# This files contains representation of taclets, which are accepted and revised.
# Each taclet is printed in parseable KeY rule syntax.
# Date: Sat Nov 28 14:35:26 CET 2026

== abortJavaCardTransactionAPI (abortJavaCardTransactionAPI) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & JavaCard:on) {
  abortJavaCardTransactionAPI {
    \schemaVar \program MethodName [name = nativeKeYAbortTransaction] #abortTransaction;
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program NonPrimitiveType [name = javacard.framework.JCSystem] #jcsystemType;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
      ==>
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #jcsystemType.#abortTransaction()@#jcsystemType;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \replacewith(
      ==>
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #abortJavaCardTransaction;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== abortJavaCardTransactionBox (abortJavaCardTransaction) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & JavaCard:on) {
  abortJavaCardTransactionBox {
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
      ==>
       \box_transaction{ ..
           #abortJavaCardTransaction;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \replacewith(
      ==>
       {heap:=anon(savedHeap,
                   allObjects(java.lang.Object::#$transactionConditionallyUpdated),
                   heap)}
         \[{ ..  ... }\] post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "abortJavaCardTransaction"
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------

    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "abortJavaCardTransaction"
  };

-----------------------------------------------------
== accDefinition (accDefinition) =========================================
\rules (reach:on) {
  accDefinition {
    \schemaVar \variables Field fv;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term deltaObject o2;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s;

    \find(acc(h, s, o, o2))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(fv, h),
      \notFreeIn(fv, o),
      \notFreeIn(fv, o2),
      \notFreeIn(fv, s)
    )
    \replacewith(
        !o = null
      & !o2 = null
      & \exists fv;
          (  elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(o,
                                                                                   fv),
                                                     s)
           & select<deltaObject>(h, o, fv) = o2)
    )
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}

== acosIsNaN (acosIsNaN) =========================================
acosIsNaN {
  \schemaVar \term double arg;

  \find(acosDouble(arg))

  \add(
        doubleIsNaN(arg)
      | ltDouble(arg,
                 negDouble(DFP(8(0(4(7(1(0(0(0(8(8(1(4(2(8(1(7(0(6(4(#))))))))))))))))))))))
      | gtDouble(arg,
                 DFP(8(0(4(7(1(0(0(0(8(8(1(4(2(8(1(7(0(6(4(#)))))))))))))))))))))
     -> doubleIsNaN(acosDouble(arg))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== acosRange (acosRange) =========================================
acosRange {
  \schemaVar \term double arg;

  \find(acosDouble(arg))

  \add(
          geqDouble(arg,
                    negDouble(DFP(8(0(4(7(1(0(0(0(8(8(1(4(2(8(1(7(0(6(4(#))))))))))))))))))))))
        & leqDouble(arg,
                    DFP(8(0(4(7(1(0(0(0(8(8(1(4(2(8(1(7(0(6(4(#)))))))))))))))))))))
     ->   geqDouble(acosDouble(arg), DFP(0(#)))
        & leqDouble(acosDouble(arg),
                    DFP(8(4(8(5(4(0(2(5(5(6(5(6(6(5(2(4(1(6(4(#)))))))))))))))))))))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}

== activeUseAddition (activeUse) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & initialisation:disableStaticInitialisation) {
  activeUseAddition {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program AnyNumberTypeExpression #left;
    \schemaVar \program AnyNumberTypeExpression #right;
    \schemaVar \program StaticVariable #sv;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #sv = #left + #right;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\newTypeOf(#v0, #sv))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #typeof(#sv) #v0 = #left + #right;
          @(#sv) = #v0;
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_expression)
    \displayname "activeUse"
  };
}

    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \heuristics(simplify_prog, simplify_prog_subset)

== activeUseSubtraction (activeUse) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & initialisation:disableStaticInitialisation) {
  activeUseSubtraction {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program AnyNumberTypeExpression #left;
    \schemaVar \program AnyNumberTypeExpression #right;
    \schemaVar \program StaticVariable #sv;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #sv = #left - #right;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\newTypeOf(#v0, #sv))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #typeof(#sv) #v0 = #left - #right;
          @(#sv) = #v0;
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_expression)
    \displayname "activeUse"
  };
}

== allFieldsEq (allFieldsEq) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  allFieldsEq {
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o1;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o2;

    \find(allFields(o1) = allFields(o2))

    \replacewith(o1 = o2)
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== allFieldsSubsetOf (allFieldsSubsetOf) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  allFieldsSubsetOf {
    \schemaVar \term Field f;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s;

    \assumes(
       subset<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(allFields(o),
                                            s)
      ==>
    )
    \find(
       elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(o,
                                                                             f),
                                               s)
    )

    \replacewith(true)
    \heuristics(concrete)
  };
}

== allFieldsUnfold (allFieldsAssignment) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  allFieldsUnfold {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program NonSimpleExpression #nseObj;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #vObjNew;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #v = \all_fields(#nseObj);
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\newTypeOf(#vObjNew, #nseObj))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #typeof(#nseObj) #vObjNew = #nseObj;
          #v = \all_fields(#vObjNew);
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "allFieldsAssignment"
  };
}

== allObjectsAssignment (allObjectsAssignment) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  allObjectsAssignment {
    \schemaVar \program Variable #a;
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #eObj;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #v = \all_objects(#eObj.#a);
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      {#v:=allObjects(#memberPVToField(#a))}
        \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

== allocateInstance (allocateInstance) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & permissions:off) {
  allocateInstance {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program MethodName [name = $allocate] #allocate;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program ProgramMethod #pm;
    \schemaVar \program Type #t;
    \schemaVar \program Type #t2;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
      ==>
       \modality{#allmodal}{ .#pm@#t2()..
           #lhs = #t.#allocate()@#t;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \varcond(\hasSort(#t2, alphaObj))
    \replacewith(
      ==>
       {heap:=create(heap, #lhs)}
         \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \add(
         !#lhs = null
       & (   wellFormed(heap)
          ->   select<boolean>(heap,
                               #lhs,
                               java.lang.Object::#$created)
             = FALSE)
       & exactInstance<alphaObj>(#lhs) = TRUE
      ==>
    )
    \heuristics(method_expand)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== allocateInstanceWithLength (allocateInstanceWithLength) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & permissions:off) {
  allocateInstanceWithLength {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program MethodName [name = $allocate] #allocate;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #len;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program ProgramMethod #pm;
    \schemaVar \program Type #t;
    \schemaVar \program Type #t2;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
      ==>
       \modality{#allmodal}{ .#pm@#t2()..
           #lhs = #t.#allocate(#len)@#t;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \varcond(\hasSort(#t2, alphaObj))
    \replacewith(
      ==>
       {heap:=store(store(create(heap, #lhs),
                          #lhs,
                          java.lang.Object::#$transient,
                          Z(0(#))),
                    #lhs,
                    java.lang.Object::#$transactionConditionallyUpdated,
                    FALSE)}
         \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \add(
         !#lhs = null
       & (   wellFormed(heap)
          ->     select<boolean>(heap,
                                 #lhs,
                                 java.lang.Object::#$created)
               = FALSE
             & length(#lhs) = #len)
       & exactInstance<alphaObj>(#lhs) = TRUE
      ==>
    )
    \heuristics(method_expand)
  };
}

== altAxiom (altAxiom) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  altAxiom {
    \schemaVar \term RegEx rexp1;
    \schemaVar \term RegEx rexp2;
    \schemaVar \term Seq string;

    \find(match(alt(rexp1, rexp2), string))

    \replacewith(
      match(rexp1, string) | match(rexp2, string)
    )
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}

== applyEq_and_gen0 (applyEq_and_gen0) =========================================
applyEq_and_gen0 {
  \schemaVar \term G applyEqLeft;
  \schemaVar \term I applyEqOther;
  \schemaVar \term H applyEqRight;

  \find(
       applyEqLeft = applyEqOther
     & applyEqLeft = applyEqRight
  )

  \replacewith(
      applyEqRight = applyEqOther
    & applyEqLeft = applyEqRight
  )
  \heuristics(apply_equations_andOr)
}

== apply_eq_monomials (apply_eq_monomials) =========================================
apply_eq_monomials {
  \schemaVar \term int applyEqDividend;
  \schemaVar \term int applyEqDivisor;
  \schemaVar \term int i0;

  \assumes(applyEqDivisor = i0 ==>)
  \find(applyEqDividend)

  \replacewith(
    add(mul(#divideMonomials(applyEqDividend,
                             applyEqDivisor),
            add(i0,
                mul(applyEqDivisor, Z(neglit(1(#)))))),
        applyEqDividend)
  )
  \heuristics(
    apply_equations,
    notHumanReadable,
    polySimp_applyEq)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== apply_eq_monomials_rigid (apply_eq_monomials_rigid) =========================================
apply_eq_monomials_rigid {
  \schemaVar \term int applyEqDividend;
  \schemaVar \term int applyEqDivisorr;
  \schemaVar \term int i0r;

  \assumes(applyEqDivisorr = i0r ==>)
  \find(applyEqDividend)
  \ignoreUpdateLevel
  \replacewith(
    add(mul(#divideMonomials(applyEqDividend,
                             applyEqDivisorr),
            add(i0r,
                mul(applyEqDivisorr, Z(neglit(1(#)))))),
        applyEqDividend)
  )
  \heuristics(
    apply_equations,
    notHumanReadable,
    polySimp_applyEqRigid)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== apply_eq_pseudo_eq (apply_eq_pseudo_eq) =========================================
apply_eq_pseudo_eq {
  \schemaVar \term int aePseudoLeft;
  \schemaVar \term int aePseudoLeftCoeff;
  \schemaVar \term int aePseudoRight;
  \schemaVar \term int aePseudoTargetFactor;
  \schemaVar \term int aePseudoTargetLeft;
  \schemaVar \term int aePseudoTargetRight;

  \assumes(
       mul(aePseudoLeft, aePseudoLeftCoeff)
     = aePseudoRight
    ==>
  )
  \find(aePseudoTargetLeft = aePseudoTargetRight)

  \replacewith(
    \if (    aePseudoTargetLeft
           = mul(aePseudoLeft, aePseudoTargetFactor)
         & !aePseudoLeftCoeff = Z(0(#)))
        \then (  mul(aePseudoRight,
                     aePseudoTargetFactor)
               = mul(aePseudoTargetRight,
                     aePseudoLeftCoeff))
        \else (aePseudoTargetLeft = aePseudoTargetRight)
  )
  \heuristics(
    notHumanReadable,
    notHumanReadable,
    polySimp_applyEqPseudo,
    polySimp_leftNonUnit)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== apply_eq_pseudo_geq (apply_eq_pseudo_geq) =========================================
apply_eq_pseudo_geq {
  \schemaVar \term int aePseudoLeft;
  \schemaVar \term int aePseudoLeftCoeff;
  \schemaVar \term int aePseudoRight;
  \schemaVar \term int aePseudoTargetFactor;
  \schemaVar \term int aePseudoTargetLeft;
  \schemaVar \term int aePseudoTargetRight;

  \assumes(
       mul(aePseudoLeft, aePseudoLeftCoeff)
     = aePseudoRight
    ==>
  )
  \find(geq(aePseudoTargetLeft, aePseudoTargetRight))

  \replacewith(
    \if (    aePseudoTargetLeft
           = mul(aePseudoLeft, aePseudoTargetFactor)
         & gt(aePseudoLeftCoeff, Z(0(#))))
        \then (geq(mul(aePseudoRight,
                       aePseudoTargetFactor),
                   mul(aePseudoTargetRight,
                       aePseudoLeftCoeff)))
        \else (geq(aePseudoTargetLeft,
                   aePseudoTargetRight))
  )
  \heuristics(
    notHumanReadable,
    polySimp_applyEqPseudo,
    polySimp_leftNonUnit)
}

       mul(aePseudoLeft, aePseudoLeftCoeff)
     = aePseudoRight

== array2seqDef (array2seqDef) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  array2seqDef {
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object a;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \variables int u;

    \find(array2seq(h, a))

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(u, a), \notFreeIn(u, h))
    \replacewith(
      seqDef{u;}(Z(0(#)),
                 length(a),
                 select<any>(h, a, arr(u)))
    )
    \heuristics(seqSimplifyEnlarging)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== arrayCreation (arrayCreation) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  arrayCreation {
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program ArrayCreation #na;
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {box, diamond} #normal;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#normal}{ ..
           #lhs = #na;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\newTypeOf(#v0, #na))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#normal}{ ..
          #typeof(#na) #v0;
          #initArrayCreation(#v0, #na)
          #lhs = #v0;
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== arrayCreationWithInitializers (arrayCreationWithInitializers) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  arrayCreationWithInitializers {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program ArrayInitializer #arrayinitializer;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs = #arrayinitializer;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\newTypeOf(#v0, #lhs))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #typeof(#lhs) #v0;
          #initArrayCreation(#v0, #arrayinitializer)
          #lhs = #v0;
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== arrayInitialisation (arrayInitialisation) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  arrayInitialisation {
    \schemaVar \program Variable #a;
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program ArrayLength #length;
    \schemaVar \program NonStringLiteral #lit;
    \schemaVar \program ProgramMethod #pm;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se;
    \schemaVar \program Type #t;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ .#pm@#t()..
           for (int #v = #se; #v < this.#length; #v++)
             this[#v] = #lit;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      {heap:=memset(heap,
                    arrayRange(#a,
                               #se,
                               sub(length(#a), Z(1(#)))),
                    #lit)}
        \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}

== arrayRangeEmpty (arrayRangeEmpty) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  arrayRangeEmpty {
    \schemaVar \term int lower;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term int upper;

    \find(
         arrayRange(o, lower, upper)
       = empty<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>
    )

    \replacewith(lt(upper, lower))
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}

== array_post_declaration (array_post_declaration) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  array_post_declaration {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program ArrayPostDeclaration #arraypost;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #arraypost
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #arrayPostDeclaration(#arraypost)
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog, simplify_prog_subset)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== array_self_reference (array_self_reference) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  array_self_reference {
    \schemaVar \term GOS array;
    \schemaVar \term Heap heapSV;
    \schemaVar \term int idx;

    \assumes(wellFormed(heapSV) ==> array = null)
    \find(
       arrayStoreValid(array,
                       select<G>(heapSV, array, arr(idx)))
    )

    \replacewith(true)
    \heuristics(simplify_java)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== array_self_reference_eq (array_self_reference_eq) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  array_self_reference_eq {
    \schemaVar \term G EQ;
    \schemaVar \term GOS array;
    \schemaVar \term Heap heapSV;
    \schemaVar \term int idx;

    \assumes(
       wellFormed(heapSV),
       select<G>(heapSV, array, arr(idx)) = EQ
      ==> array = null
    )
    \find(arrayStoreValid(array, EQ))

    \replacewith(true)
    \heuristics(simplify_java)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== array_store_known_dynamic_array_type (known dynamic array type) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  array_store_known_dynamic_array_type {
    \schemaVar \term GOS array;
    \schemaVar \term H obj;

    \assumes(exactInstance<J>(array) = TRUE ==>)
    \find(arrayStoreValid(array, obj))

    \varcond(\isReference[non_null]( J ))
    \replacewith(
        obj = null
      |   #arrayBaseInstanceOf(exactInstance<J>(array),
                               obj)
        = TRUE
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_java)
    \displayname "known dynamic array type"
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== asinIsNaN (asinIsNaN) =========================================
asinIsNaN {
  \schemaVar \term double arg;

  \find(asinDouble(arg))

  \add(
        doubleIsNaN(arg)
      | ltDouble(arg,
                 negDouble(DFP(8(0(4(7(1(0(0(0(8(8(1(4(2(8(1(7(0(6(4(#))))))))))))))))))))))
      | gtDouble(arg,
                 DFP(8(0(4(7(1(0(0(0(8(8(1(4(2(8(1(7(0(6(4(#)))))))))))))))))))))
     -> doubleIsNaN(asinDouble(arg))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== asineIsZero (asineIsZero) =========================================
asineIsZero {
  \schemaVar \term double arg;

  \find(asinDouble(arg))

  \add(
    arg = DFP(0(#)) -> asinDouble(arg) = DFP(0(#))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== asineRange (asineRange) =========================================
asineRange {
  \schemaVar \term double arg;

  \find(asinDouble(arg))

  \add(
          geqDouble(arg,
                    negDouble(DFP(8(0(4(7(1(0(0(0(8(8(1(4(2(8(1(7(0(6(4(#))))))))))))))))))))))
        & leqDouble(arg,
                    DFP(8(0(4(7(1(0(0(0(8(8(1(4(2(8(1(7(0(6(4(#)))))))))))))))))))))
     ->   geqDouble(asinDouble(arg),
                    negDouble(DFP(2(5(3(5(7(6(4(2(9(6(5(0(3(5(7(9(0(6(4(#))))))))))))))))))))))
        & leqDouble(asinDouble(arg),
                    DFP(2(5(3(5(7(6(4(2(9(6(5(0(3(5(7(9(0(6(4(#)))))))))))))))))))))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== assertSafe (assert) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & assertions:safe) {
  assertSafe {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #condition;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e1;
    \schemaVar \program ExecutionContext #ex;
    \schemaVar \formula  b;
    \schemaVar \variables Field f;
    \schemaVar \variables java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm Heap oldHeap;

    \find(
      ==>
       \modality{#allmodal}{ .#ex..
           assert #e1;
         ... }\endmodality b
    )
    \varcond(
      \newDependingOn(oldHeap, b),
      \newTypeOf(#condition, #e1),
      \not \containsAssignment( #e1 )
    )
    "Assertion (#e1) Skip":
      \replacewith(
        ==> \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality b
      );
    "Assertion (#e1) Terminates And OK":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
         \<{
             method-frame (#ex) {
               #condition = #e1;
             }
           }\> #condition = TRUE
      );
    "Assertion (#e1) No Effects":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
         \[{
             method-frame (#ex) {
               #typeof(#e1) #condition = #e1;
             }
           }\] \forall f;
                 \forall o;
                   (    !o = null
                      &   select<boolean>(oldHeap,
                                          o,
                                          java.lang.Object::#$created)
                        = FALSE
                    |   select<any>(oldHeap, o, f)
                      = select<any>(heap, o, f))
      )
      \add(oldHeap = heap ==>)
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "assert"
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== assertSafeWithMessage (assert) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & assertions:safe) {
  assertSafeWithMessage {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #condition;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e1;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e2;
    \schemaVar \program ExecutionContext #ex;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #message;
    \schemaVar \formula  b;
    \schemaVar \variables Field f;
    \schemaVar \variables java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm Heap oldHeap;

    \find(
      ==>
       \modality{#allmodal}{ .#ex..
           assert #e1 : #e2;
         ... }\endmodality b
    )
    \varcond(
      \newDependingOn(oldHeap, b),
      \newTypeOf(#condition, #e1),
      \newTypeOf(#message, #e2),
      \not \containsAssignment( #e1 ),
      \not \containsAssignment( #e2 )
    )
    "Assertion (#e1) Skip":
      \replacewith(
        ==> \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality b
      );
    "Assertion (#e1) Terminates And OK":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
         \<{
             method-frame (#ex) {
               #typeof(#e1) #condition = #e1;
               #typeof(#e2) #message = #e2;
             }
           }\> #condition = TRUE
      );
    "Assertion (#e1) No Effects":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
         \[{
             method-frame (#ex) {
               #typeof(#e1) #condition = #e1;
               #typeof(#e2) #message = #e2;
             }
           }\] \forall f;
                 \forall o;
                   (    !o = null
                      &   select<boolean>(oldHeap,
                                          o,
                                          java.lang.Object::#$created)
                        = FALSE
                    |   select<any>(oldHeap, o, f)
                      = select<any>(heap, o, f))
      )
      \add(oldHeap = heap ==>)
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "assert"
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== assignableDefinition (assignableDefinition) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  assignableDefinition {
    \schemaVar \variables Field f;
    \schemaVar \term Heap heapNew;
    \schemaVar \term Heap heapOld;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> locs;
    \schemaVar \variables java.lang.Object o;

    \find(assignable(heapNew, heapOld, locs))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(f, heapNew),
      \notFreeIn(f, heapOld),
      \notFreeIn(f, locs),
      \notFreeIn(o, heapNew),
      \notFreeIn(o, heapOld),
      \notFreeIn(o, locs)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \forall f;
        \forall o;
          (  elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(o,
                                                                                   f),
                                                     locs)
           | !o = null
           & !  select<boolean>(heapOld,
                                o,
                                java.lang.Object::#$created)
              = TRUE
           |   select<any>(heapNew, o, f)
             = select<any>(heapOld, o, f))
    )
    \heuristics(delayedExpansion)
  };
}

== assignment (assignment) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  assignment {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #loc;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #loc = #se;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      {#loc:=#se}
        \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog, simplify_prog_subset)
  };
}

== assignmentAdditionBigint1 (addition) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & bigint:on) {
  assignmentAdditionBigint1 {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #loc;
    \schemaVar \program AnyNumberTypeExpression #seAny;
    \schemaVar \program JavaBigintExpression #seBigint;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #loc = #seBigint + #seAny;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      {#loc:=add(#seBigint, #seAny)}
        \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(executeIntegerAssignment)
    \displayname "addition"
  };
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== assignment_array2 (assignment_array2) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & runtimeExceptions:ban) {
  assignment_array2 {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
      ==>
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #v = #v0[#se];
         ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \varcond(\hasElementarySort(#v0, G))
    "Normal Execution (#v0 != null)":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
         {#v:=select<G>(heap, #v0, arr(#se))}
           \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
      );
    "Null Reference (#v0 = null)":
      \replacewith(==> false)
      \add(#v0 = null ==>);
    "Index Out of Bounds (#v0 != null, but #se Out of Bounds!)":
      \replacewith(==> false)
      \add(
           !#v0 = null
         & (leq(length(#v0), #se) | lt(#se, Z(0(#))))
        ==>
      )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog, simplify_prog_subset)
  };
}

== assignment_read_attribute (assignment_read_attribute) =========================================
\rules ((programRules:Java & runtimeExceptions:ban) & finalFields:immutable) {
  assignment_read_attribute {
    \schemaVar \program Variable #a;
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
      ==>
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #v0 = #v.#a;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \varcond(
       \not \final(#a),
       \not \isArrayLength(#a),
       \not \static(#a),
      \hasSort(#a, G),
      \not\isThisReference (#v)
    )
    "Normal Execution (#v != null)":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
         {#v0:=select<G>(heap, #v, #memberPVToField(#a))}
           \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
      );
    "Null Reference (#v = null)":
      \replacewith(==> false)
      \add(#v = null ==>)
    \heuristics(simplify_prog, simplify_prog_subset)
  };
}

== assignment_to_primitive_array_component (assignment_to_primitive_array_component) =========================================

    "Null Reference (#v = null)":
      \replacewith(==> false)
      \add(#v = null ==>);
    "Index Out of Bounds (#v != null, but #se Out of Bounds!)":
      \replacewith(==> false)
      \add(
           !#v = null
         & (leq(length(#v), #se) | lt(#se, Z(0(#))))
        ==>
      )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog, simplify_prog_subset)
  };
}

  assignment_to_primitive_array_component_transaction {
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se0;
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box_transaction,
      diamond_transaction
    } #transaction;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
      ==>
       \modality{#transaction}{ ..
           #v[#se] = #se0;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \varcond( \not \isReferenceArray(#v))
    "Normal Execution (#v != null)":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
         {heap:=store(heap, #v, arr(#se), #se0)}
           {savedHeap:=\if (  select<int>(heap,
                                          #v,
                                          java.lang.Object::#$transient)
                            = Z(0(#)))
                           \then (store(savedHeap,
                                        #v,
                                        java.lang.Object::#$transactionConditionallyUpdated,
                                        TRUE))
                           \else (\if (  select<boolean>(savedHeap,
                                                         #v,
                                                         java.lang.Object::#$transactionConditionallyUpdated)
                                       = FALSE)
                                      \then (store(savedHeap,
                                                   #v,
                                                   arr(#se),
                                                   #se0))
                                      \else (savedHeap))}
             \modality{#transaction}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
      );
    "Null Reference (#v = null)":
      \replacewith(==> false)
      \add(#v = null ==>);
    "Index Out of Bounds (#v != null, but #se Out of Bounds!)":
      \replacewith(==> false)
      \add(
           !#v = null
         & (leq(length(#v), #se) | lt(#se, Z(0(#))))
        ==>
      )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog, simplify_prog_subset)
    \displayname "assignment_to_primitive_array_component"
  };
}

== assignment_to_reference_array_component (assignment_to_reference_array_component) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & runtimeExceptions:ban) {

== associativeLawIntersect (associativeLawIntersect) =========================================
associativeLawIntersect {
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s1;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s2;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s3;

  \find(intersect<T>(s1, intersect<T>(s2, s3)))

  \replacewith(intersect<T>(intersect<T>(s1, s2), s3))
  \heuristics(setAssoc)
}

== atan2IsNaN (atan2IsNaN) =========================================
atan2IsNaN {
  \schemaVar \term double arg1;
  \schemaVar \term double arg2;

  \find(atan2Double(arg1, arg2))

  \add(
        doubleIsNaN(arg1)
      | doubleIsNaN(arg2)
     -> doubleIsNaN(atan2Double(arg1, arg2))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}

== atan2Range (atan2Range) =========================================
atan2Range {
  \schemaVar \term double arg1;
  \schemaVar \term double arg2;

  \find(atan2Double(arg1, arg2))

  \add(
        !doubleIsNaN(arg1) & !doubleIsNaN(arg2)
     ->   geqDouble(atan2Double(arg1, arg2),
                    negDouble(DFP(8(4(8(5(4(0(2(5(5(6(5(6(6(5(2(4(1(6(4(#))))))))))))))))))))))
        & leqDouble(atan2Double(arg1, arg2),
                    DFP(8(4(8(5(4(0(2(5(5(6(5(6(6(5(2(4(1(6(4(#)))))))))))))))))))))
    ==>
  )
}

== autoInductGEQ_Lemma_1 (auto_induction_lemma) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  autoInductGEQ_Lemma_1 {
    \schemaVar \formula  b;
    \schemaVar \formula  phi;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm int sk;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(==> \forall uSub; (leq(t, uSub) -> b) & phi)
    \varcond(\newDependingOn(sk, b), \notFreeIn(uSub, t))
    "Base Case":
      \replacewith(
        ==> #ExpandQueries({\subst uSub;t}b, true)
      );
    "Step Case":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
            geq(sk, Z(0(#))) & {\subst uSub;add(t, sk)}b
         -> #ExpandQueries({\subst uSub;add(t,
                                            add(sk,
                                                Z(1(#))))}
                             b,
                           true)
      );
    "Use Case":
      \replacewith(
        \forall uSub; (leq(t, uSub) -> b)
        ==> phi
      )
    \heuristics(auto_induction_lemma, induction_var)
    \displayname "auto_induction_lemma"
  };
}

    \schemaVar \formula  phi;
    \schemaVar \formula  psi;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm int sk;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(
      ==>
      \forall uSub; (leq(uSub, t) | psi | b) & phi
    )
    \varcond(\newDependingOn(sk, b), \notFreeIn(uSub, t))
    "Base Case":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
         #ExpandQueries({\subst uSub;add(t, Z(1(#)))}
                          (psi | b),
                        true)
      );
    "Step Case":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
              geq(sk, Z(1(#)))
            & {\subst uSub;add(t, sk)}(psi | b)
         -> #ExpandQueries({\subst uSub;add(t,
                                            add(sk,
                                                Z(1(#))))}
                             (psi | b),
                           true)
      );
    "Use Case":
      \replacewith(
        \forall uSub; (lt(t, uSub) -> psi | b)
        ==> phi
      )
    \heuristics(auto_induction_lemma, induction_var)
    \displayname "auto_induction_lemma"
  };
}

== autoInduct_Lemma (autoInduct_Lemma) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  autoInduct_Lemma {
    \schemaVar \formula  b;
    \schemaVar \formula  phi;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm int sk;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(==> \forall uSub; b & phi)
    \varcond(\newDependingOn(sk, b))
    "Base Case":
      \replacewith(==> {\subst uSub;Z(0(#))}b);
    "Step Case (positive)":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
            geq(sk, Z(0(#))) & {\subst uSub;sk}b
         -> {\subst uSub;add(sk, Z(1(#)))}b
      );
    "Step Case (negative)":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
            leq(sk, Z(0(#))) & {\subst uSub;sk}b
         -> {\subst uSub;sub(sk, Z(1(#)))}b
      );
    "Use Case":
      \replacewith(\forall uSub; b ==> phi)
  };
}

== beginJavaCardTransactionAPI (beginJavaCardTransactionAPI) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & JavaCard:on) {
  beginJavaCardTransactionAPI {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program MethodName [name = nativeKeYBeginTransaction] #beginTransaction;
    \schemaVar \program NonPrimitiveType [name = javacard.framework.JCSystem] #jcsystemType;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
      ==>
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #jcsystemType.#beginTransaction()@#jcsystemType;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \replacewith(
      ==>
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #beginJavaCardTransaction;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

  \find(binaryAnd(left, Z(1(#))))

  \replacewith(
    \if (mod(left, Z(2(#))) = Z(0(#)))
        \then (Z(0(#)))
        \else (Z(1(#)))
  )
  \heuristics(simplify_enlarging)
}

== binaryOrGte (binaryOrGte) =========================================
binaryOrGte {
  \schemaVar \term int left;
  \schemaVar \term int right;

  \find(binaryOr(left, right))

  \add(
        geq(left, Z(0(#))) & geq(right, Z(0(#)))
     ->   geq(binaryOr(left, right), left)
        & geq(binaryOr(left, right), right)
        & leq(binaryOr(left, right),
              mul(Z(2(#)),
                  \if (gt(left, right))
                      \then (left)
                      \else (right)))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}

== bprod_all_positive (bprod_all_positive) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full & sequences:on) {
  bprod_all_positive {
    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i1;
    \schemaVar \term int t1;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(bprod{uSub;}(i0, i1, t1))

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(uSub, i0), \notFreeIn(uSub, i1))
    \add(
          \forall uSub;
            (   leq(i0, uSub) & lt(uSub, i1)
             -> geq(t1, Z(0(#))))
       -> geq(bprod{uSub;}(i0, i1, t1), Z(0(#)))
      ==>
    )
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== bprod_commutative_associative (bprod_commutative_associative) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  bprod_commutative_associative {
    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i2;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \term int t2;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub1;

    \find(bprod{uSub;}(i0, i2, mul(t, t2)))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, i2),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i2),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, t2)
    )
    \replacewith(
      mul(bprod{uSub;}(i0, i2, t),
          bprod{uSub1;}(i0, i2, {\subst uSub;uSub1}t2))
    )
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== bprod_empty (bprod_empty) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  bprod_empty {
    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i1;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(bprod{uSub;}(i0, i1, t))

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(uSub, i0), \notFreeIn(uSub, i1))
    "Precondition":
      \add(==> leq(i1, i0));
    "Empty Sum":
      \replacewith(Z(1(#)))
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== bprod_equal_one_right (bprod_equal_one_right) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  bprod_equal_one_right {
    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i2;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(==> bprod{uSub;}(i0, i2, t) = Z(1(#)))
    \varcond(\notFreeIn(uSub, i0), \notFreeIn(uSub, i2))
    \add(
      ==>
       \forall uSub;
         {\subst uSub;uSub}
           (geq(uSub, i0) & lt(uSub, i2) -> t = Z(1(#)))
    )
    \heuristics(comprehensions)
  };
}

       \exists uSub;

    )
    \heuristics(comprehensions)
  };

-----------------------------------------------------
== bprod_find (bprod_find) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  bprod_find {
    \schemaVar \term int high;
    \schemaVar \term int low;
    \schemaVar \term int middle;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(bprod{uSub;}(low, high, t))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, high),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, low),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, middle)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \if (leq(low, middle) & leq(middle, high))
          \then (mul(bprod{uSub;}(low, middle, t),
                     bprod{uSub;}(middle, high, t)))
          \else (bprod{uSub;}(low, high, t))
    )
    \heuristics(comprehension_split, triggered)
    \trigger {middle} bprod{uSub;}(low, middle, t)
         \avoid leq(middle, low), geq(middle, high);
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== bprod_induction_lower (bprod_induction_lower) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  bprod_induction_lower {
    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i2;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(bprod{uSub;}(i0, i2, t))

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(uSub, i0), \notFreeIn(uSub, i2))
    \replacewith(
      mul(bprod{uSub;}(add(i0, Z(1(#))), i2, t),
          \if (lt(i0, i2))
              \then ({\subst uSub;i0}t)
              \else (Z(1(#))))
    )
  };
}

== bprod_induction_lower_concrete (bprod_induction_lower_concrete) =========================================

    \schemaVar \term int i2;
    \schemaVar \term int t;

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(uSub, i0), \notFreeIn(uSub, i2))
    \replacewith(
      mul(bprod{uSub;}(i0, i2, t),
          \if (lt(add(Z(neglit(1(#))), i0), i2))
              \then ({\subst uSub;add(Z(neglit(1(#))),
                                      i0)}
                       t)
              \else (Z(1(#))))
    )
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}

== bprod_invert_index (bprod_invert_index) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  bprod_invert_index {
    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i1;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub1;

    \find(bprod{uSub;}(i0, i1, t))

== bprod_split (bprod_split) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full & sequences:on) {
  bprod_split {
    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i1;
    \schemaVar \term int middle;
    \schemaVar \term int t1;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(bprod{uSub;}(i0, i1, t1))

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(uSub, i0), \notFreeIn(uSub, i1))
    \replacewith(
      \if (leq(i0, middle) & leq(middle, i1))
          \then (mul(bprod{uSub;}(i0, middle, t1),
                     bprod{uSub;}(middle, i1, t1)))
          \else (bprod{uSub;}(i0, i1, t1))
    )
  };

== break (break) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  break {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Label #lb0;
    \schemaVar \program Label #lb1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lb0:
           break #lb1;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #doBreak(#lb0:
          break #lb1;)
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

== bsum_add (bsum_add) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  bsum_add {
    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i1;
    \schemaVar \term int i2;
    \schemaVar \term int i3;
    \schemaVar \term int t1;
    \schemaVar \term int t2;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub1;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub2;

    \find(
       add(bsum{uSub1;}(i0, i1, t1),
           bsum{uSub2;}(i2, i3, t2))
    )

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i2),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i3),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, t2),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, i2),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, i3),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, t1)
    )
    \replacewith(
      bsum{uSub1;}(\if (lt(i0, i2))
                       \then (i0)
                       \else (i2),
                   \if (gt(i1, i3))
                       \then (i1)
                       \else (i3),
                   {\subst uSub2;uSub1}
                     add(\if (  leq(i0, uSub1)
                              & lt(uSub1, i1))
                             \then (t1)
                             \else (Z(0(#))),
                         \if (  leq(i2, uSub1)
                              & lt(uSub1, i3))
                             \then (t2)
                             \else (Z(0(#)))))
    )
  };
}

== bsum_equal_except_one_index (bsum_equal_except_one_index) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  bsum_equal_except_one_index {
    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i1;
    \schemaVar \term int index;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \term int t1;
    \schemaVar \term int t2;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub1;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub2;

    \find(
      ==>
         bsum{uSub1;}(i0, i1, t1)
       = add(bsum{uSub2;}(i0, i1, t2), t)
    )
    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, index),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, t),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, t2),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, index),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, t),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, t1)
    )
    "Precondition":
      \add(
        ==>
           leq(i0, index)
         & lt(index, i1)
         & \forall uSub1;
             (     geq(uSub1, i0)
                 & lt(uSub1, i1)
                 & !uSub1 = index
              -> t1 = {\subst uSub2;uSub1}t2)
      );
    "Usage":
      \add(
        ==>
           t
         = sub({\subst uSub1;index}t1,
               {\subst uSub2;index}t2)
      )
  };
}

== bsum_equal_split1 (bsum_equal_split1) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  bsum_equal_split1 {
    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i1;
    \schemaVar \term int i2;
    \schemaVar \term int t1;
    \schemaVar \term int t2;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub1;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub2;

    \find(
      ==>
      bsum{uSub1;}(i0, i1, t1) = bsum{uSub2;}(i0, i2, t2)
    )
    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i2),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, t2),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, i2),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, t1)
    )
    \add(
      ==>
         leq(i0, i1)
       & leq(i0, i2)
       & \if (lt(i1, i2))
             \then (  bsum{uSub1;}(i0,
                                   i1,
                                   sub(t1,
                                       {\subst uSub2;uSub1}
                                         t2))
                    = bsum{uSub2;}(i1, i2, t2))
             \else (  bsum{uSub1;}(i2, i1, t1)
                    = bsum{uSub2;}(i0,
                                   i2,
                                   sub(t2,
                                       {\subst uSub1;uSub2}
                                         t1)))
    )
    \heuristics(comprehensions)
  };
}

  };

== bsum_less_same_index (bsum_less_same_index) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  bsum_less_same_index {
    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i1;
    \schemaVar \term int t1;
    \schemaVar \term int t2;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub1;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub2;

    \find(
      ==>
       lt(bsum{uSub1;}(i0, i1, t1),
          bsum{uSub2;}(i0, i1, t2))
    )
    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, t2),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, t1)
    )
    \add(
      ==>
         \forall uSub1;
           (   geq(uSub1, i0) & lt(uSub1, i1)
            -> leq(t1, {\subst uSub2;uSub1}t2))
       & \exists uSub1;
           (  geq(uSub1, i0)
            & lt(uSub1, i1)
            & lt(t1, {\subst uSub2;uSub1}t2))
    )
  };
}

== bsum_positive_lower_bound_element (bsum_positive_lower_bound_element) =========================================

    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i1;
    \schemaVar \term int index;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(bsum{uSub;}(i0, i1, t))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, index)
    )
    "Precondition":
      \add(
        ==>
           \forall uSub;
             (     geq(uSub, i0)
                 & lt(uSub, i1)
                 & !uSub = index
              -> geq(t, Z(0(#))))
         & leq(i0, index)
         & lt(index, i1)
      );
    "Usage":
      \add(
        leq({\subst uSub;index}t, bsum{uSub;}(i0, i1, t))
        ==>
      )
  };
}

    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(bsum{uSub;}(i0, i1, t))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, t)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \if (geq(i1, i0))
          \then (mul(t, sub(i1, i0)))
          \else (Z(0(#)))
    )
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== bsum_shift_index (bsum_shift_index) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  bsum_shift_index {
    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i1;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub1;

    \find(bsum{uSub;}(i0, i1, t))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, t)
    )
    \replacewith(
      bsum{uSub1;}(Z(0(#)),
                   sub(i1, i0),
                   {\subst uSub;add(uSub1, i0)}t)
    )
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== bsum_split (bsum_split) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  bsum_split {
    \schemaVar \term int high;
    \schemaVar \term int low;
    \schemaVar \term int middle;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(bsum{uSub;}(low, high, t))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, high),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, low),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, middle)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \if (leq(low, middle) & leq(middle, high))
          \then (add(bsum{uSub;}(low, middle, t),
                     bsum{uSub;}(middle, high, t)))
          \else (bsum{uSub;}(low, high, t))
    )
    \heuristics(comprehension_split, triggered)
    \trigger {middle} bsum{uSub;}(low, middle, t)
         \avoid leq(middle, low), geq(middle, high);
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== bsum_split_in_three (bsum_split_in_three) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  bsum_split_in_three {
    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i1;
    \schemaVar \term int i2;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub1;

    \find(bsum{uSub;}(i0, i2, t))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i2),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, t)
    )
    "Precondition":
      \add(==> leq(i0, i1) & lt(i1, i2));
    "Splitted Sum":
      \replacewith(
        add(add(bsum{uSub;}(i0, i1, t),
                {\subst uSub;i1}t),
            bsum{uSub1;}(add(i1, Z(1(#))),
                         i2,
                         {\subst uSub;uSub1}t))
      )
  };
}

== bsum_sub_same_index (bsum_sub_same_index) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  bsum_sub_same_index {
    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i1;
    \schemaVar \term int t1;
    \schemaVar \term int t2;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub1;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub2;

    \find(
       sub(bsum{uSub1;}(i0, i1, t1),
           bsum{uSub2;}(i0, i1, t2))
    )

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, t2),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, t1)
    )
    \add(
         bsum{uSub1;}(i0,
                      i1,
                      sub(t1, {\subst uSub2;uSub1}t2))
       = sub(bsum{uSub1;}(i0, i1, t1),
             bsum{uSub2;}(i0, i1, t2))
      ==>
    )
  };
}

== bsum_upper_bound (bsum_upper_bound) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  bsum_upper_bound {
    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i1;
    \schemaVar \term int j;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(bsum{uSub;}(i0, i1, t))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, j)
    )
    \add(
          \forall uSub;
            (geq(uSub, i0) & lt(uSub, i1) -> leq(t, j))
       -> leq(bsum{uSub;}(i0, i1, t),
              \if (gt(sub(i1, i0), Z(0(#))))
                  \then (mul(sub(i1, i0), j))
                  \else (Z(0(#))))
      ==>
    )
  };
}

    \schemaVar \term int i2;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(==> bsum{uSub;}(i0, i2, t) = Z(0(#)))

    conjNormalForm,
    notHumanReadable)

      {#lhs:=\if (#seBool = TRUE)
                 \then (FALSE)
                 \else (TRUE)}
        \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_expression)
    \displayname "assignment_negation"
  };
}

== compound_assignment_op_and (compound_assignment_op_and) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  compound_assignment_op_and {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs &= #e;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #lhs = (#typeof(#lhs)) (#lhs & (#e));
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== compound_assignment_op_and_array (compound_assignment_op_and_array) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  compound_assignment_op_and_array {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e0;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e1;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #e0[#e] &= #e1;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\newTypeOf(#v0, #e0), \newTypeOf(#v1, #e))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #typeof(#e0) #v0 = #e0;
          #typeof(#e) #v1 = #e;
          #v0[#v1] = (#typeof(#e0[#e])) (#v0[#v1] & #e1);
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

== compound_assignment_xor_nonsimple (compound_assignment) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  compound_assignment_xor_nonsimple {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program JavaBooleanExpression #exBool1;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program NonSimpleExpression #nseBool0;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs = #nseBool0 ^ #exBool1;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\new(#v0, boolean), \new(#v1, boolean))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          boolean #v0 = #nseBool0;
          boolean #v1 = #exBool1;
          #lhs = #v0 ^ #v1;
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_expression)
    \displayname "compound_assignment"
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== compound_assignment_xor_simple (assignment_xor) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  compound_assignment_xor_simple {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleJavaBooleanExpression #seBool0;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleJavaBooleanExpression #seBool1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs = #seBool0 ^ #seBool1;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      {#lhs:=\if (#seBool0 = #seBool1)
                 \then (FALSE)
                 \else (TRUE)}
        \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_expression)
    \displayname "assignment_xor"
  };
}

== condition (condition) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  condition {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e0;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e1;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e2;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs = #e0 ? #e1 : #e2;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          if (#e0) {
            #lhs = #e1;
          } else {
            #lhs = #e2;
          }
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog, split_if)
  };
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== contains (contains) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  contains {
    \schemaVar \term int fstTextCharacter;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm int newSym;
    \schemaVar \term Seq searchString;
    \schemaVar \term Seq textStringTail;

    \find(
       clContains(seqConcat(seqSingleton(fstTextCharacter),
                            textStringTail),
                  searchString)
    )

    \varcond(\newDependingOn(newSym, searchString))
    \replacewith(
        lt(newSym, seqLen(textStringTail))
      & (    seqSub(seqConcat(seqSingleton(fstTextCharacter),
                              textStringTail),
                    Z(0(#)),
                    newSym)
           = searchString
         | clContains(textStringTail, searchString))
    )
    \add(seqLen(searchString) = newSym ==>)
    \heuristics(
      stringsContainsDefInline,
      stringsIntroduceNewSym)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== containsAxiomAntec (containsAxiomAntec) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  containsAxiomAntec {
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \term Seq searchString;
    \schemaVar \term Seq textString;

    \find(clContains(textString, searchString) ==>)
    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(iv, searchString),
      \notFreeIn(iv, textString)
    )
    \replacewith(
       \exists iv;
         (  geq(iv, Z(0(#)))
          & leq(add(iv, seqLen(searchString)),
                seqLen(textString))
          &   seqSub(textString,
                     iv,
                     add(iv, seqLen(searchString)))
            = searchString)
      ==>
    )
    \heuristics(stringsExpandDefNormalOp)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== containsAxiomSucc (containsAxiomSucc) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  containsAxiomSucc {
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \term Seq searchString;
    \schemaVar \term Seq textString;

    \find(==> clContains(textString, searchString))
    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(iv, searchString),
      \notFreeIn(iv, textString)
    )
    \replacewith(
      ==>
       \exists iv;
         (  geq(iv, Z(0(#)))
          & leq(add(iv, seqLen(searchString)),
                seqLen(textString))
          &   seqSub(textString,
                     iv,
                     add(iv, seqLen(searchString)))
            = searchString)
    )
    \heuristics(stringsExpandDefNormalOp)
  };
}

== cosIsNaN (cosIsNaN) =========================================
cosIsNaN {
  \schemaVar \term double arg;

  \find(cosDouble(arg))

  \add(
        doubleIsNaN(arg)
      | doubleIsInfinite(arg)
     -> doubleIsNaN(cosDouble(arg))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}

  \add(
        !doubleIsNaN(arg) & !doubleIsInfinite(arg)
     -> !doubleIsNaN(cosDouble(arg))
    ==>
  )

}

== cosRange (cosRange) =========================================
cosRange {
  \schemaVar \term double arg;

  \find(cosDouble(arg))

  \add(
         geqDouble(cosDouble(arg), DFP(0(#)))
       & leqDouble(cosDouble(arg),
                   DFP(8(0(4(7(1(0(0(0(8(8(1(4(2(8(1(7(0(6(4(#)))))))))))))))))))))
     | doubleIsNaN(cosDouble(arg))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}

  \schemaVar \term double arg;

  \add(
        !doubleIsNaN(arg) & !doubleIsInfinite(arg)
     ->   geqDouble(cosDouble(arg), DFP(0(#)))
        & leqDouble(cosDouble(arg),
                    DFP(8(0(4(7(1(0(0(0(8(8(1(4(2(8(1(7(0(6(4(#)))))))))))))))))))))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}

== cosRangeAlt (cosRangeAlt) =========================================
cosRangeAlt {
  \schemaVar \term double arg;

  \find(==> doubleIsNaN(cosDouble(arg)))
  \add(
       geqDouble(cosDouble(arg), DFP(0(#)))
     & leqDouble(cosDouble(arg),
                 DFP(8(0(4(7(1(0(0(0(8(8(1(4(2(8(1(7(0(6(4(#)))))))))))))))))))))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}

== createdInHeapToElementOf (createdInHeapToElementOf) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  createdInHeapToElementOf {
    \schemaVar \variables Field fv;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \variables java.lang.Object ov;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s;

    \find(createdInHeap(s, h))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(fv, h),
      \notFreeIn(fv, s),
      \notFreeIn(ov, h),
      \notFreeIn(ov, s)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \forall ov;
        \forall fv;
          (   elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(ov,
                                                                                    fv),
                                                      s)
           ->   ov = null
              |   select<boolean>(h,
                                  ov,
                                  java.lang.Object::#$created)
                = TRUE)
    )
    \heuristics(classAxiom)
  };
}

== crossInst (crossInst) =========================================
crossInst {
  \schemaVar \formula  a;
  \schemaVar \formula  b;
  \schemaVar \formula  c;
  \schemaVar \term int i;
  \schemaVar \term int j;
  \schemaVar \term int k;
  \schemaVar \skolemTerm int sk;
  \schemaVar \variables int v;

  \assumes(==> leq(k, Z(neglit(1(#)))) | geq(k, i) | c)
  \find(
     \forall v;
       (leq(v, Z(neglit(1(#)))) | geq(v, j) | b | a)
    ==>
  )
  \varcond(\newDependingOn(sk, b))
  \add(
       sk = k
     & {\subst v;sk}
         (leq(v, Z(neglit(1(#)))) | geq(v, j) | b | a)
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(loopInvariant)
}

== cut (cut) =========================================
cut {
  \schemaVar \formula  cutFormula;

  "CUT: #cutFormula TRUE":
    \add(cutFormula ==>);
  "CUT: #cutFormula FALSE":
    \add(==> cutFormula)
  \heuristics(cut)
}

== cutUpperBound (cutUpperBound) =========================================
cutUpperBound {
  \schemaVar \formula  a;
  \schemaVar \formula  b;
  \schemaVar \formula  c;
  \schemaVar \term int i;
  \schemaVar \term int j;
  \schemaVar \term int k;
  \schemaVar \variables int v;

  \assumes(
     \forall v;
       (leq(v, Z(neglit(1(#)))) | geq(v, j) | b | a)
    ==>
  )
  \find(==> leq(k, Z(neglit(1(#)))) | geq(k, i) | c)
  \add(k = i ==>);
  \add(!k = i ==>)
  \heuristics(loopInvariant)
}

    \add(==> cutFormula)
  \heuristics(cut_direct)
}

== defIsFinite (defIsFinite) =========================================
defIsFinite {
  \schemaVar \variables int ix;
  \schemaVar \variables K kv;
  \schemaVar \term Map<K,V> m;
  \schemaVar \variables PSeq<K> s;

  \find(isFinite<K, V>(m))

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(kv, m), \notFreeIn(s, m))
  \replacewith(
    \exists s;
      \forall kv;
        (  (   inDomain<K, V>(m, kv)
            -> \exists ix;
                 (  leq(Z(0(#)), ix)
                  & lt(ix, pseqLen<K>(s))
                  & pseqGet<K>(s, ix) = kv
                  & \forall int jx;
                      (     leq(Z(0(#)), jx)
                          & lt(jx, pseqLen<K>(s))
                          & !ix = jx
                       -> !pseqGet<K>(s, jx) = kv)))
         & (   \exists ix;
                 (  leq(Z(0(#)), ix)
                  & lt(ix, pseqLen<K>(s))
                  & pseqGet<K>(s, ix) = kv)
            -> inDomain<K, V>(m, kv)))
  )
}

== defMapEmpty (defMapEmpty) =========================================
defMapEmpty {
  \schemaVar \variables K kv;

  \find(mapEmpty<K, V>)

  \replacewith(
    mapForeach<K, V>{kv;}(FALSE, mapUndef<V>)
  )
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== defMapEquality (defMapEquality) =========================================
defMapEquality {
  \schemaVar \variables K kv;
  \schemaVar \term Map<K,V> m0;
  \schemaVar \term Map<K,V> m1;

  \find(m0 = m1)

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(kv, m0), \notFreeIn(kv, m1))
  \replacewith(
    \forall kv;
      (  (    inDomain<K, V>(m0, kv)
          <-> inDomain<K, V>(m1, kv))
       & (   inDomain<K, V>(m0, kv)
          ->   mapGet<K, V>(m0, kv)
             = mapGet<K, V>(m1, kv)))
  )
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== defMapOverride (defMapOverride) =========================================
defMapOverride {
  \schemaVar \variables K kv;
  \schemaVar \term Map<K,V> m0;
  \schemaVar \term Map<K,V> m1;

  \find(mapOverride<K, V>(m0, m1))

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(kv, m0), \notFreeIn(kv, m1))
  \replacewith(
    mapForeach<K, V>{kv;}(\if (  inDomain<K, V>(m0, kv)
                               | inDomain<K, V>(m1, kv))
                              \then (TRUE)
                              \else (FALSE),
                          \if (inDomain<K, V>(m1, kv))
                              \then (mapGet<K, V>(m1,
                                                  kv))
                              \else (mapGet<K, V>(m0,
                                                  kv)))
  )
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== defMapRemove (defMapRemove) =========================================
defMapRemove {
  \schemaVar \term K key;
  \schemaVar \variables K kv;
  \schemaVar \term Map<K,V> m;

  \find(mapRemove<K, V>(m, key))

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(kv, key), \notFreeIn(kv, m))
  \replacewith(
    mapForeach<K, V>{kv;}(\if (  inDomain<K, V>(m, kv)
                               & !kv = key)
                              \then (TRUE)
                              \else (FALSE),
                          mapGet<K, V>(m, kv))
  )
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== defMapSingleton (defMapSingleton) =========================================
defMapSingleton {
  \schemaVar \term K key;
  \schemaVar \variables K kv;
  \schemaVar \term V value;

  \find(mapSingleton<K, V>(key, value))

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(kv, key), \notFreeIn(kv, value))
  \replacewith(
    mapForeach<K, V>{kv;}(\if (kv = key)
                              \then (TRUE)
                              \else (FALSE),
                          value)
  )
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== defMapUpdate (defMapUpdate) =========================================
defMapUpdate {
  \schemaVar \term K key;
  \schemaVar \variables K kv;
  \schemaVar \term Map<K,V> m;
  \schemaVar \term V value;

  \find(mapUpdate<K, V>(m, key, value))

  \varcond(
    \notFreeIn(kv, key),
    \notFreeIn(kv, m),
    \notFreeIn(kv, value)
  )
  \replacewith(
    mapForeach<K, V>{kv;}(\if (  inDomain<K, V>(m, kv)
                               | kv = key)
                              \then (TRUE)
                              \else (FALSE),
                          \if (kv = key)
                              \then (value)
                              \else (mapGet<K, V>(m,
                                                  kv)))
  )
}

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(uSub, te))
    \replacewith(seqDef{uSub;}(Z(0(#)), Z(0(#)), te))
  };

== defOfPSeqConcat (defOfPSeqConcat) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  defOfPSeqConcat {
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> seq1;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> seq2;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(pseqConcat<E>(seq1, seq2))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, seq1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, seq2)
    )
    \replacewith(
      pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(Z(0(#)),
                        add(pseqLen<E>(seq1),
                            pseqLen<E>(seq2)),
                        \if (lt(uSub, pseqLen<E>(seq1)))
                            \then (pseqGet<E>(seq1, uSub))
                            \else (pseqGet<E>(seq2,
                                              sub(uSub,
                                                  pseqLen<E>(seq1)))))
    )
  };
}

== defOfPSeqRemove (defOfPSeqRemove) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  defOfPSeqRemove {
    \schemaVar \term int iv;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(pseqRemove<E>(s, iv))

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(uSub, iv), \notFreeIn(uSub, s))
    \replacewith(
      \if (lt(iv, Z(0(#))) | leq(pseqLen<E>(s), iv))
          \then (s)
          \else (pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(Z(0(#)),
                                   sub(pseqLen<E>(s),
                                       Z(1(#))),
                                   \if (lt(uSub, iv))
                                       \then (pseqGet<E>(s,
                                                         uSub))
                                       \else (pseqGet<E>(s,
                                                         add(uSub,
                                                             Z(1(#)))))))
    )
  };
}

== defOfPSeqSub (defOfPSeqSub) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  defOfPSeqSub {
    \schemaVar \term int from;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> seq;
    \schemaVar \term int to;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(pseqSub<E>(seq, from, to))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, from),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, seq),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, to)
    )
    \replacewith(
      pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(from, to, pseqGet<E>(seq, uSub))
    )
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== defOfPSeqSwap (defOfPSeqSwap) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  defOfPSeqSwap {
    \schemaVar \term int iv;
    \schemaVar \term int jv;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(pseqSwap<E>(s, iv, jv))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, iv),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, jv),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, s)
    )
    \replacewith(
      pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(Z(0(#)),
                        pseqLen<E>(s),
                        \if (!(  leq(Z(0(#)), iv)
                               & leq(Z(0(#)), jv)
                               & lt(iv, pseqLen<E>(s))
                               & lt(jv, pseqLen<E>(s))))
                            \then (pseqGet<E>(s, uSub))
                            \else (\if (uSub = iv)
                                       \then (pseqGet<E>(s,
                                                         jv))
                                       \else (\if (  uSub
                                                   = jv)
                                                  \then (pseqGet<E>(s,
                                                                    iv))
                                                  \else (pseqGet<E>(s,
                                                                    uSub)))))
    )
  };
}

== defOfPSeqUpd (defOfPSeqUpd) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  defOfPSeqUpd {
    \schemaVar \term int idx;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> seq;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;
    \schemaVar \term E value;

    \find(pseqUpd<E>(seq, idx, value))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, idx),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, seq),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, value)
    )
    \replacewith(
      pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(Z(0(#)),
                        pseqLen<E>(seq),
                        \if (uSub = idx)
                            \then (value)
                            \else (pseqGet<E>(seq, uSub)))
    )
  };
}
