== defOfSeqNPermInv (defOfSeqNPermInv) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  defOfSeqNPermInv {
    \schemaVar \term Seq s;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(seqNPermInv(s))

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(uSub, s))
    \replacewith(
      seqDef{uSub;}(Z(0(#)),
                    seqLen(s),
                    seqIndexOf(s, uSub))
    )
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== defOfSeqRemove (defOfSeqRemove) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  defOfSeqRemove {
    \schemaVar \term int iv;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(seqRemove(s, iv))

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(uSub, iv), \notFreeIn(uSub, s))
    \replacewith(
      \if (lt(iv, Z(0(#))) | leq(seqLen(s), iv))
          \then (s)
          \else (seqDef{uSub;}(Z(0(#)),
                               sub(seqLen(s), Z(1(#))),
                               \if (lt(uSub, iv))
                                   \then (seqGet<any>(s,
                                                      uSub))
                                   \else (seqGet<any>(s,
                                                      add(uSub,
                                                          Z(1(#)))))))
    )
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== defOfSeqReverse (defOfSeqReverse) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  defOfSeqReverse {
    \schemaVar \term Seq seq;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(seqReverse(seq))

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(uSub, seq))
    \replacewith(
      seqDef{uSub;}(Z(0(#)),
                    seqLen(seq),
                    seqGet<any>(seq,
                                sub(sub(seqLen(seq),
                                        uSub),
                                    Z(1(#)))))
    )
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== defOfSeqSingleton (defOfSeqSingleton) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  defOfSeqSingleton {
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;
    \schemaVar \term any x;

    \find(seqSingleton(x))

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(uSub, x))
    \replacewith(seqDef{uSub;}(Z(0(#)), Z(1(#)), x))
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== defOfSeqSub (defOfSeqSub) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  defOfSeqSub {
    \schemaVar \term int from;
    \schemaVar \term Seq seq;
    \schemaVar \term int to;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(seqSub(seq, from, to))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, from),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, seq),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, to)
    )
    \replacewith(
      seqDef{uSub;}(from, to, seqGet<any>(seq, uSub))
    )
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== defOfSeqSwap (defOfSeqSwap) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  defOfSeqSwap {
    \schemaVar \term int iv;
    \schemaVar \term int jv;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(seqSwap(s, iv, jv))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, iv),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, jv),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, s)
    )
    \replacewith(
      seqDef{uSub;}(Z(0(#)),
                    seqLen(s),
                    \if (!(  leq(Z(0(#)), iv)
                           & leq(Z(0(#)), jv)
                           & lt(iv, seqLen(s))
                           & lt(jv, seqLen(s))))
                        \then (seqGet<any>(s, uSub))
                        \else (\if (uSub = iv)
                                   \then (seqGet<any>(s,
                                                      jv))
                                   \else (\if (uSub = jv)
                                              \then (seqGet<any>(s,
                                                                 iv))
                                              \else (seqGet<any>(s,
                                                                 uSub)))))
    )
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== defOfSeqUpd (defOfSeqUpd) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  defOfSeqUpd {
    \schemaVar \term int idx;
    \schemaVar \term Seq seq;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;
    \schemaVar \term any value;

    \find(seqUpd(seq, idx, value))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, idx),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, seq),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, value)
    )
    \replacewith(
      seqDef{uSub;}(Z(0(#)),
                    seqLen(seq),
                    \if (uSub = idx)
                        \then (value)
                        \else (seqGet<any>(seq, uSub)))
    )
  };
}

== defPSeq2Map (defPSeq2Map) =========================================
defPSeq2Map {
  \schemaVar \variables int ix;
  \schemaVar \term PSeq<V> s;

  \find(pseq2map<V>(s))

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(ix, s))
  \replacewith(
    mapForeach<int, V>{ix;}(\if (  leq(Z(0(#)), ix)
                                 & lt(ix,
                                      pseqLen<V>(s)))
                                \then (TRUE)
                                \else (FALSE),
                            pseqGet<V>(s, ix))
  )
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== def_wellOrderLeqInt (def_wellOrderLeqInt) =========================================
def_wellOrderLeqInt {
  \schemaVar \term int intT1;
  \schemaVar \term int intT2;

  \find(wellOrderLeqInt(intT1, intT2))

  \replacewith(
      geq(intT1, intT2) & lt(intT2, Z(0(#)))
    | leq(Z(0(#)), intT1)
    & leq(intT1, intT2)
  )
  \heuristics(simplify)
}

== definitionAllElementsOfArray (definitionAllElementsOfArray) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  definitionAllElementsOfArray {
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object array;
    \schemaVar \term Field f;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \variables int j;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;

    \find(
       allElementsOfArray(h,
                          array,
                          singleton<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(o,
                                                                                                f)))
    )

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(j, array),
      \notFreeIn(j, f),
      \notFreeIn(j, h),
      \notFreeIn(j, o)
    )
    \replacewith(
      infiniteUnion<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>{j;}(\if (  leq(Z(0(#)),
                                                                 j)
                                                           & lt(j,
                                                                length(array)))
                                                          \then (singleton<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(select<java.lang.Object>(h,
                                                                                                                                                                array,
                                                                                                                                                                arr(j)),
                                                                                                                                       f)))
                                                          \else (empty<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>))
    )
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}

== definitionOfNewObjectsIsomorphic (definitionOfNewObjectsIsomorphic) =========================================
definitionOfNewObjectsIsomorphic {
  \schemaVar \term Heap h1;
  \schemaVar \term Heap h2;
  \schemaVar \term Seq s1;
  \schemaVar \term Seq s2;

  \find(==> newObjectsIsomorphic(s1, h1, s2, h2))
  "New on Heap 1":
    \replacewith(==> newOnHeap(h1, s1));
  "New on Heap 2":
    \replacewith(==> newOnHeap(h2, s2));
  "Same Types":
    \replacewith(==> sameTypes(s1, s2));
  "Objects Isomorphic":
    \replacewith(==> objectsIsomorphic(s1, s1, s2, s2))
  \heuristics(simplify_enlarging)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== definitionOfNewOnHeap (definitionOfNewOnHeap) =========================================
definitionOfNewOnHeap {
  \schemaVar \term Heap h;
  \schemaVar \variables int i;
  \schemaVar \term Seq s;

  \find(==> newOnHeap(h, s))
  \varcond(\notFreeIn(i, h), \notFreeIn(i, s))
  \replacewith(
    ==>
     \forall i;
       (   leq(Z(0(#)), i) & lt(i, seqLen(s))
        ->   (     instance<java.lang.Object>(seqGet<any>(s,
                                                          i))
                 = TRUE
              ->   select<boolean>(h,
                                   seqGet<java.lang.Object>(s,
                                                            i),
                                   java.lang.Object::#$created)
                 = FALSE)
           & (     instance<Seq>(seqGet<any>(s, i))
                 = TRUE
              -> newOnHeap(h, seqGet<Seq>(s, i))))
  )
  \heuristics(comprehensions)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== definitionOfObjectIsomorphic (definitionOfObjectIsomorphic) =========================================
definitionOfObjectIsomorphic {
  \schemaVar \variables int i;
  \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o1;
  \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o2;
  \schemaVar \term Seq s1;
  \schemaVar \term Seq s2;

  \find(==> objectIsomorphic(s1, o1, s2, o2))
  \varcond(
    \notFreeIn(i, o1),
    \notFreeIn(i, o2),
    \notFreeIn(i, s1),
    \notFreeIn(i, s2)
  )
  \replacewith(
    ==>
     \forall i;
       (   leq(Z(0(#)), i) & lt(i, seqLen(s1))
        ->   (     instance<java.lang.Object>(seqGet<any>(s1,
                                                          i))
                 = TRUE
              -> (      seqGet<java.lang.Object>(s1, i)
                      = o1
                  <->   seqGet<java.lang.Object>(s2, i)
                      = o2))
           & (     instance<Seq>(seqGet<any>(s1, i))
                 = TRUE
              -> objectIsomorphic(seqGet<Seq>(s1, i),
                                  o1,
                                  seqGet<Seq>(s2, i),
                                  o2)))
  )
  \heuristics(comprehensions)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== definitionOfObjectsIsomorphic (definitionOfObjectsIsomorphic) =========================================
definitionOfObjectsIsomorphic {
  \schemaVar \variables int i;
  \schemaVar \term Seq s1;
  \schemaVar \term Seq s2;
  \schemaVar \term Seq t1;
  \schemaVar \term Seq t2;

  \find(==> objectsIsomorphic(s1, t1, s2, t2))
  \varcond(
    \notFreeIn(i, s1),
    \notFreeIn(i, s2),
    \notFreeIn(i, t1),
    \notFreeIn(i, t2)
  )
  \replacewith(
    ==>
     \forall i;
       (   leq(Z(0(#)), i) & lt(i, seqLen(t1))
        ->   (     instance<java.lang.Object>(seqGet<any>(t1,
                                                          i))
                 = TRUE
              -> objectIsomorphic(s1,
                                  seqGet<java.lang.Object>(t1,
                                                           i),
                                  s2,
                                  seqGet<java.lang.Object>(t2,
                                                           i)))
           & (     instance<Seq>(seqGet<any>(t1, i))
                 = TRUE
              -> objectsIsomorphic(s1,
                                   seqGet<Seq>(t1, i),
                                   s2,
                                   seqGet<Seq>(t2, i))))
  )
  \heuristics(comprehensions)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== definitionOfSameTypes (definitionOfSameTypes) =========================================
definitionOfSameTypes {
  \schemaVar \variables int i;
  \schemaVar \term Seq s1;
  \schemaVar \term Seq s2;

  \find(==> sameTypes(s1, s2))
  \varcond(\notFreeIn(i, s1), \notFreeIn(i, s2))
  \replacewith(
    ==>
       seqLen(s1) = seqLen(s2)
     & \forall i;
         (   leq(Z(0(#)), i) & lt(i, seqLen(s1))
          ->   sameType(seqGet<any>(s1, i),
                        seqGet<any>(s2, i))
             & (     instance<Seq>(seqGet<any>(s1, i))
                   = TRUE
                -> sameTypes(seqGet<Seq>(s1, i),
                             seqGet<Seq>(s2, i))))
  )
  \heuristics(comprehensions)
}

== deleteMergePoint (deleteMergePoint) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  deleteMergePoint {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           merge_point (#lhs);
           ... }\endmodality post
     )

      \replacewith(
        \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
      )
      \heuristics(merge_point, simplify_prog)
    };
}

== delete_unnecessary_cast (delete_unnecessary_cast) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  delete_unnecessary_cast {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program NonPrimitiveType #npit;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs = (#npit) #se;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\hasSort(#npit, G), \sub(\typeof(#se), G))
    "Normal Execution (#se instanceof #npit)":
      \replacewith(
        {#lhs:=#addCast(#se, #lhs)}
          \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
      )
      \add(#se = null | instance<G>(#se) = TRUE ==>)
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

== disjointAllFields (disjointAllFields) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  disjointAllFields {
    \schemaVar \term Field f;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s;

    \assumes(
         intersect<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(allFields(o),
                                                 s)
       = empty<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>
      ==>
    )
    \find(
       elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(o,
                                                                             f),
                                               s)
    )

    \replacewith(false)
    \heuristics(concrete)
  };
}

  };

== disjointArrayRanges (disjointArrayRanges) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  disjointArrayRanges {
    \schemaVar \term int lower1;
    \schemaVar \term int lower2;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o1;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o2;
    \schemaVar \term int upper1;
    \schemaVar \term int upper2;

    \find(
         intersect<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(arrayRange(o1,
                                                            lower1,
                                                            upper1),
                                                 arrayRange(o2,
                                                            lower2,
                                                            upper2))
       = empty<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>
    )

    \replacewith(
      !(  o1 = o2
        & leq(lower1, upper1)
        & leq(lower2, upper2)
        & (  leq(lower1, lower2) & leq(lower2, upper1)
           | leq(lower2, lower1)
           & leq(lower1, upper2)))
    )
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}

== disjointToElementOf (disjointToElementOf) =========================================
disjointToElementOf {
  \schemaVar \variables T av;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> t;

  \find(disjoint<T>(s, t))

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(av, s), \notFreeIn(av, t))
  \replacewith(
    \forall av;
      (!elementOf<T>(av, s) | !elementOf<T>(av, t))
  )
  \heuristics(semantics_blasting)
}

    div(add(divNum, mul(coef, divDenom)), divDenom)

  \heuristics(simplify_enlarging)

== divMinus (divMinus) =========================================
divMinus {
  \schemaVar \term int divDenom;
  \schemaVar \term int divNum;

  \find(div(neg(divNum), divDenom))

  \replacewith(
    \if (mul(div(divNum, divDenom), divDenom) = divNum)
        \then (neg(div(divNum, divDenom)))
        \else (\if (gt(divDenom, Z(0(#))))
                   \then (sub(neg(div(divNum, divDenom)),
                              Z(1(#))))
                   \else (add(neg(div(divNum, divDenom)),
                              Z(1(#)))))
  );
  \add(==> !divDenom = Z(0(#)))
}

          gt(divDenom, Z(0(#)))
        & leq(Z(0(#)), divNum)
        & lt(divNum, divDenom)
     -> div(divNum, divDenom) = Z(0(#))
    ==>
  )
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== divResZero2 (divResZero2) =========================================
divResZero2 {
  \schemaVar \term int divDenom;
  \schemaVar \term int divNum;

  \find(div(divNum, divDenom))

  \add(
          lt(divDenom, Z(0(#)))
        & leq(Z(0(#)), divNum)
        & lt(divNum, neg(divDenom))
     -> div(divNum, divDenom) = Z(0(#))
    ==>
  )
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== div_axiom (div_axiom) =========================================
div_axiom {
  \schemaVar \term int divDenom;
  \schemaVar \term int divNum;
  \schemaVar \skolemTerm int quotient;

  \find(div(divNum, divDenom))

  \varcond(
    \newDependingOn(quotient, divDenom),
    \newDependingOn(quotient, divNum)
  )
  \add(
       divDenom = Z(0(#))
     | div(divNum, divDenom) = quotient
     & leq(mul(quotient, divDenom), divNum)
     & \if (geq(divDenom, Z(0(#))))
           \then (geq(mul(quotient, divDenom),
                      add(add(Z(1(#)), divNum),
                          mul(Z(neglit(1(#))),
                              divDenom))))
           \else (geq(mul(quotient, divDenom),
                      add(add(Z(1(#)), divNum),
                          divDenom)))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(defOps_div, notHumanReadable)
}

== div_exists (div_exists) =========================================
div_exists {
  \schemaVar \variables int a;
  \schemaVar \variables int cnom;
  \schemaVar \term int divDenom;
  \schemaVar \term int divNum;
  \schemaVar \variables int qu;
  \schemaVar \variables int rm;

  \find(div(divNum, divDenom))

  \add(
     \forall cnom;
       (   !cnom = Z(0(#))
        -> \forall a;
             \exists qu;
               \exists rm;
                 (  a = add(mul(qu, cnom), rm)
                  & leq(Z(0(#)), rm)
                  & \if (geq(cnom, Z(0(#))))
                        \then (  geq(mul(qu, cnom),
                                     add(add(Z(1(#)),
                                             a),
                                         mul(Z(neglit(1(#))),
                                             cnom)))
                               & lt(rm, cnom))
                        \else (  geq(mul(qu, cnom),
                                     add(add(Z(1(#)),
                                             a),
                                         cnom))
                               & lt(rm, neg(cnom)))))
    ==>
  )
}

== div_unique1 (div_unique1) =========================================
div_unique1 {
  \schemaVar \variables int a;
  \schemaVar \variables int cnom;
  \schemaVar \term int divDenom;
  \schemaVar \term int divNum;
  \schemaVar \variables int x;
  \schemaVar \variables int y;

  \find(div(divNum, divDenom))

  \add(
     \forall a;
       \forall cnom;
         \forall x;
           \forall y;
             (     gt(cnom, Z(0(#)))
                 & leq(mul(x, cnom), a)
                 & leq(mul(y, cnom), a)
                 & geq(mul(x, cnom),
                       sub(add(Z(1(#)), a), cnom))
                 & geq(mul(y, cnom),
                       sub(add(Z(1(#)), a), cnom))
              -> x = y)
    ==>
  )
}

== divide_equation (divide_equation) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  divide_equation {
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcd;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdLeft;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdRight;

    \find(elimGcdLeft = elimGcdRight)

    \replacewith(
      \if (  geq(elimGcd, Z(1(#)))
           & mod(elimGcdLeft, elimGcd) = Z(0(#))
           & leq(mod(elimGcdRight, elimGcd),
                 add(Z(neglit(1(#))), elimGcd)))
          \then (  mod(elimGcdRight, elimGcd) = Z(0(#))
                 &   div(elimGcdLeft, elimGcd)
                   = div(elimGcdRight, elimGcd))
          \else (elimGcdLeft = elimGcdRight)
    )
  };
}

== divide_geq (divide_geq) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  divide_geq {
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcd;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdLeft;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdRight;

    \find(geq(elimGcdLeft, elimGcdRight))

    \replacewith(
      \if (  geq(elimGcd, Z(1(#)))
           & mod(elimGcdLeft, elimGcd) = Z(0(#))
           & leq(mod(elimGcdRight, elimGcd),
                 add(Z(neglit(1(#))), elimGcd)))
          \then (geq(div(elimGcdLeft, elimGcd),
                     add(Z(1(#)),
                         div(add(Z(neglit(1(#))),
                                 elimGcdRight),
                             elimGcd))))
          \else (geq(elimGcdLeft, elimGcdRight))
    )
  };
}

== doWhileUnwind (doWhileUnwind) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  doWhileUnwind {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e;
    \schemaVar \program Label #innerLabel;
    \schemaVar \program Label #outerLabel;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #s;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           do #s
           while (#e);
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(
      \newLabel (#innerLabel),
      \newLabel (#outerLabel)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #unwindLoop(#innerLabel,
          #outerLabel,
          do #s
          while (#e);)
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

  \schemaVar \formula  c;
  \schemaVar \formula  d;

  \find(b -> c -> d ==>)
  \replacewith(==> b);
  \replacewith(==> c);
  \replacewith(d ==>)
  \heuristics(beta)
}

== dropEffectlessStores (dropEffectlessStores) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {

    \schemaVar \term Field f;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term Heap result;

== dynamic_type_for_null (dynamic_type_for_null) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  dynamic_type_for_null {

    \find(exactInstance<G>(null))

    \varcond(\not\same(G, Null))
    \replacewith(FALSE)
    \heuristics(concrete)

== elementOfArrayRange (elementOfArrayRange) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  elementOfArrayRange {
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \term Pair<java.lang.Object,Field> l;
    \schemaVar \term int lower;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o2;
    \schemaVar \term int upper;

    \find(
       elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(l,
                                               arrayRange(o2,
                                                          lower,
                                                          upper))
    )

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(iv, l),
      \notFreeIn(iv, lower),
      \notFreeIn(iv, upper)
    )
    \replacewith(
        first<java.lang.Object, Field>(l) = o2
      & \exists iv;
          (  second<java.lang.Object, Field>(l) = arr(iv)
           & leq(lower, iv)
           & leq(iv, upper))
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_enlarging)
  };
}

== elementOfArrayRangeConcrete (elementOfArrayRangeConcrete) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  elementOfArrayRangeConcrete {

    \schemaVar \term int lower;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o2;
    \schemaVar \term int upper;

    \find(
       elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(o,
                                                                             arr(idx)),
                                               arrayRange(o2,
                                                          lower,
                                                          upper))
    )

    \replacewith(
      o = o2 & leq(lower, idx) & leq(idx, upper)
    )
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}

== elementOfSubsetOfUnion1 (elementOfSubsetOfUnion1) =========================================

  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s2;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s3;

  \assumes(
    subset<T>(s, union<T>(s2, s3))
    ==> elementOf<T>(e, s2)

  \add(
         elementOf<T>(e, s)
     <-> elementOf<T>(e, intersect<T>(s, s3))
    ==>
  )

== elimGcdEq (elimGcdEq) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  elimGcdEq {
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcd;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdLeft;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdLeftDiv;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdRight;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdRightDiv;

    \find(elimGcdLeft = elimGcdRight)

    \replacewith(
      \if (  mul(elimGcdLeftDiv, elimGcd) = elimGcdLeft
           & leq(add(elimGcdRight,
                     mul(mul(elimGcd, Z(neglit(1(#)))),
                         elimGcdRightDiv)),
                 add(Z(neglit(1(#))), elimGcd))
           & geq(add(elimGcdRight,
                     mul(mul(elimGcd, Z(neglit(1(#)))),
                         elimGcdRightDiv)),
                 Z(0(#))))
          \then (    add(elimGcdRight,
                         mul(mul(elimGcd,
                                 Z(neglit(1(#)))),
                             elimGcdRightDiv))
                   = Z(0(#))
                 & elimGcdLeftDiv = elimGcdRightDiv)
          \else (elimGcdLeft = elimGcdRight)
    )
    \heuristics(notHumanReadable, polySimp_pullOutGcd)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== elimGcdGeq (elimGcdGeq) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  elimGcdGeq {
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcd;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdLeft;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdLeftDiv;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdRight;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdRightDiv;

    \find(geq(elimGcdLeft, elimGcdRight))

    \replacewith(
      \if (  geq(add(add(add(add(sub(elimGcd, Z(1(#))),
                                 mul(mul(elimGcd,
                                         Z(neglit(1(#)))),
                                     elimGcdRightDiv)),
                             elimGcdRight),
                         mul(elimGcdLeftDiv, elimGcd)),
                     mul(elimGcdLeft, Z(neglit(1(#))))),
                 Z(0(#)))
           & leq(add(add(add(mul(mul(elimGcd,
                                     Z(neglit(1(#)))),
                                 elimGcdRightDiv),
                             elimGcdRight),
                         mul(elimGcdLeftDiv, elimGcd)),
                     mul(elimGcdLeft, Z(neglit(1(#))))),
                 Z(0(#))))
          \then (geq(elimGcdLeftDiv, elimGcdRightDiv))
          \else (geq(elimGcdLeft, elimGcdRight))
    )
    \heuristics(
      inEqSimp_pullOutGcd,
      inEqSimp_pullOutGcd_geq,
      notHumanReadable)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== elimGcdGeq_antec (elimGcdGeq_antec) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  elimGcdGeq_antec {
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcd;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdLeft;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdLeftDiv;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdRight;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdRightDiv;

    \find(geq(elimGcdLeft, elimGcdRight) ==>)
    \replacewith(
         leq(elimGcd, Z(0(#)))
       | leq(add(add(add(add(elimGcd,
                             mul(mul(elimGcd,
                                     Z(neglit(1(#)))),
                                 elimGcdRightDiv)),
                         elimGcdRight),
                     mul(elimGcdLeftDiv, elimGcd)),
                 mul(elimGcdLeft, Z(neglit(1(#))))),
             Z(0(#)))
       | geq(elimGcdLeftDiv, elimGcdRightDiv)
      ==>
    )
    \heuristics(
      inEqSimp_pullOutGcd,
      inEqSimp_pullOutGcd_antec,
      inEqSimp_pullOutGcd_geq,
      notHumanReadable)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== elimGcdLeq (elimGcdLeq) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  elimGcdLeq {
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcd;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdLeft;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdLeftDiv;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdRight;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdRightDiv;

    \find(leq(elimGcdLeft, elimGcdRight))

    \replacewith(
      \if (  leq(add(add(add(add(sub(Z(1(#)), elimGcd),
                                 mul(mul(elimGcd,
                                         Z(neglit(1(#)))),
                                     elimGcdRightDiv)),
                             elimGcdRight),
                         mul(elimGcdLeftDiv, elimGcd)),
                     mul(elimGcdLeft, Z(neglit(1(#))))),
                 Z(0(#)))
           & geq(add(add(add(mul(mul(elimGcd,
                                     Z(neglit(1(#)))),
                                 elimGcdRightDiv),
                             elimGcdRight),
                         mul(elimGcdLeftDiv, elimGcd)),
                     mul(elimGcdLeft, Z(neglit(1(#))))),
                 Z(0(#))))
          \then (leq(elimGcdLeftDiv, elimGcdRightDiv))
          \else (leq(elimGcdLeft, elimGcdRight))
    )
    \heuristics(
      inEqSimp_pullOutGcd,
      inEqSimp_pullOutGcd_leq,
      notHumanReadable)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== elimGcdLeq_antec (elimGcdLeq_antec) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  elimGcdLeq_antec {
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcd;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdLeft;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdLeftDiv;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdRight;
    \schemaVar \term int elimGcdRightDiv;

    \find(leq(elimGcdLeft, elimGcdRight) ==>)
    \replacewith(
         leq(elimGcd, Z(0(#)))

                         elimGcdRight),
                     mul(elimGcdLeftDiv, elimGcd)),

      inEqSimp_pullOutGcd,

      inEqSimp_pullOutGcd_leq,
      notHumanReadable)
  };
}

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          for (; #guard; ) #s
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "elim_double_block"
  };
}

== elim_double_block_8 (elim_double_block) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  elim_double_block_8 {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #s;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           {
             do #s
             while (#e);
           }
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          do #s
          while (#e);
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "elim_double_block"
  };

  )

  \schemaVar \term Set<G> locSetTermLeft;
  \schemaVar \term Set<G> locSetTermRight;
  \schemaVar \variables Set<G> locVar;

  \find(
     \exists locVar;
       (  subset<G>(locVar, locSetTermRight)
        & subset<G>(locSetTermLeft, locVar))
  )

  \varcond(
    \notFreeIn(locVar, locSetTermLeft),
    \notFreeIn(locVar, locSetTermRight)
  )
  \replacewith(
    subset<G>(locSetTermLeft, locSetTermRight)
  )
  \heuristics(elimQuantifier)

elim_forall_leq {
  \schemaVar \variables int INTVar;
  \schemaVar \term int intTermLeft;
  \schemaVar \term int intTermRight;

  \find(
     \forall INTVar;
       (  leq(INTVar, intTermLeft)
        | geq(INTVar, intTermRight))
  )

  \varcond(
    \notFreeIn(INTVar, intTermLeft),
    \notFreeIn(INTVar, intTermRight)
  )
  \replacewith(
    leq(intTermRight, add(intTermLeft, Z(1(#))))
  )
  \heuristics(elimQuantifier)
}

== elim_forall_superOfAll_and_phi (elim_forall_superOfAll_and_phi) =========================================
elim_forall_superOfAll_and_phi {
  \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> locSetTerm;
  \schemaVar \variables Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> locVar;
  \schemaVar \formula  phi;

  \find(
     \forall locVar;
       (  subset<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(locVar,
                                               locSetTerm)
        & phi)
  )

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(locVar, locSetTerm))
  \replacewith(
    locSetTerm = allLocs & \forall locVar; phi
  )
  \heuristics(elimQuantifier)
}

== emptyEqualsSingleton (emptyEqualsSingleton) =========================================
emptyEqualsSingleton {
  \schemaVar \term T a;

  \find(empty<T> = singleton<T>(a))

  \replacewith(false)
  \heuristics(concrete)
}

== emptyModality (emptyModality) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  emptyModality {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {box, diamond} #normal;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(\modality{#normal}{}\endmodality post)

    \replacewith(post)
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== emptyModalityBoxTransaction (emptyModality) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  emptyModalityBoxTransaction {
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(\box_transaction{}\endmodality post)

    "Unbalanced Transaction":
      \replacewith(true)
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "emptyModality"
  };
}

== emptyStatement (emptyStatement) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  emptyStatement {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           ;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog, simplify_prog_subset)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== endsWith (endsWith) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  endsWith {
    \schemaVar \term Seq searchStr;
    \schemaVar \term Seq sourceStr;

    \find(clEndsWith(sourceStr, searchStr))

    \replacewith(
      \if (gt(seqLen(searchStr), seqLen(sourceStr)))
          \then (false)
          \else (  seqSub(sourceStr,
                          sub(seqLen(sourceStr),
                              seqLen(searchStr)),
                          seqLen(sourceStr))
                 = searchStr)
    )
    \heuristics(defOpsStartsEndsWith)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== enhancedfor_iterable (enhancedfor) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  enhancedfor_iterable {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #id;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #stm;
    \schemaVar \program Type #ty;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           for (#ty #id : #e) #stm
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #enhancedforElim(for (#ty #id : #e) #stm)
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "enhancedfor"
  };
}

== eqPSeqConcat (eqPSeqConcat) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  eqPSeqConcat {
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s1;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s2;

    \find(s = pseqConcat<E>(s1, s2))

    \replacewith(
          pseqLen<E>(s)
        = add(pseqLen<E>(s1), pseqLen<E>(s2))
      & pseqSub<E>(s, Z(0(#)), pseqLen<E>(s1)) = s1
      & pseqSub<E>(s, pseqLen<E>(s1), pseqLen<E>(s)) = s2
    )
  };
}

== eqPSeqConcat2 (eqPSeqConcat2) =========================================

    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s2;

    \find(pseqConcat<E>(s, s1) = pseqConcat<E>(s, s2))

    \replacewith(s1 = s2)
    \heuristics(seqSimplify)
  };
}

== eqPSeqConcat2EQ (eqPSeqConcat2EQ) =========================================

    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s1;

    \assumes(pseqConcat<E>(s, s2) = EQ ==>)
    \find(pseqConcat<E>(s, s1) = EQ)

    \replacewith(s1 = s2)
    \heuristics(no_self_application, seqSimplify)
  };
}

== eqPSeqDef (eqPSeqDef) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  eqPSeqDef {
    \schemaVar \term E a;
    \schemaVar \variables int i;
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \term int l;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s;
    \schemaVar \term int u;

    \find(s = pseqDef<E>{i;}(l, u, a))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(iv, a),
      \notFreeIn(iv, l),
      \notFreeIn(iv, s),
      \notFreeIn(iv, u)
    )
    \replacewith(
          pseqLen<E>(s)
        = pseqLen<E>(pseqDef<E>{i;}(l, u, a))
      & \forall iv;
          (   leq(Z(0(#)), iv) & lt(iv, pseqLen<E>(s))
           ->   pseqGet<E>(s, iv)
              = pseqGet<E>(pseqDef<E>{i;}(l, u, a), iv))
    )
  };
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== eqSamePSeq (eqSamePSeq) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  eqSamePSeq {
    \schemaVar \term int from;
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> seq;
    \schemaVar \term int to;

    \find(pseqSub<E>(seq, from, to) = seq)

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(iv, from), \notFreeIn(iv, seq))
    \replacewith(
        from = Z(0(#)) & pseqLen<E>(seq) = to
      | leq(to, from)
      & pseqLen<E>(seq) = Z(0(#))
      | pseqLen<E>(seq) = sub(to, from)
      & \forall iv;
          (   leq(Z(0(#)), iv) & lt(iv, pseqLen<E>(seq))
           ->   pseqGet<E>(seq, iv)
              = pseqGet<E>(seq, add(iv, from)))
    )
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== eqSameSeq (eqSameSeq) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  eqSameSeq {
    \schemaVar \term int from;
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \term Seq seq;
    \schemaVar \term int to;

    \find(seqSub(seq, from, to) = seq)

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(iv, from), \notFreeIn(iv, seq))
    \replacewith(
        from = Z(0(#)) & seqLen(seq) = to
      | leq(to, from)
      & seqLen(seq) = Z(0(#))
      | seqLen(seq) = sub(to, from)
      & \forall iv;
          (   leq(Z(0(#)), iv) & lt(iv, seqLen(seq))
           ->   seqGet<any>(seq, iv)
              = seqGet<any>(seq, add(iv, from)))
    )
  };
}

    \find(s = s2)

      seqLen(s) = Z(1(#)) & seqGet<any>(s, Z(0(#))) = x
    )
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== eqSymm (eqSymm) =========================================
eqSymm {
  \schemaVar \term G commEqLeft;
  \schemaVar \term H commEqRight;

  \find(commEqLeft = commEqRight)

  \replacewith(commEqRight = commEqLeft)
  \heuristics(order_terms)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== eqTermCut (eqTermCut) =========================================
eqTermCut {
  \schemaVar \term G s;
  \schemaVar \term G t;

  \find(t)

  "Assume #t  = #s":
    \add(t = s ==>);
  "Assume #t != #s":
    \add(!t = s ==>)
}

== eq_add_iff1 (eq_add_iff1) =========================================
eq_add_iff1 {
  \schemaVar \term int i0;
  \schemaVar \term int i1;
  \schemaVar \term int i2;
  \schemaVar \term int i3;
  \schemaVar \term int i4;

  \find(add(mul(i0, i1), i2) = add(mul(i3, i1), i4))

  \replacewith(add(mul(sub(i0, i3), i1), i2) = i4)
}

== eq_add_iff2 (eq_add_iff2) =========================================
eq_add_iff2 {
  \schemaVar \term int i0;
  \schemaVar \term int i1;
  \schemaVar \term int i2;
  \schemaVar \term int i3;
  \schemaVar \term int i4;

  \find(add(mul(i0, i1), i2) = add(mul(i3, i1), i4))

  \replacewith(i2 = add(mul(sub(i3, i0), i1), i4))
}

== equal_bprod1 (equal_bprod_same_index) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  equal_bprod1 {
    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i1;
    \schemaVar \term int t1;
    \schemaVar \term int t2;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub1;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub2;

    \find(
      ==>
         bprod{uSub1;}(i0, i1, t1)
       = bprod{uSub2;}(i0, i1, t2)
    )
    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, t2),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, i0),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, i1),
      \notFreeIn(uSub2, t1)
    )
    \add(
      ==>
       \forall uSub1;
         (   geq(uSub1, i0) & lt(uSub1, i1)
          -> t1 = {\subst uSub2;uSub1}t2)
    )
    \heuristics(comprehensions)
    \displayname "equal_bprod_same_index"
  };
}

== equal_bprod5 (equal_bprod) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  equal_bprod5 {

    \schemaVar \term int i2;

== equalityToElementOf (equalityToElementOf) =========================================
equalityToElementOf {
  \schemaVar \variables T av;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> t;

  \find(s = t)

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(av, s), \notFreeIn(av, t))
  \replacewith(
    \forall av;
      (elementOf<T>(av, s) <-> elementOf<T>(av, t))
  )
  \heuristics(semantics_blasting)

== equalityToElementOfRight (equalityToElementOfRight) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  equalityToElementOfRight {
    \schemaVar \variables Field fv;
    \schemaVar \variables java.lang.Object ov;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s2;

    \find(==> s = s2)
    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(fv, s),
      \notFreeIn(fv, s2),
      \notFreeIn(ov, s),
      \notFreeIn(ov, s2)
    )
    \replacewith(
      ==>
       \forall ov;
         \forall fv;
           (    elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(ov,
                                                                                      fv),
                                                        s)
            <-> elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(ov,
                                                                                      fv),
                                                        s2))
    )
    \heuristics(locSetEqualityBlastingRight)
  };
}

== equalityToPSeqGetAndPSeqLen (equalityToPSeqGetAndPSeqLen) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  equalityToPSeqGetAndPSeqLen {
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> left;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> right;

    \find(left = right)

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(iv, left), \notFreeIn(iv, right))
    \replacewith(
        pseqLen<E>(left) = pseqLen<E>(right)
      & \forall iv;
          (   leq(Z(0(#)), iv) & lt(iv, pseqLen<E>(left))
           ->   pseqGet<E>(left, iv)
              = pseqGet<E>(right, iv))
    )
    \heuristics(defOpsSeqEquality)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== equalityToPSeqGetAndPSeqLenLeft (equalityToPSeqGetAndPSeqLenLeft) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  equalityToPSeqGetAndPSeqLenLeft {
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s2;

    \find(s = s2 ==>)
    \varcond(\notFreeIn(iv, s), \notFreeIn(iv, s2))
    \add(
         pseqLen<E>(s) = pseqLen<E>(s2)
       & \forall iv;
           (   leq(Z(0(#)), iv) & lt(iv, pseqLen<E>(s))
            -> pseqGet<E>(s, iv) = pseqGet<E>(s2, iv))
      ==>
    )
    \heuristics(seqEqExpandAntec)
  };
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== equalityToSelect (equalityToSelect) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  equalityToSelect {
    \schemaVar \variables Field fv;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h2;
    \schemaVar \variables java.lang.Object ov;

    \find(h = h2)

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(fv, h),
      \notFreeIn(fv, h2),
      \notFreeIn(ov, h),
      \notFreeIn(ov, h2)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \forall ov;
        \forall fv;
            select<any>(h, ov, fv)
          = select<any>(h2, ov, fv)
    )
    \heuristics(semantics_blasting)
  };
}

    \schemaVar \term Seq right;

        seqLen(left) = seqLen(right)

== equality_comparison_double (equality comparison) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  equality_comparison_double {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program JavaDoubleExpression #seDouble0;
    \schemaVar \program JavaDoubleExpression #seDouble1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs = #seDouble0 == #seDouble1;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      {#lhs:=\if (eqDouble(#seDouble0, #seDouble1))
                 \then (TRUE)
                 \else (FALSE)}
        \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "equality comparison"
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== equality_comparison_new (equality comparison) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  equality_comparison_new {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpressionNonFloatDouble #senf0;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpressionNonFloatDouble #senf1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs = #senf0 == #senf1;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \if (!#senf0 = #senf1)
          \then (\modality{#allmodal}{ ..
                     #lhs = false;
                   ... }\endmodality post)
          \else (\modality{#allmodal}{ ..
                     #lhs = true;
                   ... }\endmodality post)
    )
    \heuristics(obsolete, simplify_prog, split_if)
    \displayname "equality comparison"
  };
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== equivAllRight (equivAllRight) =========================================
equivAllRight {
  \schemaVar \formula  b;
  \schemaVar \formula  c;
  \schemaVar \variables G e2;
  \schemaVar \variables G u;

  \find(==> \forall u; b <-> \forall e2; c)
  \varcond(\notFreeIn(e2, b), \notFreeIn(u, c))
  \add(==> \forall u; (b <-> {\subst e2;u}c))
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== equiv_left (equiv_left) =========================================
equiv_left {
  \schemaVar \formula  b;
  \schemaVar \formula  c;

  \find(b <-> c ==>)
  \replacewith(b, c ==>);
  \replacewith(==> b, c)
  \heuristics(beta)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== equiv_right (equiv_right) =========================================
equiv_right {
  \schemaVar \formula  b;
  \schemaVar \formula  c;

  \find(==> b <-> c)
  "Case '->'":
    \replacewith(b ==> c);
  "Case '<-'":
    \replacewith(c ==> b)
  \heuristics(beta)
}

== eval_array_this_access (eval_array_access) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  eval_array_this_access {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program NonSimpleExpression #nse;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se0;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           this[#nse] = #se0;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\newTypeOf(#v0, #nse))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #typeof(#nse) #v0 = #nse;
          this[#v0] = #se0;
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog, simplify_prog_subset)
    \displayname "eval_array_access"
  };
}

== eval_order_iterated_assignments_10_0 (eval_order_iterated_assignments) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  eval_order_iterated_assignments_10_0 {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e0;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e1;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs0;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs0 = #e0[#e] |= #e1;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\newTypeOf(#v0, #e0), \newTypeOf(#v1, #e))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #typeof(#e0) #v0 = #e0;
          #typeof(#e) #v1 = #e;

  eval_order_iterated_assignments_9_1 {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #attribute;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e0;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs0;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs0 = #e0.#attribute &= #e;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\newTypeOf(#v0, #e0))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #typeof(#e0) #v0 = #e0;
          #v0.#attribute =
            (#typeof(#attribute)) (#v0.#attribute & #e);
          #lhs0 = #v0.#attribute;
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "eval_order_iterated_assignments"
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== exLeft (exLeft) =========================================
exLeft {
  \schemaVar \formula  b;
  \schemaVar \skolemTerm G sk;
  \schemaVar \variables G u;

  \find(\exists u; b ==>)
  \varcond(\newDependingOn(sk, b))
  \replacewith({\subst u;sk}b ==>)
  \heuristics(delta)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== exRight (exRight) =========================================
exRight {
  \schemaVar \formula  b;
  \schemaVar \term G t;
  \schemaVar \variables G u;

  \find(==> \exists u; b)
  \add(==> {\subst u;t}b)
  \heuristics(gamma)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== exRightHide (exRightHide) =========================================
exRightHide {
  \schemaVar \formula  b;
  \schemaVar \term G t;
  \schemaVar \variables G u;

  \find(==> \exists u; b)
  \replacewith(==> {\subst u;t}b)
  \addrules(
    insert_hidden {
      \add(==> \exists u; b)
    }
  )
  \heuristics(gamma_destructive)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== ex_bool (ex_bool) =========================================
ex_bool {
  \schemaVar \formula  c;
  \schemaVar \variables boolean x;

  \find(\exists x; c)

  \replacewith({\subst x;FALSE}c | {\subst x;TRUE}c)
  \heuristics(boolean_cases)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== ex_pull_out0 (ex_pull_out0) =========================================
ex_pull_out0 {
  \schemaVar \formula  b;
  \schemaVar \formula  c;
  \schemaVar \variables G u;

  \find(\exists u; b & c)

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(u, c))
  \replacewith(\exists u; (b & c))
  \heuristics(pullOutQuantifierEx)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== ex_pull_out1 (ex_pull_out1) =========================================
ex_pull_out1 {
  \schemaVar \formula  b;
  \schemaVar \formula  c;
  \schemaVar \variables G u;

  \find(c & \exists u; b)

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(u, c))
  \replacewith(\exists u; (c & b))
  \heuristics(pullOutQuantifierEx)
}

ex_pull_out2 {
  \schemaVar \formula  b;
  \schemaVar \formula  c;
  \schemaVar \variables G u;

  \find(\exists u; b | c)

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(u, c))
  \replacewith(\exists u; (b | c))
  \heuristics(pullOutQuantifierEx)
}

  \schemaVar \variables G u;

  \find(c | \exists u; b)

  \replacewith(\exists u; (c | b))

== ex_pull_out4 (ex_pull_out4) =========================================
ex_pull_out4 {
  \schemaVar \formula  b;
  \schemaVar \formula  c;
  \schemaVar \variables G u;
  \schemaVar \variables G u2;

  \find(\exists u; b | \exists u2; c)

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(u, c))
  \replacewith(\exists u; (b | {\subst u2;u}c))
  \heuristics(
    pullOutQuantifierEx,
    pullOutQuantifierUnifying)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== ex_unused (ex_unused) =========================================
ex_unused {
  \schemaVar \formula  b;
  \schemaVar \variables G u;

  \find(\exists u; b)

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(u, b))
  \replacewith(b)
  \heuristics(elimQuantifier)
}

== exact_instance_definition_boolean (exact_instance_definition_boolean) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  exact_instance_definition_boolean {
    \schemaVar \term boolean bool;
    \schemaVar \variables boolean bv;

    \find(exactInstance<boolean>(bool) = TRUE)

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(bv, bool))
    \replacewith(\exists bv; bool = bv)
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== exact_instance_definition_int (exact_instance_definition_int) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  exact_instance_definition_int {
    \schemaVar \term int idx0;
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;

    \find(exactInstance<int>(idx0) = TRUE)

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(iv, idx0))
    \replacewith(\exists iv; idx0 = iv)
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== exact_instance_definition_null (exact_instance_definition_null) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  exact_instance_definition_null {
    \schemaVar \term boolean bool;
    \schemaVar \variables boolean bv;
    \schemaVar \term J obj;

    \find(exactInstance<Null>(obj) = TRUE)

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(bv, bool))
    \replacewith(obj = null)
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== exact_instance_for_interfaces_or_abstract_classes (interfaces or abstract classes have no exact instances) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  exact_instance_for_interfaces_or_abstract_classes {
    \schemaVar \term J obj;

    \find(exactInstance<G>(obj))

    \varcond(\isAbstractOrInterface (G))
    \replacewith(FALSE)
    \heuristics(simplify)
    \displayname "interfaces or abstract classes have no exact instances"
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== exact_instance_known_dynamic_type (exact_instance_known_dynamic_type) =========================================
exact_instance_known_dynamic_type {
  \schemaVar \term any a;

  \assumes(exactInstance<G>(a) = TRUE ==>)
  \find(exactInstance<H>(a))

  \varcond(\not\same(G, H))
  \replacewith(FALSE)
  \heuristics(evaluate_instanceof, simplify)
}

== execBreak (execBreak) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  execBreak {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Ccatch #cs;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #slist;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #slist1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           exec {
             break;
             #slist
           } ccatch (\Break) {
             #slist1
           }#cs
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          {
            #slist1
          }
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #slist;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #slist1;
    \schemaVar \program Type #t;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           exec {
             throw #se;
             #slist
           } ccatch (#t #v0) {
             #slist1
           }
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          if (#se == null) {
            exec {
              throw new java.lang.NullPointerException();
            } ccatch (#t #v0) {
              #slist1
            }
          } else if (#se instanceof #t) {
            #t #v0;
            #v0 = (#t) #se;
            #slist1
          } else {
            throw #se;
          }
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== execMultipleCatchThrow (execCatchThrow) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  execMultipleCatchThrow {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Ccatch #cs;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #slist;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #slist1;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #slist3;
    \schemaVar \program Type #t;
    \schemaVar \program Type #t2;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           exec {
             throw #se;
             #slist
           } ccatch (#t #v0) {
             #slist1
           } ccatch (#t2 #v1) {
             #slist3
           }#cs
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          if (#se == null) {
            exec {
              throw new java.lang.NullPointerException();
            } ccatch (#t #v0) {
              #slist1
            } ccatch (#t2 #v1) {
              #slist3
            }#cs
          } else if (#se instanceof #t) {
            #t #v0;
            #v0 = (#t) #se;
            #slist1
          } else {
            exec {
              throw #se;
            } ccatch (#t2 #v1) {
              #slist3
            }#cs
          }
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "execCatchThrow"
  };
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== expIsInfinite (expIsInfinite) =========================================
expIsInfinite {
  \schemaVar \term double arg;

  \find(expDouble(arg))

  \add(
          doubleIsInfinite(arg)
        & gtDouble(arg, DFP(0(#)))
     ->   doubleIsInfinite(expDouble(arg))
        & gtDouble(expDouble(arg), DFP(0(#)))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== expIsNaN (expIsNaN) =========================================
expIsNaN {
  \schemaVar \term double arg;

  \find(expDouble(arg))

  \add(
    doubleIsNaN(arg) -> doubleIsNaN(expDouble(arg))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== expIsZero (expIsZero) =========================================
expIsZero {
  \schemaVar \term double arg;

  \find(expDouble(arg))

  \add(
          doubleIsInfinite(arg)
        & ltDouble(arg, DFP(0(#)))
     -> expDouble(arg) = DFP(0(#))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}

== forInitUnfold (forInitUnfold) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  forInitUnfold {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program ForUpdates #forupdates;
    \schemaVar \program Guard #guard;
    \schemaVar \program LoopInit #loopInit;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #s;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           for (#loopInit; #guard; #forupdates) #s
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          {
            #forInitUnfoldTransformer(#loopInit)
            for (; #guard; #forupdates) #s
          }
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(loop_expand)
  };
}

== for_to_while (for_to_while) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  for_to_while {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program ForLoop #forloop;
    \schemaVar \program Label #innerLabel;
    \schemaVar \program Label #outerLabel;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #forloop
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(
      \newLabel (#innerLabel),
      \newLabel (#outerLabel)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #forToWhile(#innerLabel, #outerLabel, #forloop)
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

== geq_add (geq_add) =========================================
geq_add {
  \schemaVar \term int i0;
  \schemaVar \term int i1;
  \schemaVar \variables int j2;

  \find(==> geq(i0, i1))
  \varcond(\notFreeIn(j2, i0), \notFreeIn(j2, i1))
  \replacewith(
    ==> \exists j2; geq(add(i0, j2), add(i1, j2))
  )
}

== getAnyOfArray2seq (getAnyOfArray2seq) =========================================

    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object a;

    \schemaVar \term int idx;

  };

== getJavaCardTransient (getJavaCardTransient) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & JavaCard:on) {
  getJavaCardTransient {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program MethodName [name = nativeKeYGetTransient] #getTransient;
    \schemaVar \program NonPrimitiveType [name = javacard.framework.JCSystem] #jcsystemType;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
      ==>
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs
           =
           #jcsystemType.#getTransient(#se)@#jcsystemType;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )
    "Normal Execution":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
         {#lhs:=select<int>(heap,
                            #se,
                            java.lang.Object::#$transient)}
           \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
      );
    "#se is not null":
      \replacewith(==> !#se = null)
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

== getOfNPermInv (getOfNPermInv) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  getOfNPermInv {
    \schemaVar \term int i3;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm int jsk;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s1;

    \find(seqGet<int>(seqNPermInv(s1), i3))

    \varcond(\newDependingOn(jsk, i3))
    \replacewith(jsk)
    \add(
         seqGet<int>(s1, jsk) = i3
       & leq(Z(0(#)), jsk)
       & lt(jsk, seqLen(s1))
      ==>
    );
    \add(
      ==>
         leq(Z(0(#)), i3)
       & lt(i3, seqLen(s1))
       & seqNPerm(s1)
    )
    \heuristics(seqSimplify)
  };
}

== getOfPSeqDef (getOfPSeqDef) =========================================

  getOfPSeqDef {
    \schemaVar \term int from;
    \schemaVar \term int idx;
    \schemaVar \term E t;
    \schemaVar \term int to;

    \find(
      pseqGet<E>(pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(from, to, t), idx)
    )

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, from),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, to)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \if (leq(Z(0(#)), idx) & lt(idx, sub(to, from)))
          \then ({\subst uSub;add(idx, from)}t)
          \else (pseqGetOutside<E>)
    )
    \heuristics(seqSimplify)
  };

    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \assumes(pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(from, to, t) = EQ ==>)
    \find(pseqGet<E>(EQ, idx))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, from),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, to)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \if (leq(Z(0(#)), idx) & lt(idx, sub(to, from)))
          \then ({\subst uSub;add(idx, from)}t)
          \else (pseqGetOutside<E>)
    )
    \heuristics(seqSimplifyEnlarging)
    \displayname "getOfSeqDef"
  };
}

== getOfRemoveAny (getOfRemoveAny) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  getOfRemoveAny {
    \schemaVar \term int i2;
    \schemaVar \term int i3;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s1;

    \find(seqGet<alpha>(seqRemove(s1, i2), i3))

    \replacewith(
      \if (lt(i2, Z(0(#))) | leq(seqLen(s1), i2))
          \then (seqGet<alpha>(s1, i3))
          \else (\if (lt(i3, i2))
                     \then (seqGet<alpha>(s1, i3))
                     \else (\if (  leq(i2, i3)
                                 & lt(i3,
                                      sub(seqLen(s1),
                                          Z(1(#)))))
                                \then (seqGet<alpha>(s1,
                                                     add(i3,
                                                         Z(1(#)))))
                                \else (cast<alpha>(seqGetOutside))))
    )
    \heuristics(seqRead)
  };
}

== getOfSwap (getOfSwap) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  getOfSwap {
    \schemaVar \term int idx;
    \schemaVar \term int iv;
    \schemaVar \term int jv;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s1;

    \find(seqGet<alpha>(seqSwap(s1, iv, jv), idx))

    \replacewith(
      \if (!(  leq(Z(0(#)), iv)
             & leq(Z(0(#)), jv)
             & lt(iv, seqLen(s1))
             & lt(jv, seqLen(s1))))
          \then (seqGet<alpha>(s1, idx))
          \else (\if (idx = iv)
                     \then (seqGet<alpha>(s1, jv))
                     \else (\if (idx = jv)
                                \then (seqGet<alpha>(s1,
                                                     iv))
                                \else (seqGet<alpha>(s1,
                                                     idx))))
    )
    \heuristics(seqRead)
  };
}

    \schemaVar \term int jv;

== greater (greater) =========================================
greater {
  \schemaVar \term int i;
  \schemaVar \term int i0;

  \find(gt(i, i0))

  \replacewith(lt(i0, i))
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== greater_add (greater_add) =========================================
greater_add {
  \schemaVar \term int i0;
  \schemaVar \term int i1;
  \schemaVar \variables int j2;

  \find(==> gt(i0, i1))
  \varcond(\notFreeIn(j2, i0), \notFreeIn(j2, i1))
  \replacewith(
    ==> \exists j2; gt(add(i0, j2), add(i1, j2))
  )
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== greater_add_one (greater_add_one) =========================================
greater_add_one {
  \schemaVar \term int i0;
  \schemaVar \term int i1;

  \find(gt(i0, i1))

  \replacewith(gt(add(i0, Z(1(#))), add(i1, Z(1(#)))))
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== greater_equal_than_comparison_new (greater-or-equal than distinction) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  greater_equal_than_comparison_new {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpressionNonFloatDouble #senf0;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpressionNonFloatDouble #senf1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs = #senf0 >= #senf1;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \if (geq(#senf0, #senf1))
          \then (\modality{#allmodal}{ ..
                     #lhs = true;
                   ... }\endmodality post)
          \else (\modality{#allmodal}{ ..
                     #lhs = false;
                   ... }\endmodality post)
    )
    \heuristics(obsolete, simplify_prog, split_if)
    \displayname "greater-or-equal than distinction"
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== greater_equal_than_comparison_simple (greater-or-equal than distinction) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  greater_equal_than_comparison_simple {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpressionNonFloatDouble #senf0;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpressionNonFloatDouble #senf1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs = #senf0 >= #senf1;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      {#lhs:=\if (geq(#senf0, #senf1))
                 \then (TRUE)
                 \else (FALSE)}
        \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "greater-or-equal than distinction"
  };
}

== greater_equal_than_comparison_simple_double (greater-or-equal than distinction) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  greater_equal_than_comparison_simple_double {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program JavaDoubleExpression #seDouble0;
    \schemaVar \program JavaDoubleExpression #seDouble1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs = #seDouble0 >= #seDouble1;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      {#lhs:=\if (geqDouble(#seDouble0, #seDouble1))
                 \then (TRUE)
                 \else (FALSE)}

== if (ifElse) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  if {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #s0;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           if (#se) #s0
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \if (#se = TRUE)
          \then (\modality{#allmodal}{ ..
                     #s0
                   ... }\endmodality post)
          \else (\modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post)
    )
    \displayname "ifElse"
  };
}

    \heuristics(split_if)

ifEqualsInteger {
  \schemaVar \term numbers iz;
  \schemaVar \formula  phi;
  \schemaVar \term any x;
  \schemaVar \term any y;

  \find(\if (phi)  \then (x)  \else (y) = Z(iz))

  \replacewith(phi & x = Z(iz) | !phi & y = Z(iz))
  \heuristics(simplify)
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== ifExthenelse1_eq (ifExthenelse1_eq) =========================================
ifExthenelse1_eq {
  \schemaVar \term G2 else;
  \schemaVar \variables int intVar;
  \schemaVar \term int t;
  \schemaVar \term G2 then;

  \find(
     \ifEx intVar; (intVar = t)
         \then (then)
         \else (else)
  )

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(intVar, t))
  \replacewith({\subst intVar;t}then)
  \heuristics(concrete)
}

  \schemaVar \variables int intVar;
  \schemaVar \term int t;

  \find(
    \ifEx intVar; (intVar = t)  \then (b)  \else (c)
  )

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(intVar, t))
  \replacewith({\subst intVar;t}b)
  \heuristics(concrete)
  \displayname "ifExthenelse1_eq"
}

== ifExthenelse1_solve (ifExthenelse1_solve) =========================================
ifExthenelse1_solve {
  \schemaVar \term G2 else;
  \schemaVar \term int intValue;
  \schemaVar \variables int intVar;
  \schemaVar \formula  phi;
  \schemaVar \term G2 then;

  \find(
    \ifEx intVar; (phi)  \then (then)  \else (else)
  )

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(intVar, intValue))
  \replacewith({\subst intVar;intValue}then);
  \replacewith(
    \ifEx intVar; (phi)  \then (then)  \else (else)
  )
  \add(
    ==>
       {\subst intVar;intValue}phi
     & \forall intVar;
         (phi -> wellOrderLeqInt(intValue, intVar))
  )
}

== ifExthenelse1_split (ifExthenelse1_split) =========================================
ifExthenelse1_split {
  \schemaVar \term G2 else;
  \schemaVar \skolemTerm int intSk;
  \schemaVar \variables int intVar;
  \schemaVar \formula  phi;
  \schemaVar \term G2 then;

  \find(
    \ifEx intVar; (phi)  \then (then)  \else (else)
  )

  \varcond(
    \newDependingOn(intSk, phi),
    \notFreeIn(intVar, intSk)
  )
  \replacewith({\subst intVar;intSk}then)
  \add(
     {\subst intVar;intSk}phi,
     \forall intVar;
       (phi -> wellOrderLeqInt(intSk, intVar))
    ==>
  );
  \replacewith(else)
  \add(==> \exists intVar; phi)
  \heuristics(split_cond)
}

== ifFalse (ifFalse) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  ifFalse {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #s0;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \assumes(#se = FALSE ==>)
    \find(
      ==>
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           if (#se) #s0
         ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \replacewith(
      ==>
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

== ifSplit (ifElseSplit) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  ifSplit {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #s0;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
      ==>
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           if (#se) #s0
         ... }\endmodality post
    )
    "if #se true":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
         \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
             #s0
           ... }\endmodality post
      )
      \add(#se = TRUE ==>);
    "if #se false":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
         \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
      )
      \add(#se = FALSE ==>)
    \heuristics(split_if)
    \displayname "ifElseSplit"
  };
}

== ifUnfold (ifElseUnfold) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  ifUnfold {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #boolv;
    \schemaVar \program NonSimpleExpression #nse;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #s0;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           if (#nse) #s0
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\new(#boolv, boolean))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          boolean #boolv;
          #boolv = #nse;
          if (#boolv) #s0
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_autoname)
    \displayname "ifElseUnfold"
  };
}

inDomainConcrete {
  \schemaVar \term K key;
  \schemaVar \term Map<K,V> m;
  \schemaVar \term V value;

  \assumes(==> mapUndef<V> = value)
  \find(mapGet<K, V>(m, key) = value ==>)
  \add(inDomain<K, V>(m, key) ==>)
  \heuristics(inReachableStateImplication)
}

== inDomainOfMapForeach (inDomainOfMapForeach) =========================================
inDomainOfMapForeach {
  \schemaVar \term boolean b;
  \schemaVar \term K key;
  \schemaVar \variables K kv;
  \schemaVar \term V value;

  \find(
     inDomain<K, V>(mapForeach<K, V>{kv;}(b, value),
                    key)
  )

  \replacewith({\subst kv;key}b = TRUE)
  \heuristics(simplify)
}

  \schemaVar \term Map<K,V> m0;
  \schemaVar \term Map<K,V> m1;

  \find(inDomain<K, V>(mapOverride<K, V>(m0, m1), key))

    inDomain<K, V>(m0, key) | inDomain<K, V>(m1, key)
  )
  \heuristics(simplify)

  \schemaVar \term int contradCoeffSmaller;

                  contradRightBigger)))

          contradRightBigger)

  \schemaVar \term int esCoeff2;
  \schemaVar \term int esLeft;
  \schemaVar \term int esRight1;
  \schemaVar \term int esRight2;

  \find(geq(mul(esLeft, esCoeff2), esRight2) ==>)
  \add(
        gt(esCoeff1, Z(0(#))) & gt(esCoeff2, Z(0(#)))
     -> geq(add(mul(Z(neglit(1(#))),
                    mul(esCoeff1, esRight2)),
                mul(esCoeff2, esRight1)),
            Z(0(#)))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(
    inEqSimp_exactShadow,

  \find(geq(mul(esLeft, esCoeff2), esRight2) ==>)

        gt(esCoeff2, Z(0(#)))
     -> geq(add(mul(Z(neglit(1(#))), esRight2),
                mul(esCoeff2, esRight1)),
            Z(0(#)))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(
    inEqSimp_exactShadow,
    inEqSimp_saturate,
    notHumanReadable)
}

== inEqSimp_or_antiSymm0 (inEqSimp_or_antiSymm0) =========================================
inEqSimp_or_antiSymm0 {
  \schemaVar \term int antiSymmLeft;
  \schemaVar \term int antiSymmRightBigger;
  \schemaVar \term int antiSymmRightSmaller;

  \find(
       leq(antiSymmLeft, antiSymmRightSmaller)
     | geq(antiSymmLeft, antiSymmRightBigger)
  )

  \replacewith(
    \if (  add(Z(2(#)), antiSymmRightSmaller)
         = antiSymmRightBigger)
        \then (!  antiSymmLeft
                = add(Z(1(#)), antiSymmRightSmaller))
        \else (  leq(antiSymmLeft,
                     antiSymmRightSmaller)
               | geq(antiSymmLeft, antiSymmRightBigger))
  )
  \heuristics(
    inEqSimp_forNormalisation,
    inEqSimp_or_antiSymm,
    notHumanReadable)
}

  \assumes(==> strengthenLeft = strengthenRight)
  \find(leq(strengthenLeft, strengthenRight) ==>)
  \replacewith(
     leq(strengthenLeft,
         add(Z(neglit(1(#))), strengthenRight))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(
    inEqSimp_propagation,
    inEqSimp_strengthen,
    notHumanReadable)
}

== inEqSimp_subsumption2 (inEqSimp_subsumption2) =========================================
inEqSimp_subsumption2 {
  \schemaVar \term int subsumCoeffBigger;
  \schemaVar \term int subsumCoeffSmaller;
  \schemaVar \term int subsumLeft;
  \schemaVar \term int subsumRightBigger;
  \schemaVar \term int subsumRightSmaller;

  \assumes(
     leq(mul(subsumLeft, subsumCoeffSmaller),
         subsumRightSmaller)
    ==>
  )
  \find(
     leq(mul(subsumLeft, subsumCoeffBigger),
         subsumRightBigger)
  )

  \replacewith(
        gt(subsumCoeffSmaller, Z(0(#)))
      & gt(subsumCoeffBigger, Z(0(#)))
      & leq(mul(subsumCoeffBigger, subsumRightSmaller),
            mul(subsumCoeffSmaller, subsumRightBigger))
    | leq(mul(subsumLeft, subsumCoeffBigger),
          subsumRightBigger)
  )
  \heuristics(
    inEqSimp_propagation,
    inEqSimp_subsumption,
    notHumanReadable)
}

== indexOf (indexOf) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  indexOf {
    \schemaVar \term int c;
    \schemaVar \term int i;
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \term Seq l;

    \find(clIndexOfChar(l, c, i))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(iv, c),
      \notFreeIn(iv, i),
      \notFreeIn(iv, l)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \ifEx iv; (  geq(i, Z(0(#)))
                 & geq(iv, i)
                 & lt(iv, seqLen(l))
                 & seqGet<int>(l, iv) = c)
          \then (iv)
          \else (Z(neglit(1(#))))
    )
    \heuristics(stringsExpandDefNormalOp)
  };
}
