== indexOfPSeqConcatFirst (indexOfPSeqConcatFirst) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  indexOfPSeqConcatFirst {
    \schemaVar \variables int idx;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s1;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s2;
    \schemaVar \term E x;

    \find(pseqIndexOf<E>(pseqConcat<E>(s1, s2), x))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(idx, s1),
      \notFreeIn(idx, s2),
      \notFreeIn(idx, x)
    )
    \replacewith(pseqIndexOf<E>(s1, x));
    \add(
      ==>
       \exists idx;
         (  leq(Z(0(#)), idx)
          & lt(idx, pseqLen<E>(s1))
          & pseqGet<E>(s1, idx) = x)
    )
  };
}

== indexOfPSeqConcatSecond (indexOfPSeqConcatSecond) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  indexOfPSeqConcatSecond {
    \schemaVar \variables int idx;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s1;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s2;
    \schemaVar \term E x;

    \find(pseqIndexOf<E>(pseqConcat<E>(s1, s2), x))

    )
  };

== indexOfStr (indexOfStr) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  indexOfStr {
    \schemaVar \term int i;
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \term Seq searchStr;
    \schemaVar \term Seq sourceStr;

    \find(clIndexOfCl(sourceStr, i, searchStr))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(iv, i),
      \notFreeIn(iv, searchStr),
      \notFreeIn(iv, sourceStr)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \ifEx iv; (  geq(iv, i)
                 & geq(iv, Z(0(#)))
                 & leq(add(iv, seqLen(searchStr)),
                       seqLen(sourceStr))
                 &   seqSub(sourceStr,
                            iv,
                            add(iv, seqLen(searchStr)))
                   = searchStr)
          \then (iv)
          \else (Z(neglit(1(#))))
    )
    \heuristics(stringsExpandDefNormalOp)
  };
}

== inequality_comparison_new (inequality comparison) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  inequality_comparison_new {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpressionNonFloatDouble #senf0;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpressionNonFloatDouble #senf1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs = #senf0 != #senf1;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \if (!#senf0 = #senf1)
          \then (\modality{#allmodal}{ ..
                     #lhs = true;
                   ... }\endmodality post)
          \else (\modality{#allmodal}{ ..
                     #lhs = false;
                   ... }\endmodality post)
    )
    \heuristics(obsolete, simplify_prog, split_if)
    \displayname "inequality comparison"
  };
}

== insert_constant_string_value (insert_constant_string_value) =========================================
insert_constant_string_value {
  \schemaVar \program ConstantStringVariable #csv;

  \assumes(wellFormed(heap) ==>)
  \find(#csv)

  \replacewith(
    \if (#constantvalue(#csv) = null)
        \then (null)
        \else (strPool(cast<Seq>(#constantvalue(#csv))))
  )
  \add(
       #constantvalue(#csv) = null
     | !strPool(cast<Seq>(#constantvalue(#csv))) = null
     &   select<boolean>(heap,
                         strPool(cast<Seq>(#constantvalue(#csv))),
                         java.lang.Object::#$created)
       = TRUE
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(concrete)
}

== instanceCreation (instanceCreation) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  instanceCreation {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleInstanceCreation #n;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #n
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\newTypeOf(#v0, #n))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #typeof(#v0) #v0 = #createObject(#n);
          #constructorCall(#v0, #n)
          #postWork(#v0)
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(method_expand)
  };
}

    } #allmodal;

  };

== intDivRem (intDivRem) =========================================
intDivRem {
  \schemaVar \term int divDenom;
  \schemaVar \term int divNum;

  \find(jmod(divNum, divDenom))

  \add(
        !divDenom = Z(0(#))
     ->   divNum
        = add(mul(jdiv(divNum, divDenom), divDenom),
              jmod(divNum, divDenom))
    ==>
  )
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== int_induction (int_induction) =========================================
int_induction {
  \schemaVar \formula  b;
  \schemaVar \variables int nv;

  "Base Case":
    \add(==> {\subst nv;Z(0(#))}b);
  "Step Case":
    \add(
      ==>
       \forall nv;
         (   geq(nv, Z(0(#))) & b
          -> {\subst nv;add(nv, Z(1(#)))}b)
    );
  "Use Case":
    \add(\forall nv; (geq(nv, Z(0(#))) -> b) ==>)
}

== intersectAllFieldsAllObjects (intersectAllFieldsAllObjects) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  intersectAllFieldsAllObjects {
    \schemaVar \term Field f;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;

    \find(
       intersect<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(allFields(o),
                                               allObjects(f))
    )

    \replacewith(
      singleton<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(o,
                                                                            f))
    )
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}

== intersectArrayRangesDisjoint (intersectArrayRangesDisjoint) =========================================

  intersectArrayRangesDisjoint {
    \schemaVar \term int lower;
    \schemaVar \term int lower2;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term int upper;
    \schemaVar \term int upper2;

    \find(
       intersect<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(arrayRange(o,
                                                          lower,
                                                          upper),
                                               arrayRange(o,
                                                          lower2,
                                                          upper2))
    )

    \replacewith(
      \if (lt(upper, lower2))
          \then (empty<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>)
          \else (intersect<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(arrayRange(o,
                                                                    lower,
                                                                    upper),
                                                         arrayRange(o,
                                                                    lower2,
                                                                    upper2)))
    )
    \heuristics(locSetArrayRangeInterDisjoint)
  };

== intersectArrayRangesNested (intersectArrayRangesNested) =========================================

    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term int upper;
    \schemaVar \term int upper2;

    \find(
       intersect<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(arrayRange(o,
                                                          lower,
                                                          upper),
                                               arrayRange(o,
                                                          lower2,
                                                          upper2))
    )

    \replacewith(
      \if (leq(lower2, lower) & leq(upper, upper2))
          \then (arrayRange(o, lower, upper))
          \else (intersect<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(arrayRange(o,
                                                                    lower,
                                                                    upper),
                                                         arrayRange(o,
                                                                    lower2,
                                                                    upper2)))
    )
    \heuristics(locSetArrayRangeInterNested2)
    \displayname "intersectArrayRangesNested"
  };
}

== intersectUnionEqualsEmpty (intersectUnionEqualsEmpty) =========================================
intersectUnionEqualsEmpty {
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s2;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> t;

  \find(intersect<T>(union<T>(s, s2), t) = empty<T>)

  \replacewith(
      intersect<T>(s, t) = empty<T>
    & intersect<T>(s2, t) = empty<T>
  )
  \heuristics(simplify_enlarging)
}

== iterated_assignments_0 (eval_order_iterated_assignments) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  iterated_assignments_0 {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs0;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs0 = #lhs1 = #e;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #lhs1 = #e;
          #lhs0 = #lhs1;
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "eval_order_iterated_assignments"
  };
}

== iterated_assignments_1 (eval_order_iterated_assignments) =========================================

    )

        ... }\endmodality post

  };

    \schemaVar \program Expression #e;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs0;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs0 = #lhs1 >>>= #e;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #lhs1 = (#typeof(#lhs1)) (#lhs1 >>> #e);
          #lhs0 = #lhs1;
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "eval_order_iterated_assignments"
  };
}

== jdivAddMultDenom (jdivAddMultDenom) =========================================
jdivAddMultDenom {
  \schemaVar \variables int A;
  \schemaVar \variables int D;
  \schemaVar \variables int N;

  \add(
     \forall N;
       \forall D;
         \forall A;
           (   !D = Z(0(#))
            ->   jdiv(add(N, mul(A, D)), D)
               = \if (N = mul(jdiv(N, D), D))
                     \then (add(jdiv(N, D), A))
                     \else (\if (  !  N
                                    = mul(jdiv(N, D),
                                          D)
                                 & (    geq(N, Z(0(#)))
                                    <-> geq(add(N,
                                                mul(D,
                                                    A)),
                                            Z(0(#)))))
                                \then (add(jdiv(N, D),
                                           A))
                                \else (\if (  !  N
                                               = mul(jdiv(N,
                                                          D),
                                                     D)
                                            & (    geq(N,
                                                       Z(0(#)))
                                               <-> lt(add(N,
                                                          mul(D,
                                                              A)),
                                                      Z(0(#))))
                                            & (    gt(D,
                                                      Z(0(#)))
                                               <-> lt(add(N,
                                                          mul(D,
                                                              A)),
                                                      Z(0(#)))))
                                           \then (add(add(jdiv(N,
                                                               D),
                                                          A),
                                                      Z(1(#))))
                                           \else (sub(add(jdiv(N,
                                                               D),
                                                          A),
                                                      Z(1(#)))))))
    ==>
  )
}

== lastIndexOf (lastIndexOf) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  lastIndexOf {
    \schemaVar \term int c;
    \schemaVar \term int i;
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \term Seq sourceStr;

    \find(clLastIndexOfChar(sourceStr, c, i))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(iv, c),
      \notFreeIn(iv, i),
      \notFreeIn(iv, sourceStr)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \ifEx iv; (  gt(iv, Z(0(#)))
                 & geq(i, iv)
                 & lt(sub(i, iv), seqLen(sourceStr))
                 & seqGet<int>(sourceStr, sub(i, iv)) = c)
          \then (sub(i, iv))
          \else (Z(neglit(1(#))))
    )
    \heuristics(stringsExpandDefNormalOp)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== lastIndexOfStr (lastIndexOfStr) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  lastIndexOfStr {
    \schemaVar \term int i;
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \term Seq searchStr;
    \schemaVar \term Seq sourceStr;

    \find(clLastIndexOfCl(sourceStr, i, searchStr))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(iv, i),
      \notFreeIn(iv, searchStr),
      \notFreeIn(iv, sourceStr)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \ifEx iv; (  gt(iv, Z(0(#)))
                 & geq(sub(i, iv), Z(0(#)))
                 & leq(sub(add(seqLen(searchStr), i), iv),
                       seqLen(sourceStr))
                 &   seqSub(sourceStr,
                            sub(i, iv),
                            sub(add(seqLen(searchStr), i),
                                iv))
                   = searchStr)
          \then (sub(i, iv))
          \else (Z(neglit(1(#))))
    )
    \heuristics(stringsExpandDefNormalOp)
  };
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== leq_add (leq_add) =========================================
leq_add {
  \schemaVar \term int i0;
  \schemaVar \term int i1;
  \schemaVar \variables int j2;

  \find(==> leq(i0, i1))
  \varcond(\notFreeIn(j2, i0), \notFreeIn(j2, i1))
  \replacewith(
    ==> \exists j2; leq(add(i0, j2), add(i1, j2))
  )
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== leq_add_iff1 (leq_add_iff1) =========================================
leq_add_iff1 {
  \schemaVar \term int i0;
  \schemaVar \term int i1;
  \schemaVar \term int i2;
  \schemaVar \term int i3;
  \schemaVar \term int i4;

  \find(
    leq(add(mul(i0, i1), i2), add(mul(i3, i1), i4))
  )

  \replacewith(leq(add(mul(sub(i0, i3), i1), i2), i4))
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== leq_add_iff2 (leq_add_iff2) =========================================
leq_add_iff2 {
  \schemaVar \term int i0;
  \schemaVar \term int i1;
  \schemaVar \term int i2;
  \schemaVar \term int i3;
  \schemaVar \term int i4;

  \find(
    leq(add(mul(i0, i1), i2), add(mul(i3, i1), i4))
  )

  \replacewith(leq(i2, add(mul(sub(i3, i0), i1), i4)))
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== less_equal_than_comparison_new (less-or-equal than distinction) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  less_equal_than_comparison_new {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpressionNonFloatDouble #senf0;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpressionNonFloatDouble #senf1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs = #senf0 <= #senf1;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \if (leq(#senf0, #senf1))
          \then (\modality{#allmodal}{ ..
                     #lhs = true;
                   ... }\endmodality post)
          \else (\modality{#allmodal}{ ..
                     #lhs = false;
                   ... }\endmodality post)
    )
    \heuristics(obsolete, simplify_prog, split_if)
    \displayname "less-or-equal than distinction"
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== less_equal_than_comparison_simple (less-or-equal than distinction) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  less_equal_than_comparison_simple {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpressionNonFloatDouble #senf0;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpressionNonFloatDouble #senf1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs = #senf0 <= #senf1;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      {#lhs:=\if (leq(#senf0, #senf1))
                 \then (TRUE)
                 \else (FALSE)}
        \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "less-or-equal than distinction"
  };
}

  \find(lt(Z(iz), Z(jz)))

  \replacewith(#less(Z(iz), Z(jz)))
  \heuristics(simplify_literals)
}

  \schemaVar \term int i0;

  \replacewith(!lt(i0, add(i, Z(1(#)))))
}

  \replacewith(lt(neg(i0), i1))

== less_than_comparison_new (lesser than distinction) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  less_than_comparison_new {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpressionNonFloatDouble #senf0;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpressionNonFloatDouble #senf1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs = #senf0 < #senf1;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \if (lt(#senf0, #senf1))
          \then (\modality{#allmodal}{ ..
                     #lhs = true;
                   ... }\endmodality post)
          \else (\modality{#allmodal}{ ..
                     #lhs = false;
                   ... }\endmodality post)
    )
    \heuristics(obsolete, simplify_prog, split_if)
    \displayname "lesser than distinction"
  };
}

  \find(i)

  \add(lt(i, Z(0(#))) ==>);
  \add(i = Z(0(#)) ==>);
  \add(lt(Z(0(#)), i) ==>)
}

  \replacewith((!psi | phi) & (psi | phi))
}

== log1Concrete (log1Concrete) =========================================
log1Concrete {
  \schemaVar \term int base;

  \find(log(base, Z(1(#))))

  \replacewith(
    \if (gt(base, Z(1(#))))
        \then (Z(0(#)))
        \else (undefinedLog(base, Z(1(#))))
  )
  \heuristics(simplify)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== logDefinition (logDefinition) =========================================
logDefinition {
  \schemaVar \term int base;
  \schemaVar \term int x;

  \find(log(base, x))

  \replacewith(
    \if (geq(x, Z(1(#))) & gt(base, Z(1(#))))
        \then (\if (lt(x, base))
                   \then (Z(0(#)))
                   \else (add(Z(1(#)),
                              log(base, div(x, base)))))
        \else (undefinedLog(base, x))
  )
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== logLessThanPow (logLessThanPow) =========================================
logLessThanPow {
  \schemaVar \term int base;
  \schemaVar \term int exp;
  \schemaVar \term int x;

  \find(lt(log(base, x), exp))

  \add(
          gt(base, Z(1(#)))
        & geq(x, Z(1(#)))
        & lt(x, pow(base, exp))
        & geq(exp, Z(1(#)))
     -> lt(log(base, x), exp)
    ==>
  )
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== logLessThanPowConcrete (logLessThanPowConcrete) =========================================
logLessThanPowConcrete {
  \schemaVar \term int base;
  \schemaVar \term int exp;
  \schemaVar \term int x;

  \find(==> lt(log(base, x), exp))
  \add(
    ==>
       gt(base, Z(1(#)))
     & geq(x, Z(1(#)))
     & lt(x, pow(base, exp))
     & geq(exp, Z(1(#)))
  )
  \heuristics(simplify)
}

== logMono (logMono) =========================================
logMono {
  \schemaVar \term int base;
  \schemaVar \term int x;
  \schemaVar \term int x_2;

  \find(leq(log(base, x), log(base, x_2)))

  \add(
          geq(x, Z(1(#)))
        & geq(x_2, x)
        & gt(base, Z(1(#)))
     -> leq(log(base, x), log(base, x_2))
    ==>
  )
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== logMonoConcrete (logMonoConcrete) =========================================
logMonoConcrete {
  \schemaVar \term int base;
  \schemaVar \term int x;
  \schemaVar \term int x_2;

  \find(
     leq(log(base, x_2),
         add(Z(neglit(1(#))), log(base, x)))
    ==>
  )
  \add(
    ==>
     geq(x, Z(1(#))) & geq(x_2, x) & gt(base, Z(1(#)))
  )
  \heuristics(simplify)
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== logPowIdentity (logPowIdentity) =========================================
logPowIdentity {
  \schemaVar \term int base;
  \schemaVar \variables int i;
  \schemaVar \term int x;

  \find(log(base, x))

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(i, base), \notFreeIn(i, x))
  \add(
        gt(base, Z(1(#)))
     -> \forall i;
          (   geq(i, Z(0(#)))
           -> log(base, pow(base, i)) = i)
    ==>
  )
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== logPowIdentityConcrete (logPowIdentityConcrete) =========================================
logPowIdentityConcrete {
  \schemaVar \term int base;
  \schemaVar \term int exp;

  \find(log(base, pow(base, exp)))

  \replacewith(
    \if (gt(base, Z(1(#))))
        \then (\if (geq(exp, Z(0(#))))
                   \then (exp)
                   \else (log(base,
                              undefinedPow(base, exp))))
        \else (undefinedLog(base, pow(base, exp)))
  )
  \heuristics(simplify)
}

== logProdIdentity (logProdIdentity) =========================================
logProdIdentity {
  \schemaVar \term int base;
  \schemaVar \term int exp;
  \schemaVar \variables int i;

  \find(log(base, bprod{i;}(Z(0(#)), exp, base)))

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(i, base), \notFreeIn(i, exp))
  \add(
        geq(exp, Z(0(#))) & gt(base, Z(1(#)))
     -> log(base, bprod{i;}(Z(0(#)), exp, base)) = exp
    ==>
  )
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== logProdIdentityConcrete (logProdIdentityConcrete) =========================================
logProdIdentityConcrete {
  \schemaVar \term int base;
  \schemaVar \term int exp;
  \schemaVar \variables int i;

  \find(log(base, bprod{i;}(Z(0(#)), exp, base)))

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(i, base), \notFreeIn(i, exp))
  \replacewith(
    \if (gt(base, Z(1(#))))
        \then (\if (lt(exp, Z(0(#))))
                   \then (Z(0(#)))
                   \else (exp))
        \else (undefinedLog(base,
                            bprod{i;}(Z(0(#)),
                                      exp,
                                      base)))
  )
  \heuristics(simplify)
}

     ->   log(base, mul(x, base))
        = add(log(base, x), Z(1(#)))
    ==>
  )

-----------------------------------------------------
== logSqueeze (logSqueeze) =========================================
logSqueeze {
  \schemaVar \term int base;
  \schemaVar \term int exp;
  \schemaVar \term int x;

  \find(log(base, x) = exp)

  \add(
          gt(base, Z(1(#)))
        & geq(x, Z(1(#)))
        & geq(x, pow(base, exp))
        & lt(x, pow(base, add(exp, Z(1(#)))))
        & geq(exp, Z(0(#)))
     -> log(base, x) = exp
    ==>
  )
}

        \then (add(log(base, x), Z(1(#))))
        \else (undefinedLog(base, mul(x, base)))
  )
  \heuristics(simplify)
}

== loopScopeInvBox (loopScopeInvBox) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & javaLoopTreatment:efficient) {
  loopScopeInvBox {
    \schemaVar \program Statement #body;
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {box, box_transaction} #box;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #heapBefore_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #localVarDeclsBefore_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #loopStmt;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #nse;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #permissionsBefore_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #savedHeapBefore_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \update  #updateBefore_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \update  #updateFrame_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #x;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm Heap anon_heap_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm Heap anon_permissions_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm Heap anon_savedHeap_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \formula  freeInv;
    \schemaVar \formula  inv;
    \schemaVar \formula  loopFormula;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#box}{ ..
           while (#nse) #body
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(
      \new(#heapBefore_LOOP, Heap),
      \new(#permissionsBefore_LOOP, Heap),
      \new(#savedHeapBefore_LOOP, Heap),
      \new(#x, boolean),
      \getFreeInvariant(#loopStmt, #box, freeInv),
      \getInvariant(#loopStmt, #box, inv),
      \hasInvariant(#loopStmt,#box),
      \newLocalVars(#localVarDeclsBefore_LOOP, #updateBefore_LOOP, #updateFrame_LOOP, #body),
      \storeStmtIn(#loopStmt,
      \modality{#box}{
          while (#nse) #body
        }\endmodality post),
      \storeTermIn(loopFormula,
      \modality{#box}{
          while (#nse) #body
        }\endmodality post)
    )
    "Invariant Initially Valid":
      \replacewith(inv);
    "Invariant Preserved and Used":
      \replacewith(
        \modality{#box}{
            #typeof(#heapBefore_LOOP) #heapBefore_LOOP;
            #typeof(#savedHeapBefore_LOOP) #savedHeapBefore_LOOP;
            #typeof(#permissionsBefore_LOOP) #permissionsBefore_LOOP;
            #localVarDeclsBefore_LOOP
          }\endmodality {#createBeforeLoopUpdate(loopFormula,
                                                 #heapBefore_LOOP,
                                                 #savedHeapBefore_LOOP,
                                                 #permissionsBefore_LOOP)
                         || #createLocalAnonUpdate(loopFormula)
                         || #updateBefore_LOOP
                         || #createHeapAnonUpdate(loopFormula,
                                                  anon_heap_LOOP,
                                                  anon_savedHeap_LOOP,
                                                  anon_permissions_LOOP)}
                          (   inv & freeInv
                           -> \modality{#box}{ ..
                                  boolean #x;
                                  loop-scope (#x) {
                                    if (#nse) {
                                      #body
                                      continue;
                                    } else {
                                      break;
                                    }
                                  }
                                ... }\endmodality (  (     #x<<loopScopeIndex>>
                                                         = TRUE
                                                      -> post)
                                                   & (     #x<<loopScopeIndex>>
                                                         = FALSE
                                                      ->   inv
                                                         & {#updateFrame_LOOP}
                                                             #createFrameCond(loopFormula,
                                                                              #heapBefore_LOOP,
                                                                              #savedHeapBefore_LOOP,
                                                                              #permissionsBefore_LOOP))))
      )
      \add(
         #wellFormedCond(loopFormula,
                         anon_heap_LOOP,
                         anon_savedHeap_LOOP,
                         anon_permissions_LOOP)
        ==>
      )
    \heuristics(loop_scope_inv_taclet)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== loopScopeInvDia (loopScopeInvDia) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & javaLoopTreatment:efficient) {
  loopScopeInvDia {
    \schemaVar \program Statement #body;
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #dia;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #heapBefore_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #localVarDeclsBefore_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #loopStmt;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #nse;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #permissionsBefore_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #savedHeapBefore_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \update  #updateBefore_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \update  #updateFrame_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #variant;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #x;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm Heap anon_heap_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm Heap anon_permissions_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm Heap anon_savedHeap_LOOP;
    \schemaVar \formula  freeInv;
    \schemaVar \formula  inv;
    \schemaVar \formula  loopFormula;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;
    \schemaVar \term any variantTerm;

    \find(
       \modality{#dia}{ ..
           while (#nse) #body
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(
      \new(#heapBefore_LOOP, Heap),
      \new(#permissionsBefore_LOOP, Heap),
      \new(#savedHeapBefore_LOOP, Heap),
      \new(#variant, any),
      \new(#x, boolean),
      \getFreeInvariant(#loopStmt, #dia, freeInv),
      \getInvariant(#loopStmt, #dia, inv),
      \getVariant(#loopStmt, variantTerm),
      \hasInvariant(#loopStmt,#dia),
      \newLocalVars(#localVarDeclsBefore_LOOP, #updateBefore_LOOP, #updateFrame_LOOP, #body),
      \storeStmtIn(#loopStmt,
      \modality{#dia}{
          while (#nse) #body
        }\endmodality post),
      \storeTermIn(loopFormula,
      \modality{#dia}{
          while (#nse) #body
        }\endmodality post)
    )
    "Invariant Initially Valid":
      \replacewith(inv);
    "Invariant Preserved and Used":
      \replacewith(
        \modality{#dia}{
            #typeof(#heapBefore_LOOP) #heapBefore_LOOP;
            #typeof(#savedHeapBefore_LOOP) #savedHeapBefore_LOOP;
            #typeof(#permissionsBefore_LOOP) #permissionsBefore_LOOP;
            #typeof(#variant) #variant;
            #localVarDeclsBefore_LOOP
          }\endmodality {#createBeforeLoopUpdate(loopFormula,
                                                 #heapBefore_LOOP,
                                                 #savedHeapBefore_LOOP,
                                                 #permissionsBefore_LOOP)
                         || #updateBefore_LOOP
                         || #createLocalAnonUpdate(loopFormula)
                         || #createHeapAnonUpdate(loopFormula,
                                                  anon_heap_LOOP,
                                                  anon_savedHeap_LOOP,
                                                  anon_permissions_LOOP)}
                          {#variant:=variantTerm}
                            (   inv & freeInv
                             -> \modality{#dia}{ ..
                                    boolean #x;
                                    loop-scope (#x) {
                                      if (#nse) {
                                        #body
                                        continue;
                                      } else {
                                        break;
                                      }
                                    }
                                  ... }\endmodality (  (     #x<<loopScopeIndex>>
                                                           = TRUE
                                                        -> post)
                                                     & (     #x<<loopScopeIndex>>
                                                           = FALSE
                                                        ->   inv
                                                           & {#updateFrame_LOOP}
                                                               #createFrameCond(loopFormula,
                                                                                #heapBefore_LOOP,
                                                                                #savedHeapBefore_LOOP,
                                                                                #permissionsBefore_LOOP)
                                                           & prec(variantTerm,
                                                                  #variant))))
      )
      \add(
         #wellFormedCond(loopFormula,
                         anon_heap_LOOP,
                         anon_savedHeap_LOOP,
                         anon_permissions_LOOP)
        ==>
      )
    \heuristics(loop_scope_inv_taclet)
  };
}

== loopUnwind (loopUnwind) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  loopUnwind {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e;
    \schemaVar \program Label #innerLabel;
    \schemaVar \program Label #outerLabel;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #s;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           while (#e) #s
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(
      \newLabel (#innerLabel),
      \newLabel (#outerLabel)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #unwindLoop(#innerLabel,
          #outerLabel,
          while (#e) #s)
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(loop_expand)
  };
}

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           loop-scope (#lhs) {
             continue #lb;
             #slist
           }
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(
      \not\isLabeled(#lsStmt),
      \storeStmtIn(#lsStmt,
      \modality{#allmodal}{
          loop-scope (#lhs) {
            continue #lb;
            #slist
          }
        }\endmodality post)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #lhs = true;
          continue #lb;
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

== mapEqualityRight (mapEqualityRight) =========================================
mapEqualityRight {
  \schemaVar \variables K kv;
  \schemaVar \term Map<K,V> m0;
  \schemaVar \term Map<K,V> m1;

  \find(==> m0 = m1)
  \varcond(\notFreeIn(kv, m0), \notFreeIn(kv, m1))
  \replacewith(
    ==>
     \forall kv;
       (  (    inDomain<K, V>(m0, kv)
           <-> inDomain<K, V>(m1, kv))
        & (   inDomain<K, V>(m0, kv)
           ->   mapGet<K, V>(m0, kv)
              = mapGet<K, V>(m1, kv)))
  )
  \heuristics(simplify_enlarging)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== mapGetNotInDomain (mapGetNotInDomain) =========================================

  \schemaVar \term Map<K,V> m;

  \assumes(==> inDomain<K, V>(m, key))
  \find(mapGet<K, V>(m, key))

  \replacewith(mapUndef<V>)
  \heuristics(simplify)
}

== maxAxiom (maxAxiom) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  maxAxiom {
    \schemaVar \term boolean b;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \term int t2;
    \schemaVar \variables alpha x;
    \schemaVar \variables alpha y;

    \find(max{x;}(b, t) = t2 ==>)
    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(x, t2),
      \notFreeIn(y, b),
      \notFreeIn(y, t),
      \notFreeIn(y, t2)
    )
    "Use Axiom":
      \add(
           \forall y;
             {\subst x;y}(b = TRUE -> leq(t, t2))
         & \exists y; {\subst x;y}(b = TRUE & t = t2)
        ==>
      );
    "Show Satisfiability":
      \add(
        ==>
         \exists x;
           (  b = TRUE
            & \forall y;
                (   {\subst x;y}b = TRUE
                 -> leq({\subst x;y}t, t)))
      )
  };
}

== methodCall (methodCall) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & runtimeExceptions:ban) {
  methodCall {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program MethodName #mn;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #selist;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
      ==>
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #se.#mn(#selist);
         ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \varcond(
      \mayExpandMethod(#se, #mn, #selist),
      \not \staticMethodReference(#se, #mn, #selist)
    )
    "Normal Execution (#se != null)":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
         \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
             #methodCall(#se.#mn(#selist))
           ... }\endmodality post
      );
    "Null Reference (#se = null)":
      \replacewith(==> false)
      \add(#se = null ==>)
    \heuristics(method_expand)
  };
}

    )
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #typeof(#lhs) #v0;
          #methodCall(#ex, #v0, #mn(#elist))
          #lhs = #v0;
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(method_expand)
    \displayname "methodCall"
  };
}

== methodCallWithinClass (methodCall) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & initialisation:disableStaticInitialisation) {
  methodCallWithinClass {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #elist;
    \schemaVar \program MethodName #mn;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #mn(#elist);
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\mayExpandMethod(#mn, #elist))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #methodCall(#mn(#elist))
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(method_expand)
    \displayname "methodCall"
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== minAxiom (minAxiom) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  minAxiom {
    \schemaVar \term boolean b;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \term int t2;
    \schemaVar \variables alpha x;
    \schemaVar \variables alpha y;

    \find(min{x;}(b, t) = t2 ==>)
    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(x, t2),
      \notFreeIn(y, b),
      \notFreeIn(y, t),
      \notFreeIn(y, t2)
    )
    "Use Axiom":
      \add(
           \forall y;
             {\subst x;y}(b = TRUE -> geq(t, t2))
         & \exists y; {\subst x;y}(b = TRUE & t = t2)
        ==>
      );
    "Show Satisfiability":
      \add(
        ==>
         \exists x;
           (  b = TRUE
            & \forall y;
                (   {\subst x;y}b = TRUE
                 -> geq({\subst x;y}t, t)))
      )
  };
}

== mod_axiom (mod_axiom) =========================================
mod_axiom {
  \schemaVar \term int divDenom;
  \schemaVar \term int divNum;

  \find(mod(divNum, divDenom))

  \replacewith(
    add(divNum,
        mul(mul(div(divNum, divDenom), Z(neglit(1(#)))),
            divDenom))
  )
  \heuristics(defOps_mod, notHumanReadable)
}

== mod_geZero (mod_geZero) =========================================

  \schemaVar \term int divNum;

  \add(
        !divDenom = Z(0(#))
     -> leq(Z(0(#)), mod(divNum, divDenom))
    ==>
  )
}

== mod_homoEq (mod_homoEq) =========================================
mod_homoEq {
  \schemaVar \term int modDenom;
  \schemaVar \term int modNumLeft;
  \schemaVar \term int modNumRight;

  \find(
       mod(modNumLeft, modDenom)
     = mod(modNumRight, modDenom)
  )

  \replacewith(
      mod(sub(modNumLeft, modNumRight), modDenom)
    = Z(0(#))
  )
  \heuristics(defOps_modHomoEq, notHumanReadable)
}

== mod_lessDenom (mod_lessDenom) =========================================
mod_lessDenom {
  \schemaVar \term int divDenom;
  \schemaVar \term int divNum;

  \find(mod(divNum, divDenom))

  \add(
        !divDenom = Z(0(#))
     -> lt(mod(divNum, divDenom),
           \if (geq(divDenom, Z(0(#))))
               \then (divDenom)
               \else (neg(divDenom)))
    ==>
  )
}

== moduloByteFixpointInline (moduloByteFixpointInline) =========================================
moduloByteFixpointInline {
  \schemaVar \term int i;
  \schemaVar \skolemTerm int moduloT;

  \varcond(\newDependingOn(moduloT, i))
  \replacewith(moduloT)

     = moduloT,
     moduloByte(i) = moduloT
    ==>
  )

== narrowFinalArrayType (narrowFinalArrayType) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  narrowFinalArrayType {
    \schemaVar \term int idx;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;

    \assumes(==> o = null)
    \find(final<beta>(o, arr(idx)))

    \varcond(
      \hasElementarySort(o, alpha),
      \strict\sub(alpha, beta)
    )
    \replacewith(final<alpha>(o, arr(idx)))
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}

== narrowingByteCastLong (cast) =========================================

  narrowingByteCastLong {
    \schemaVar \program Variable #loc;
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #normalassign;
    \schemaVar \program JavaLongExpression #seLong;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#normalassign}{ ..
           #loc = (byte) #seLong;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \sameUpdateLevel
    \replacewith(
      {#loc:=javaCastByte(#seLong)}
        \modality{#normalassign}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(executeIntegerAssignment)
    \displayname "cast"
  };
}

== newSym_eq (newSym_eq) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  newSym_eq {
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm int l;
    \schemaVar \term int newSymDef;
    \schemaVar \term int newSymLeft;
    \schemaVar \term int newSymLeftCoeff;
    \schemaVar \term int newSymRight;

    \find(
      mul(newSymLeft, newSymLeftCoeff) = newSymRight
      ==>
    )
    \varcond(
      \newDependingOn(l, newSymDef),
      \newDependingOn(l, newSymLeft)
    )
    \add(newSymLeft = add(l, newSymDef) ==>)
    \heuristics(polySimp_leftNonUnit, polySimp_newSym)
  };
}

== noElementOfSupersetImpliesNoElementOfSubset (noElementOfSupersetImpliesNoElementOfSubset) =========================================
noElementOfSupersetImpliesNoElementOfSubset {
  \schemaVar \term T e;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s2;

  \assumes(subset<T>(s, s2) ==>)
  \find(==> elementOf<T>(e, s2))
  \add(==> elementOf<T>(e, s))
  \heuristics(simplify_enlarging)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== nonNull (nonNull) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  nonNull {
    \schemaVar \term int depth;
    \schemaVar \term Heap heapSV;
    \schemaVar \variables int i;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;

    \find(nonNull(heapSV, o, depth))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(i, depth),
      \notFreeIn(i, heapSV),
      \notFreeIn(i, o),
      \isReferenceArray(o)
    )
    \replacewith(
        !o = null
      & (   gt(depth, Z(0(#)))
         -> \forall i;
              (   leq(Z(0(#)), i) & lt(i, length(o))
               -> nonNull(heapSV,
                          select<java.lang.Object>(heapSV,
                                                   o,
                                                   arr(i)),
                          sub(depth, Z(1(#))))))
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_enlarging)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== nonNullZero (nonNullZero) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  nonNullZero {
    \schemaVar \term Heap heapSV;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;

    \find(nonNull(heapSV, o, Z(0(#))))

    \replacewith(!o = null)
    \heuristics(concrete)
  };
}

== nullCreated (nullCreated) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  nullCreated {
    \schemaVar \variables Heap h;

    \add(
         \forall h;
             select<boolean>(h,
                             null,
                             java.lang.Object::#$created)
           = TRUE
       | \forall h;
             select<boolean>(h,
                             null,
                             java.lang.Object::#$created)
           = FALSE
      ==>
    )
  };
}

== nullString (nullString) =========================================
nullString {

  \find(strContent(null))

  \replacewith(
    seqConcat(seqSingleton(C(0(1(1(#))))),
              seqConcat(seqSingleton(C(7(1(1(#))))),
                        seqConcat(seqSingleton(C(8(0(1(#))))),
                                  seqSingleton(C(8(0(1(#))))))))
  )
  \heuristics(concrete)
}

== null_can_always_be_stored_in_a_reference_type_array (null_can_always_be_stored_in_a_reference_type_array) =========================================

== observerDependency (observerDependency) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  observerDependency {
    \schemaVar \term any termWithLargeHeap;
    \schemaVar \term any termWithSmallHeap;

    \find(termWithLargeHeap)
    \inSequentState
    \varcond(
      \sameObserver (termWithLargeHeap, termWithSmallHeap)
    )
    \replacewith(termWithSmallHeap);
    \add(
      ==>
       #ObserverEquality(termWithLargeHeap,
                         termWithSmallHeap)
    )
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== observerDependencyEQ (observerDependencyEQ) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  observerDependencyEQ {
    \schemaVar \term any t1;
    \schemaVar \term any t2;

    \find(t1 = t2)
    \inSequentState
    \varcond(\sameObserver (t1, t2))
    \replacewith(true);
    \add(==> #ObserverEquality(t1, t2))
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== observerDependencyEquiv (observerDependencyEQ) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  observerDependencyEquiv {
    \schemaVar \formula  t1;
    \schemaVar \formula  t2;

    \find(t1 <-> t2)
    \inSequentState
    \varcond(\sameObserver (t1, t2))
    \replacewith(true);
    \add(==> #ObserverEquality(t1, t2))
    \displayname "observerDependencyEQ"
  };
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== onlyCreatedObjectsAreInLocSets (onlyCreatedObjectsAreInLocSets) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  onlyCreatedObjectsAreInLocSets {
    \schemaVar \term Field f;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term Pair<java.lang.Object,Field> l;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;

    \assumes(wellFormed(h) ==>)
    \find(
       elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(l,
                                               select<Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>>(h,
                                                                                         o,
                                                                                         f))
      ==>
    )
    \add(
         first<java.lang.Object, Field>(l) = null
       |   select<boolean>(h,
                           first<java.lang.Object, Field>(l),
                           java.lang.Object::#$created)
         = TRUE
      ==>
    )
    \heuristics(inReachableStateImplication)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== onlyCreatedObjectsAreInLocSetsEQ (onlyCreatedObjectsAreInLocSetsEQ) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  onlyCreatedObjectsAreInLocSetsEQ {
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> EQ;
    \schemaVar \term Field f;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term Pair<java.lang.Object,Field> l;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;

    \assumes(
       wellFormed(h),
         select<Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>>(h,
                                                   o,
                                                   f)
       = EQ
      ==>
    )
    \find(
      elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(l, EQ)
      ==>
    )
    \add(
         first<java.lang.Object, Field>(l) = null
       |   select<boolean>(h,
                           first<java.lang.Object, Field>(l),
                           java.lang.Object::#$created)
         = TRUE
      ==>
    )
    \heuristics(inReachableStateImplication)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== onlyCreatedObjectsAreInLocSetsFinal (onlyCreatedObjectsAreInLocSetsFinal) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  onlyCreatedObjectsAreInLocSetsFinal {
    \schemaVar \term Field f;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term Pair<java.lang.Object,Field> l;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;

    \assumes(wellFormed(h) ==>)
    \find(
       elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(l,
                                               final<Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>>(o,
                                                                                        f))
      ==>
    )
    \add(

\rules (reach:on) {

    \schemaVar \term Heap h;

      ==>
    )

  };

    ==>
  )

== polyDiv_pullOut (polyDiv_pullOut) =========================================
polyDiv_pullOut {
  \schemaVar \term int divDenom;
  \schemaVar \term int divNum;
  \schemaVar \term int polyDivCoeff;

  \find(div(divNum, divDenom))

  \replacewith(
    \if (divDenom = Z(0(#)))
        \then (div(divNum, Z(0(#))))
        \else (add(div(add(divNum,
                           mul(mul(polyDivCoeff,
                                   Z(neglit(1(#)))),
                               divDenom)),
                       divDenom),
                   polyDivCoeff))
  )
  \heuristics(
    defOps_divModPullOut,
    notHumanReadable,
    polyDivision)
}

polyMod_ltdivDenom {
  \schemaVar \term int divDenom;
  \schemaVar \term int divNum;

  \find(mod(divNum, divDenom))

  \add(
       (   gt(divDenom, Z(0(#)))
        -> lt(mod(divNum, divDenom), divDenom))
     & (   lt(divDenom, Z(0(#)))
        -> lt(mod(divNum, divDenom), neg(divDenom)))
    ==>
  )
}

  \schemaVar \term int cpLeft2;
  \schemaVar \term int cpRight1;
  \schemaVar \term int cpRight2;

  \assumes(cpLeft1 = cpRight1 ==>)
  \find(cpLeft2 = cpRight2 ==>)
  \add(
       add(mul(#divideLCRMonomials(cpLeft2, cpLeft1),
               add(mul(Z(neglit(1(#))), cpRight1),
                   cpLeft1)),
           mul(#divideLCRMonomials(cpLeft1, cpLeft2),
               add(cpRight2,
                   mul(Z(neglit(1(#))), cpLeft2))))
     = Z(0(#))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(
    notHumanReadable,

  \find(lt(Z(0(#)), i0) -> mul(i0, i1) = Z(1(#)))

  \replacewith(i0 = Z(1(#)) & i1 = Z(1(#)))
}

== postdecrement (postdecrement) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  postdecrement {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs1--;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..

        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_expression)
  };

== postdecrement_array (postdecrement_array) =========================================

      diamond_transaction

       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..

         ... }\endmodality post
    )

        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_expression)
  };

         Z(neglit(9(4(6(3(8(4(7(4(1(2(#)))))))))))))

  \heuristics(simplify)

== powAdd (powAdd) =========================================
powAdd {
  \schemaVar \term int base;
  \schemaVar \term int exp;
  \schemaVar \term int exp_2;

  \find(pow(base, add(exp, exp_2)))

  \replacewith(
    \if (geq(exp, Z(0(#))) & geq(exp_2, Z(0(#))))
        \then (mul(pow(base, exp), pow(base, exp_2)))
        \else (pow(base, add(exp, exp_2)))
  )
}

== powDef (powDef) =========================================
powDef {
  \schemaVar \term int base;
  \schemaVar \term int exp;
  \schemaVar \variables int i;

  \find(pow(base, exp))

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(i, base), \notFreeIn(i, exp))
  \replacewith(
    \if (geq(exp, Z(0(#))))
        \then (bprod{i;}(Z(0(#)), exp, base))
        \else (undefinedPow(base, exp))
  )
}

== powIsInfinite1 (powIsInfinite1) =========================================
powIsInfinite1 {
  \schemaVar \term double arg1;
  \schemaVar \term double arg2;

  \find(powDouble(arg1, arg2))

  \add(
          (  geqDouble(arg1,
                       DFP(8(0(4(7(1(0(0(0(8(8(1(4(2(8(1(7(0(6(4(#)))))))))))))))))))))
           | leqDouble(arg1,
                       negDouble(DFP(8(0(4(7(1(0(0(0(8(8(1(4(2(8(1(7(0(6(4(#)))))))))))))))))))))))
        & doubleIsInfinite(arg2)
        & gtDouble(arg2, DFP(0(#)))
      | ltDouble(arg1,
                 DFP(8(0(4(7(1(0(0(0(8(8(1(4(2(8(1(7(0(6(4(#)))))))))))))))))))))
      & gtDouble(arg1,
                 negDouble(DFP(8(0(4(7(1(0(0(0(8(8(1(4(2(8(1(7(0(6(4(#))))))))))))))))))))))
      & doubleIsInfinite(arg2)
      & ltDouble(arg2, DFP(0(#)))
     ->   doubleIsInfinite(powDouble(arg1, arg2))
        & gtDouble(powDouble(arg1, arg2), DFP(0(#)))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}

      & gtDouble(arg2, DFP(0(#)))
     ->   doubleIsInfinite(powDouble(arg1, arg2))
        & gtDouble(powDouble(arg1, arg2), DFP(0(#)))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}

== powSplitFactor (powSplitFactor) =========================================

  \schemaVar \term int base;
  \schemaVar \term int exp;

  \find(pow(base, exp))

  \replacewith(
    \if (geq(exp, Z(0(#))))
        \then (\if (geq(exp, Z(1(#))))
                   \then (mul(base,
                              pow(base,
                                  sub(exp, Z(1(#))))))
                   \else (Z(1(#))))
        \else (undefinedPow(base, exp))
  )

  \schemaVar \term numbers jz;

  \find(pow(Z(iz), Z(jz)))

  \replacewith(#pow(Z(iz), Z(jz)))
  \heuristics(nonDuplicateAppCheckEq, simplify_literals)
}

  \schemaVar \term double d2;

  \heuristics(simplify)

  \schemaVar \term int b;

-----------------------------------------------------
== precOfPair (precOfPair) =========================================
precOfPair {
  \schemaVar \term S1 a1;
  \schemaVar \term S2 a2;
  \schemaVar \term S3 b1;
  \schemaVar \term S4 b2;

  \find(
    prec(pair<S1, S3>(a1, b1), pair<S2, S4>(a2, b2))
  )

  \replacewith(prec(a1, a2) | a1 = a2 & prec(b1, b2))
  \heuristics(simplify)
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== precOfSeq (precOfSeq) =========================================
precOfSeq {
  \schemaVar \variables int iv;
  \schemaVar \variables int jv;
  \schemaVar \term Seq s1;
  \schemaVar \term Seq s2;

  \find(prec(s1, s2))

  \varcond(
    \notFreeIn(iv, s1),
    \notFreeIn(iv, s2),
    \notFreeIn(jv, s1),
    \notFreeIn(jv, s2)
  )
  \replacewith(
        seqLen(s1) = seqLen(s2)
      & \exists iv;
          (  leq(Z(0(#)), iv)
           & lt(iv, seqLen(s1))
           & prec(seqGet<any>(s1, iv),
                  seqGet<any>(s2, iv))
           & \forall jv;
               (   leq(Z(0(#)), jv) & lt(jv, iv)
                ->   seqGet<any>(s1, jv)
                   = seqGet<any>(s2, jv)))
    | lt(seqLen(s1), seqLen(s2))
  )
}

== predecrement (predecrement) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  predecrement {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs1;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           --#lhs1;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #lhs1 = (#typeof(#lhs1)) (#lhs1 - 1);
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_expression)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== predecrement_array (predecrement_array) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  predecrement_array {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #e0;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           --#e[#e0];
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\newTypeOf(#v, #e), \newTypeOf(#v0, #e0))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #typeof(#e) #v = #e;
          #typeof(#e0) #v0 = #e0;
          #v[#v0] = (#typeof(#e[#e0])) (#v[#v0] - 1);
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_expression)
  };
}

== pseqCountDef (pseqCountDef) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqCountDef {
    \schemaVar \term E e;
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s;

    \find(pseqCount<E>(s, e))

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(iv, e), \notFreeIn(iv, s))
    \replacewith(
      bsum{iv;}(Z(0(#)),
                pseqLen<E>(s),
                \if (pseqGet<E>(s, iv) = e)
                    \then (Z(1(#)))
                    \else (Z(0(#))))
    )
  };
}

== pseqCountOfPSeqConcat (pseqCountOfPSeqConcat) =========================================

    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s2;

    \find(pseqCount<E>(pseqConcat<E>(s1, s2), e))

    \replacewith(
      add(pseqCount<E>(s1, e), pseqCount<E>(s2, e))
    )
    \heuristics(seqCountSimp)
  };
}

== pseqCountOfPSeqUpd (pseqCountOfPSeqUpd) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqCountOfPSeqUpd {
    \schemaVar \term E e;
    \schemaVar \term int i;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s;
    \schemaVar \term E x;

    \find(pseqCount<E>(pseqUpd<E>(s, i, x), e))

    \replacewith(
      add(pseqCount<E>(s, e),
          \if (leq(Z(0(#)), i) & lt(i, pseqLen<E>(s)))
              \then (sub(\if (x = e)
                             \then (Z(1(#)))
                             \else (Z(0(#))),
                         \if (pseqGet<E>(s, i) = e)
                             \then (Z(1(#)))
                             \else (Z(0(#)))))
              \else (Z(0(#))))
    )
    \heuristics(seqCountSimp)
  };
}

== pseqDefOfEmpty (pseqDefOfEmpty) =========================================

    \schemaVar \term E te;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(uSub, te))
    \replacewith(pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(Z(0(#)), Z(0(#)), te))

-----------------------------------------------------
== pseqDefOfPSeq (pseqDefOfPSeq) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqDefOfPSeq {
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s;
    \schemaVar \variables int u;
    \schemaVar \variables int v;
    \schemaVar \term int x;

    \find(pseqDef<E>{u;}(Z(0(#)), x, pseqGet<E>(s, u)))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(u, s),
      \notFreeIn(u, x),
      \notFreeIn(v, s),
      \notFreeIn(v, x)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \if (pseqLen<E>(s) = x)
          \then (s)
          \else (\if (gt(pseqLen<E>(s), x))
                     \then (pseqSub<E>(s, Z(0(#)), x))
                     \else (pseqConcat<E>(s,
                                          pseqDef<E>{v;}(pseqLen<E>(s),
                                                         x,
                                                         pseqGetOutside<E>))))
    )
    \heuristics(seqSimplifyEnlarging)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== pseqDef_empty (pseqDef_empty) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqDef_empty {
    \schemaVar \term int from;
    \schemaVar \term int idx;
    \schemaVar \term E t;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(from, idx, t))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, from),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, idx)
    )
    "Precondition":
      \add(==> leq(idx, from));
    "Empty SeqDef":
      \replacewith(pseqEmpty<E>)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== pseqDef_induction_lower (pseqDef_induction_lower) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqDef_induction_lower {
    \schemaVar \term int from;
    \schemaVar \term E t;
    \schemaVar \term int to;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(from, to, t))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, from),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, to)
    )
    \replacewith(
      pseqConcat<E>(\if (lt(from, to))
                        \then (pseqSingleton<E>({\subst uSub;from}
                                                  t))
                        \else (pseqEmpty<E>),
                    pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(add(from, Z(1(#))),
                                      to,
                                      t))
    )
  };
}

== pseqDef_induction_lower_concrete (pseqDef_induction_lower_concrete) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqDef_induction_lower_concrete {
    \schemaVar \term int from;
    \schemaVar \term E t;
    \schemaVar \term int to;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;

    \find(
       pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(add(Z(neglit(1(#))), from),
                         to,
                         t)
    )

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, from),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, to)
    )
    \replacewith(
      pseqConcat<E>(\if (lt(add(Z(neglit(1(#))), from),
                            to))
                        \then (pseqSingleton<E>({\subst uSub;add(Z(neglit(1(#))),
                                                                 from)}
                                                  t))
                        \else (pseqEmpty<E>),
                    pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(from, to, t))
    )
    \heuristics(seqSimplify)
  };
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== pseqDef_split (pseqDef_split) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqDef_split {
    \schemaVar \term int from;
    \schemaVar \term int idx;
    \schemaVar \term E t;
    \schemaVar \term int to;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub1;

    \find(pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(from, to, t))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, from),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, idx),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, to),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, from),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, idx),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, t),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, to)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \if (leq(from, idx) & lt(idx, to))
          \then (pseqConcat<E>(pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(from,
                                                 idx,
                                                 t),
                               pseqDef<E>{uSub1;}(idx,
                                                  to,
                                                  {\subst uSub;uSub1}
                                                    t)))
          \else (pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(from, to, t))
    )
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== pseqDef_split_in_three (pseqDef_split_in_three) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqDef_split_in_three {
    \schemaVar \term int from;
    \schemaVar \term int idx;
    \schemaVar \term E t;
    \schemaVar \term int to;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub1;

    \find(pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(from, to, t))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, from),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, idx),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, idx),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, t),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, to)
    )
    "Precondition":
      \add(==> leq(from, idx) & lt(idx, to));
    "Splitted SeqDef":
      \replacewith(
        pseqConcat<E>(pseqDef<E>{uSub;}(from, idx, t),
                      pseqConcat<E>(pseqSingleton<E>({\subst uSub;idx}
                                                       t),
                                    pseqDef<E>{uSub1;}(add(idx,
                                                           Z(1(#))),
                                                       to,
                                                       {\subst uSub;uSub1}
                                                         t)))
      )
  };
}

== pseqGetOfNPermInv (pseqGetOfNPermInv) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqGetOfNPermInv {
    \schemaVar \term int i3;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm int jsk;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<int> s1;

    \find(pseqGet<int>(pseqNPermInv(s1), i3))

    \varcond(\newDependingOn(jsk, i3))
    \replacewith(jsk)
    \add(
         pseqGet<int>(s1, jsk) = i3
       & leq(Z(0(#)), jsk)
       & lt(jsk, pseqLen<int>(s1))
      ==>
    );
    \add(
      ==>
         leq(Z(0(#)), i3)
       & lt(i3, pseqLen<int>(s1))
       & pseqNPerm(s1)
    )
    \heuristics(seqSimplify)
  };
}

    \varcond(\newDependingOn(jsk, i3))
    \replacewith(jsk)
    \add(
         pseqGet<int>(s1, jsk) = i3

  };

== pseqGetOfRemoveAny (pseqGetOfRemoveAny) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqGetOfRemoveAny {
    \schemaVar \term int i2;
    \schemaVar \term int i3;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s1;

    \find(pseqGet<E>(pseqRemove<E>(s1, i2), i3))

    \replacewith(
      \if (lt(i2, Z(0(#))) | leq(pseqLen<E>(s1), i2))
          \then (pseqGet<E>(s1, i3))
          \else (\if (lt(i3, i2))
                     \then (pseqGet<E>(s1, i3))
                     \else (\if (  leq(i2, i3)
                                 & lt(i3,
                                      sub(pseqLen<E>(s1),
                                          Z(1(#)))))
                                \then (pseqGet<E>(s1,
                                                  add(i3,
                                                      Z(1(#)))))
                                \else (pseqGetOutside<E>)))
    )
    \heuristics(seqRead)
  };
}

== pseqGetOfSwap (pseqGetOfSwap) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqGetOfSwap {
    \schemaVar \term int idx;
    \schemaVar \term int iv;
    \schemaVar \term int jv;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s1;

    \find(pseqGet<E>(pseqSwap<E>(s1, iv, jv), idx))

    \replacewith(
      \if (!(  leq(Z(0(#)), iv)
             & leq(Z(0(#)), jv)
             & lt(iv, pseqLen<E>(s1))
             & lt(jv, pseqLen<E>(s1))))
          \then (pseqGet<E>(s1, idx))
          \else (\if (idx = iv)
                     \then (pseqGet<E>(s1, jv))
                     \else (\if (idx = jv)
                                \then (pseqGet<E>(s1, iv))
                                \else (pseqGet<E>(s1,
                                                  idx))))
    )
    \heuristics(seqRead)
  };
}

== pseqIndexOf (pseqIndexOf) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqIndexOf {
    \schemaVar \variables int m;
    \schemaVar \variables int n;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s;
    \schemaVar \term E t;

    \find(pseqIndexOf<E>(s, t))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(m, s),
      \notFreeIn(m, t),
      \notFreeIn(n, s),
      \notFreeIn(n, t)
    )
    \add(
          \exists n;
            (  leq(Z(0(#)), n)
             & lt(n, pseqLen<E>(s))
             & pseqGet<E>(s, n) = t)
       ->   leq(Z(0(#)), pseqIndexOf<E>(s, t))
          & lt(pseqIndexOf<E>(s, t), pseqLen<E>(s))
          & pseqGet<E>(s, pseqIndexOf<E>(s, t)) = t
          & \forall m;
              (     leq(Z(0(#)), m)
                  & lt(m, pseqIndexOf<E>(s, t))
               -> !pseqGet<E>(s, m) = t)
      ==>
    )
  };
}

  pseqNPermInjective {

    \schemaVar \variables int jv;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<int> s;

    \find(pseqNPerm(s) ==>)
    \varcond(\notFreeIn(iv, s), \notFreeIn(jv, s))
    \add(
       \forall iv;
         \forall jv;
           (     leq(Z(0(#)), iv)
               & lt(iv, pseqLen<int>(s))
               & leq(Z(0(#)), jv)
               & lt(jv, pseqLen<int>(s))
               &   pseqGet<int>(s, iv)
                 = pseqGet<int>(s, jv)
            -> iv = jv)
      ==>
    )
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== pseqNPermInjectiveOnGet (pseqNPermInjectiveOnGet) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqNPermInjectiveOnGet {
    \schemaVar \term int i;
    \schemaVar \term int j;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<int> s;

    \assumes(pseqNPerm(s) ==>)
    \find(pseqGet<int>(s, i) = pseqGet<int>(s, j))

    \add(
            leq(Z(0(#)), i)
          & lt(i, pseqLen<int>(s))
          & leq(Z(0(#)), j)
          & lt(j, pseqLen<int>(s))
          & pseqGet<int>(s, i) = pseqGet<int>(s, j)
       -> i = j
      ==>
    )
    \heuristics(seqNPermProperties)
  };
}

== pseqNPermRange (pseqNPermRange) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqNPermRange {
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<int> s;

    \find(pseqNPerm(s) ==>)
    \varcond(\notFreeIn(iv, s))
    \add(
       \forall iv;
         (   leq(Z(0(#)), iv) & lt(iv, pseqLen<int>(s))
          ->   leq(Z(0(#)), pseqGet<int>(s, iv))
             & lt(pseqGet<int>(s, iv), pseqLen<int>(s))
             & instance<int>(pseqGet<int>(s, iv)) = TRUE)
      ==>
    )
  };
}

  pseqNPermRight {
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \variables int jv;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<int> s;

    \find(==> pseqNPerm(s))
    \varcond(\notFreeIn(iv, s), \notFreeIn(jv, s))

         \forall iv;

             (     leq(Z(0(#)), iv)
                 & lt(iv, pseqLen<int>(s))
                 & leq(Z(0(#)), jv)
                 & lt(jv, pseqLen<int>(s))
                 &   pseqGet<int>(s, iv)
                   = pseqGet<int>(s, jv)
              -> iv = jv)
       & \forall iv;
           (   leq(Z(0(#)), iv) & lt(iv, pseqLen<int>(s))
            ->   leq(Z(0(#)), pseqGet<int>(s, iv))
               & lt(pseqGet<int>(s, iv), pseqLen<int>(s)))
       & \forall iv;
           (   leq(Z(0(#)), iv) & lt(iv, pseqLen<int>(s))
            -> instance<int>(pseqGet<int>(s, iv)) = TRUE)
    )
  };

-----------------------------------------------------
== pseqPermCountsInt (pseqPermCountsInt) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqPermCountsInt {
    \schemaVar \variables E element;
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s1;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s2;

    \find(pseqPerm<E>(s1, s2))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(element, s1),
      \notFreeIn(element, s2),
      \notFreeIn(iv, s1),
      \notFreeIn(iv, s2)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \forall element;
          bsum{iv;}(Z(0(#)),
                    pseqLen<E>(s1),
                    \if (pseqGet<E>(s1, iv) = element)
                        \then (Z(1(#)))
                        \else (Z(0(#))))
        = bsum{iv;}(Z(0(#)),
                    pseqLen<E>(s2),
                    \if (pseqGet<E>(s2, iv) = element)
                        \then (Z(1(#)))
                        \else (Z(0(#))))
    )
  };
}

== pseqPermDef (pseqPermDef) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqPermDef {
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \variables PSeq<int> s;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s1;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s2;

    \find(pseqPerm<E>(s1, s2))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(iv, s1),
      \notFreeIn(iv, s2),
      \notFreeIn(s, s1),
      \notFreeIn(s, s2)
    )
    \replacewith(
        pseqLen<E>(s1) = pseqLen<E>(s2)
      & \exists s;
          (  pseqLen<int>(s) = pseqLen<E>(s1)
           & pseqNPerm(s)
           & \forall iv;
               (     leq(Z(0(#)), iv)
                   & lt(iv, pseqLen<int>(s))
                ->   pseqGet<E>(s1, iv)
                   = pseqGet<E>(s2, pseqGet<int>(s, iv))))
    )
  };
}

== pseqPermExists (pseqPermExists) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqPermExists {
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \formula  phi;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s1;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s2;
    \schemaVar \variables E x;

    \assumes(pseqPerm<E>(s1, s2) ==>)
    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(iv, phi),
      \notFreeIn(iv, s1),
      \notFreeIn(iv, s2)
    )
    \add(
           \exists iv;
             (  leq(Z(0(#)), iv)
              & lt(iv, pseqLen<E>(s1))
              & {\subst x;pseqGet<E>(s1, iv)}phi)
       <-> \exists iv;
             (  leq(Z(0(#)), iv)
              & lt(iv, pseqLen<E>(s1))
              & {\subst x;pseqGet<E>(s2, iv)}phi)
      ==>
    )
  };
}

== pseqPermFromSwap (pseqPermFromSwap) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqPermFromSwap {
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \variables int jv;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s1;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s2;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> t1;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> t2;

    \find(==> pseqPerm<E>(s2, t2))
    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(iv, s1),
      \notFreeIn(iv, s2),
      \notFreeIn(iv, t1),
      \notFreeIn(iv, t2),
      \notFreeIn(jv, s1),
      \notFreeIn(jv, s2),
      \notFreeIn(jv, t1),
      \notFreeIn(jv, t2)
    )
    \replacewith(
      ==>
         t1 = t2
       & \exists iv;
           \exists jv;
             (  leq(Z(0(#)), iv)
              & leq(Z(0(#)), jv)
              & lt(iv, pseqLen<E>(s2))
              & lt(jv, pseqLen<E>(s2))
              & s1 = pseqSwap<E>(s2, iv, jv))
    )
  };

== pseqSwapPreservesPSeqPermEQ (pseqSwapPreservesPSeqPermEQ) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqSwapPreservesPSeqPermEQ {
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> EQ;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s;
    \schemaVar \term int x;
    \schemaVar \term int y;

    \assumes(pseqSwap<E>(s, x, y) = EQ ==>)
    \find(==> pseqPerm<E>(s, EQ))
    \add(
      ==>
         leq(Z(0(#)), x)
       & lt(x, pseqLen<E>(s))
       & leq(Z(0(#)), y)
       & lt(y, pseqLen<E>(s))
    )
    \heuristics(seqSimplifyEnlarging)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== pseqnormalizeDef (pseqnormalizeDef) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  pseqnormalizeDef {
    \schemaVar \term int le;
    \schemaVar \term int ri;
    \schemaVar \term E t;
    \schemaVar \variables int u;

    \find(pseqDef<E>{u;}(le, ri, t))

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(u, le), \notFreeIn(u, ri))
    \replacewith(
      \if (lt(le, ri))
          \then (pseqDef<E>{u;}(Z(0(#)),
                                sub(ri, le),
                                {\subst u;add(u, le)}t))
          \else (pseqEmpty<E>)
    )
  };
}

== pullOut (pullOut) =========================================
pullOut {
  \schemaVar \skolemTerm G sk;
  \schemaVar \term G t;

  \find(t)

  \varcond(\newDependingOn(sk, t))
  \replacewith(sk)
  \add(t = sk ==>)
  \heuristics(pull_out_heap)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== pullOutSelect (pullOutSelect) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  pullOutSelect {
    \schemaVar \term Field f;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm beta selectSK;

    \find(select<beta>(h, o, f))

    \replacewith(selectSK<<selectSK>>)
    \add(
      select<beta>(h, o, f) = selectSK<<selectSK>>
      ==>
    )
    \heuristics(pull_out_select)
  };
}

== pullOutbsum1 (pullOutbsum1) =========================================
\rules (integerSimplificationRules:full) {
  pullOutbsum1 {
    \schemaVar \term int i0;
    \schemaVar \term int i1;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm int sk;
    \schemaVar \term int t;
    \schemaVar \term int t1;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub1;

    \find(geq(bsum{uSub1;}(i0, i1, t1), t) ==>)
    \varcond(
      \newDependingOn(sk, i0),
      \newDependingOn(sk, i1),
      \newDependingOn(sk, t1)
    )
    \replacewith(geq(sk, t) ==>)
    \add(bsum{uSub1;}(i0, i1, t1) = sk ==>)
  };
}

== reachAddOne (reachAddOne) =========================================
\rules (reach:on) {
  reachAddOne {
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term int n;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o2;
    \schemaVar \variables java.lang.Object ov;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s;

    \find(reach(h, s, o, o2, add(Z(1(#)), n)))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(ov, h),
      \notFreeIn(ov, n),
      \notFreeIn(ov, o),
      \notFreeIn(ov, o2),
      \notFreeIn(ov, s)
    )
    \replacewith(
        geq(n, Z(neglit(1(#))))
      & !o = null
      & !o2 = null
      & (  n = Z(neglit(1(#))) & o = o2
         | \exists ov;
             (reach(h, s, o, ov, n) & acc(h, s, ov, o2)))
    )
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}

                                                                                          fv),

               & elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(ov,
                                                                                       fv),

== reachEndOfUniquePath (reachEndOfUniquePath) =========================================
\rules (reach:on) {
  reachEndOfUniquePath {
    \schemaVar \term Field f;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term int n;
    \schemaVar \term int n2;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o2;

    \heuristics(inReachableStateImplication)
  };
}

== reach_does_not_depend_on_fresh_locs (reach_does_not_depend_on_fresh_locs) =========================================
\rules (reach:on) {
  reach_does_not_depend_on_fresh_locs {
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h2;
    \schemaVar \term int n;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o2;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s;

    \assumes(==> o = null)
    \find(
       reach(anon(h,
                  empty<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>,
                  h2),
             s,
             o,
             o2,
             n)
    )

    \replacewith(reach(h, s, o, o2, n));
    \add(
      ==>
         wellFormed(h)
       &   select<boolean>(h,
                           o,
                           java.lang.Object::#$created)
         = TRUE
    )
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== reach_does_not_depend_on_fresh_locsEQ (reach_does_not_depend_on_fresh_locsEQ) =========================================
\rules (reach:on) {
  reach_does_not_depend_on_fresh_locsEQ {
    \schemaVar \term Heap EQ;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h2;
    \schemaVar \term int n;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o2;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s;

    \assumes(
         anon(h, empty<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>, h2)
       = EQ
      ==> o = null
    )
    \find(reach(EQ, s, o, o2, n))

    \replacewith(reach(h, s, o, o2, n));
    \add(
      ==>
         wellFormed(h)
       &   select<boolean>(h,
                           o,
                           java.lang.Object::#$created)
         = TRUE
    )
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}
