== reference_type_cast (reference_type_cast) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & runtimeExceptions:ban) {
  reference_type_cast {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program LeftHandSide #lhs;
    \schemaVar \program NonPrimitiveType #npit;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
      ==>
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lhs = (#npit) #se;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \varcond(
      \hasSort(#npit, G),
      \not\sub(\typeof(#se), G)
    )
    "Normal Execution (#se instanceof #npit)":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
         {#lhs:=#addCast(#se, #lhs)}
           \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
      );
    "ClassCastException (!(#se instanceof #npit))":
      \replacewith(==> false)
      \add(==> #se = null | instance<G>(#se) = TRUE)
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

== regExConcatAxiom (regExConcatAxiom) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  regExConcatAxiom {
    \schemaVar \variables int endIdx;
    \schemaVar \term RegEx rexp1;
    \schemaVar \term RegEx rexp2;
    \schemaVar \term Seq string;

    \find(match(regExConcat(rexp1, rexp2), string))

         & leq(endIdx, seqLen(string))

         & match(rexp2,
                 seqSub(string, endIdx, seqLen(string))))

    \heuristics(simplify)
  };

== regExConcatRepeatLeft (regExConcatRepeatLeft) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  regExConcatRepeatLeft {
    \schemaVar \term int nTimes;
    \schemaVar \term RegEx rexp1;
    \schemaVar \term RegEx rexp2;
    \schemaVar \term Seq string;
    \schemaVar \variables Seq string1;
    \schemaVar \variables Seq string2;

    \find(
       match(regExConcat(repeat(rexp1, nTimes), rexp2),
             string)
    )

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(string1, nTimes),
      \notFreeIn(string1, rexp1),
      \notFreeIn(string1, rexp2),
      \notFreeIn(string1, string),
      \notFreeIn(string2, nTimes),
      \notFreeIn(string2, rexp1),
      \notFreeIn(string2, rexp2),
      \notFreeIn(string2, string)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \if (nTimes = Z(0(#)))
          \then (match(rexp2, string))
          \else (\if (lt(nTimes, Z(0(#))))
                     \then (false)
                     \else (\exists string1;
                              \exists string2;
                                (  match(repeat(rexp1,
                                                nTimes),
                                         string1)
                                 & match(rexp2, string2)
                                 &   string
                                   = seqConcat(string1,
                                               string2))))
    )
    \heuristics(simplify)
  };
}

== repeatAxiom (repeatAxiom) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  repeatAxiom {
    \schemaVar \variables int endIdx;
    \schemaVar \term int nTimes;
    \schemaVar \term RegEx rexp;
    \schemaVar \term Seq string;

    \find(match(repeat(rexp, nTimes), string))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(endIdx, nTimes),
      \notFreeIn(endIdx, rexp),
      \notFreeIn(endIdx, string)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \if (lt(nTimes, Z(0(#))))
          \then (false)
          \else (\if (nTimes = Z(0(#)))
                     \then (string = empty<any>)
                     \else (\exists endIdx;
                              (  geq(endIdx, Z(0(#)))
                               & leq(endIdx,
                                     seqLen(string))
                               & match(rexp,
                                       seqSub(string,
                                              Z(0(#)),
                                              endIdx))
                               & match(repeat(rexp,
                                              sub(nTimes,
                                                  Z(1(#)))),
                                       seqSub(string,
                                              endIdx,
                                              seqLen(string))))))
    )
  };
}

== replaceConcat (replaceConcat) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  replaceConcat {
    \schemaVar \term Seq leftStr;
    \schemaVar \term int replaceChar;
    \schemaVar \term Seq rightStr;
    \schemaVar \term int searchChar;

    \find(
       clReplace(seqConcat(leftStr, rightStr),
                 searchChar,
                 replaceChar)
    )

    \replacewith(
      seqConcat(clReplace(leftStr,
                          searchChar,
                          replaceChar),
                clReplace(rightStr,
                          searchChar,
                          replaceChar))
    )
    \heuristics(stringsMoveReplaceInside)
  };
}

== replaceCons (replaceCons) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  replaceCons {
    \schemaVar \term int fstChar;
    \schemaVar \term int replChar;
    \schemaVar \term int searchChar;
    \schemaVar \term Seq str;

    \find(
       clReplace(seqConcat(seqSingleton(fstChar), str),
                 searchChar,
                 replChar)
    )

    \replacewith(
      \if (searchChar = fstChar)
          \then (seqConcat(seqSingleton(replChar),
                           clReplace(str,
                                     searchChar,
                                     replChar)))
          \else (seqConcat(seqSingleton(fstChar),
                           clReplace(str,
                                     searchChar,
                                     replChar)))
    )
    \heuristics(defOpsReplaceInline)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== replaceDef (replaceDef) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  replaceDef {
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm Seq newSym;
    \schemaVar \variables int pos;
    \schemaVar \term int replChar;
    \schemaVar \term int searchChar;
    \schemaVar \term Seq str;

    \find(clReplace(str, searchChar, replChar))

    \varcond(
      \newDependingOn(newSym, replChar),
      \newDependingOn(newSym, searchChar),
      \newDependingOn(newSym, str),
      \notFreeIn(pos, replChar),
      \notFreeIn(pos, searchChar),
      \notFreeIn(pos, str)
    )
    \add(
         clReplace(str, searchChar, replChar) = newSym
       &   seqDef{pos;}(Z(0(#)),
                        seqLen(str),
                        \if (  seqGet<int>(str, pos)
                             = searchChar)
                            \then (replChar)
                            \else (seqGet<int>(str, pos)))
         = newSym
      ==>
    )
    \heuristics(defOpsReplace, stringsIntroduceNewSym)
  };
}

== replaceSubstring (replaceSubstring) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  replaceSubstring {
    \schemaVar \term int endIdx;
    \schemaVar \term int replaceChar;
    \schemaVar \term int searchChar;
    \schemaVar \term int startIdx;
    \schemaVar \term Seq str;
    \schemaVar \term Seq subStr;

    \assumes(seqSub(str, startIdx, endIdx) = subStr ==>)
    \find(clReplace(subStr, searchChar, replaceChar))

    \replacewith(
      \if (  geq(startIdx, Z(0(#)))
           & geq(endIdx, startIdx)
           & leq(endIdx, seqLen(str)))
          \then (seqSub(clReplace(str,
                                  searchChar,
                                  replaceChar),
                        startIdx,
                        endIdx))
          \else (clReplace(subStr,
                           searchChar,
                           replaceChar))
    )
    \heuristics(stringsMoveReplaceInside)
  };
}

== returnUnfold (returnUnfold) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  returnUnfold {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program NonSimpleExpression #nse;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           return #nse;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\newTypeOf(#v0, #nse))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #typeof(#nse) #v0 = #nse;
          return #v0;
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

== sameTypeFalse (sameTypeFalse) =========================================
sameTypeFalse {
  \schemaVar \term any x1;
  \schemaVar \term any x2;

  \assumes(
     exactInstance<G>(x1) = TRUE,
     exactInstance<H>(x2) = TRUE
    ==>
  )
  \find(sameType(x1, x2))

  \varcond(\not\same(G, H))
  \replacewith(false)
  \heuristics(concrete)
}

== same_boxes_left (same_boxes_left) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  same_boxes_left {
    \schemaVar \program Statement #s;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;
    \schemaVar \formula  post1;

    \assumes(
       \[{ ..
           #s
         ... }\] post
      ==>
    )
    \find(
       \[{ ..
           #s
         ... }\] post1
      ==>
    )
    \add(
       \[{ ..
           #s
         ... }\] (post & post1)
      ==>
    )
  };
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== schiffl_lemma_2 (schiffl_lemma_2) =========================================
schiffl_lemma_2 {
  \schemaVar \variables int iv;
  \schemaVar \variables Seq r;
  \schemaVar \term Seq s;
  \schemaVar \term Seq t;
  \schemaVar \variables int x;
  \schemaVar \variables int y;

  \find(seqPerm(s, t) ==>)
  \varcond(
    \notFreeIn(iv, s),
    \notFreeIn(iv, t),
    \notFreeIn(r, s),
    \notFreeIn(r, t),
    \notFreeIn(x, s),
    \notFreeIn(x, t),
    \notFreeIn(y, s),
    \notFreeIn(y, t)
  )
  \add(
     \forall x;
       \forall y;
         (     seqGet<any>(s, x) = seqGet<any>(t, x)
             & seqGet<any>(s, y) = seqGet<any>(t, y)
             & leq(Z(0(#)), x)
             & lt(x, seqLen(s))
             & leq(Z(0(#)), y)
             & lt(y, seqLen(s))
          -> \exists r;
               (  seqLen(r) = seqLen(s)
                & seqNPerm(r)
                & \forall iv;
                    (     leq(Z(0(#)), iv)
                        & lt(iv, seqLen(s))
                     ->   seqGet<any>(s, iv)
                        = seqGet<any>(t,
                                      seqGet<int>(r,
                                                  iv)))
                & seqGet<int>(r, x) = x
                & seqGet<int>(r, y) = y))
    ==>
  )
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== schiffl_thm_1 (schiffl_thm_1) =========================================
schiffl_thm_1 {
  \schemaVar \term any a;
  \schemaVar \term any b;
  \schemaVar \variables int idx;
  \schemaVar \term Seq s;
  \schemaVar \term Seq t;
  \schemaVar \term int x;
  \schemaVar \term int y;

  \find(seqPerm(s, t) ==>)
  \varcond(
    \notFreeIn(idx, a),
    \notFreeIn(idx, b),
    \notFreeIn(idx, s),
    \notFreeIn(idx, t),
    \notFreeIn(idx, x),
    \notFreeIn(idx, y)
  )
  \add(
          seqPerm(s, t)
        & seqGet<any>(s, x) = seqGet<any>(t, x)
        & seqGet<any>(s, y) = seqGet<any>(t, y)
        & leq(Z(0(#)), x)
        & lt(x, seqLen(s))
        & leq(Z(0(#)), y)
        & lt(y, seqLen(s))
     -> seqPerm(seqDef{idx;}(Z(0(#)),
                             seqLen(s),
                             \if (idx = y)
                                 \then (b)
                                 \else (\if (idx = x)
                                            \then (a)
                                            \else (seqGet<any>(s,
                                                               idx)))),
                seqDef{idx;}(Z(0(#)),
                             seqLen(s),
                             \if (idx = y)
                                 \then (b)
                                 \else (\if (idx = x)
                                            \then (a)
                                            \else (seqGet<any>(t,
                                                               idx)))))
    ==>
  )
}

== selectCreatedOfAnon (selectCreatedOfAnon) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  selectCreatedOfAnon {
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h2;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s;

    \find(
       select<boolean>(anon(h, s, h2),
                       o,
                       java.lang.Object::#$created)
    )

    \replacewith(
      \if (  select<boolean>(h,
                             o,
                             java.lang.Object::#$created)
           = TRUE)
          \then (TRUE)
          \else (select<boolean>(h2,
                                 o,
                                 java.lang.Object::#$created))
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_heap_high_costs)
  };
}

== selectOfAnon (selectOfAnon) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  selectOfAnon {
    \schemaVar \term Field f;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h2;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s;

    \find(select<beta>(anon(h, s, h2), o, f))

    \replacewith(
      \if (    elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(o,
                                                                                     f),
                                                       s)
             & !f = java.lang.Object::#$created
           | elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(o,
                                                                                   f),
                                                     freshLocs(h)))
          \then (select<beta>(h2, o, f))
          \else (select<beta>(h, o, f))
    )
    \heuristics(semantics_blasting)
  };
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== seqConcatUnfoldLeft (seqConcatUnfold) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  seqConcatUnfoldLeft {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #eRight;
    \schemaVar \program NonSimpleExpression #nseLeft;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v;

== seqCountDef (seqCountDef) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  seqCountDef {
    \schemaVar \term any e;
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s;

    \find(seqCount(s, e))

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(iv, e), \notFreeIn(iv, s))
    \replacewith(
      bsum{iv;}(Z(0(#)),
                seqLen(s),
                \if (seqGet<any>(s, iv) = e)
                    \then (Z(1(#)))
                    \else (Z(0(#))))
    )
  };
}

== seqDefOfSeq (seqDefOfSeq) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  seqDefOfSeq {
    \schemaVar \term Seq s;
    \schemaVar \variables int u;
    \schemaVar \variables int v;
    \schemaVar \term int x;

    \find(seqDef{u;}(Z(0(#)), x, seqGet<any>(s, u)))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(u, s),
      \notFreeIn(u, x),
      \notFreeIn(v, s),
      \notFreeIn(v, x)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \if (seqLen(s) = x)
          \then (s)
          \else (\if (gt(seqLen(s), x))
                     \then (seqSub(s, Z(0(#)), x))
                     \else (seqConcat(s,
                                      seqDef{v;}(seqLen(s),
                                                 x,
                                                 seqGetOutside))))
    )
    \heuristics(seqSimplifyEnlarging)
  };
}

== seqDefOfStore (seqDefOfStore) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  seqDefOfStore {
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object a;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term int k;
    \schemaVar \term int l;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term int r;
    \schemaVar \variables int u;
    \schemaVar \term any x;

    \find(
       seqDef{u;}(l,
                  r,
                  select<any>(store(h, o, arr(k), x),
                              a,
                              arr(u)))
    )

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(u, a),
      \notFreeIn(u, h),
      \notFreeIn(u, k),
      \notFreeIn(u, o),
      \notFreeIn(u, x)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \if (o = a & leq(l, k) & lt(k, r))
          \then (seqUpd(seqDef{u;}(l,
                                   r,
                                   select<any>(h,
                                               a,
                                               arr(u))),
                        sub(k, l),
                        x))
          \else (seqDef{u;}(l,
                            r,
                            select<any>(h, a, arr(u))))
    )
    \heuristics(seqDefStore)
  };
}

== seqDef_split (seqDef_split) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  seqDef_split {
    \schemaVar \term int from;
    \schemaVar \term int idx;
    \schemaVar \term any t;
    \schemaVar \term int to;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub;
    \schemaVar \variables int uSub1;

    \find(seqDef{uSub;}(from, to, t))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(uSub, from),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, idx),
      \notFreeIn(uSub, to),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, from),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, idx),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, t),
      \notFreeIn(uSub1, to)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \if (leq(from, idx) & lt(idx, to))
          \then (seqConcat(seqDef{uSub;}(from, idx, t),
                           seqDef{uSub1;}(idx,
                                          to,
                                          {\subst uSub;uSub1}
                                            t)))
          \else (seqDef{uSub;}(from, to, t))
    )
  };
}

                                               Z(1(#))),
                                           to,
                                           {\subst uSub;uSub1}
                                             t)))
      )
  };

== seqIndexOf (seqIndexOf) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  seqIndexOf {
    \schemaVar \variables int m;
    \schemaVar \variables int n;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s;
    \schemaVar \term any t;

    \find(seqIndexOf(s, t))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(m, s),
      \notFreeIn(m, t),
      \notFreeIn(n, s),
      \notFreeIn(n, t)
    )
    \add(
          \exists n;
            (  leq(Z(0(#)), n)
             & lt(n, seqLen(s))
             & seqGet<any>(s, n) = t)
       ->   leq(Z(0(#)), seqIndexOf(s, t))
          & lt(seqIndexOf(s, t), seqLen(s))
          & seqGet<any>(s, seqIndexOf(s, t)) = t
          & \forall m;
              (     leq(Z(0(#)), m)
                  & lt(m, seqIndexOf(s, t))
               -> !seqGet<any>(s, m) = t)
      ==>
    )
  };
}

== seqNPermComp (seqNPermComp) =========================================

  seqNPermComp {
    \schemaVar \term Seq s1;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s2;
    \schemaVar \variables int u;

    \assumes(seqNPerm(s2) & seqLen(s1) = seqLen(s2) ==>)
    \find(seqNPerm(s1) ==>)
    \varcond(\notFreeIn(u, s1), \notFreeIn(u, s2))
    \add(
       seqNPerm(seqDef{u;}(Z(0(#)),
                           seqLen(s1),
                           seqGet<int>(s1,
                                       seqGet<int>(s2, u))))
      ==>
    )
  };

== seqNPermDefLeft (seqNPermDefLeft) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  seqNPermDefLeft {
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \variables int jv;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s1;

    \find(seqNPerm(s1) ==>)
    \varcond(\notFreeIn(iv, s1), \notFreeIn(jv, s1))
    \add(
       \forall iv;

      ==>
    )
  };
}

== seqNPermInjective (seqNPermInjective) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  seqNPermInjective {
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \variables int jv;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s;

    \find(seqNPerm(s) ==>)
    \varcond(\notFreeIn(iv, s), \notFreeIn(jv, s))
    \add(
       \forall iv;
         \forall jv;
           (     leq(Z(0(#)), iv)
               & lt(iv, seqLen(s))
               & leq(Z(0(#)), jv)
               & lt(jv, seqLen(s))
               & seqGet<int>(s, iv) = seqGet<int>(s, jv)
            -> iv = jv)
      ==>
    )
  };
}

== seqNPermInjectiveOnGet (seqNPermInjectiveOnGet) =========================================

  seqNPermInjectiveOnGet {
    \schemaVar \term int i;
    \schemaVar \term int j;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s;

    \assumes(seqNPerm(s) ==>)
    \find(seqGet<int>(s, i) = seqGet<int>(s, j))

    \add(
            leq(Z(0(#)), i)
          & lt(i, seqLen(s))
          & leq(Z(0(#)), j)
          & lt(j, seqLen(s))
          & seqGet<int>(s, i) = seqGet<int>(s, j)
       -> i = j
      ==>
    )
    \heuristics(seqNPermProperties)
  };
}

== seqPermCountsInt (seqPermCountsInt) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  seqPermCountsInt {
    \schemaVar \variables any element;
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s1;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s2;

    \find(seqPerm(s1, s2))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(element, s1),
      \notFreeIn(element, s2),
      \notFreeIn(iv, s1),
      \notFreeIn(iv, s2)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \forall element;
          bsum{iv;}(Z(0(#)),
                    seqLen(s1),
                    \if (seqGet<any>(s1, iv) = element)
                        \then (Z(1(#)))
                        \else (Z(0(#))))
        = bsum{iv;}(Z(0(#)),
                    seqLen(s2),
                    \if (seqGet<any>(s2, iv) = element)
                        \then (Z(1(#)))
                        \else (Z(0(#))))
    )
  };
}

== seqPermDef (seqPermDef) =========================================

  seqPermDef {
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \variables Seq s;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s1;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s2;

                   = seqGet<any>(s2, seqGet<int>(s, iv))))
    )
  };

== seqPermExists (seqPermExists) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  seqPermExists {
    \schemaVar \variables int iv;
    \schemaVar \formula  phi;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s1;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s2;
    \schemaVar \variables any x;

    \assumes(seqPerm(s1, s2) ==>)
    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(iv, phi),
      \notFreeIn(iv, s1),
      \notFreeIn(iv, s2)
    )
    \add(
           \exists iv;
             (  leq(Z(0(#)), iv)
              & lt(iv, seqLen(s1))
              & {\subst x;seqGet<any>(s1, iv)}phi)
       <-> \exists iv;
             (  leq(Z(0(#)), iv)
              & lt(iv, seqLen(s1))
              & {\subst x;seqGet<any>(s2, iv)}phi)
      ==>
    )
  };
}

              & leq(Z(0(#)), jv)
              & lt(iv, seqLen(s2))
              & lt(jv, seqLen(s2))
              & s1 = seqSwap(s2, iv, jv))
    )
  };

== seqReverseUnfold (seqReverseUnfold) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  seqReverseUnfold {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program NonSimpleExpression #nse;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #vNew;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #v = \seq_reverse(#nse);
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\newTypeOf(#vNew, #nse))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #typeof(#nse) #vNew = #nse;
          #v = \seq_reverse(#vNew);
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #eMiddle;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #eRight;
    \schemaVar \program NonSimpleExpression #nseLeft;

    \schemaVar \program Variable #vLeftNew;

         ... }\endmodality post

    \varcond(\newTypeOf(#vLeftNew, #nseLeft))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #typeof(#nseLeft) #vLeftNew = #nseLeft;
          #v = \seq_sub(#vLeftNew, #eMiddle, #eRight);
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "seqSubUnfold"
  };
}

== seqSwapPreservesSeqPerm (seqSwapPreservesSeqPerm) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  seqSwapPreservesSeqPerm {
    \schemaVar \term Seq s;
    \schemaVar \term int x;
    \schemaVar \term int y;

    \find(==> seqPerm(s, seqSwap(s, x, y)))
    \add(
      ==>
         leq(Z(0(#)), x)
       & lt(x, seqLen(s))
       & leq(Z(0(#)), y)
       & lt(y, seqLen(s))
    )
    \heuristics(seqSimplifyEnlarging)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== seqSwapPreservesSeqPermEQ (seqSwapPreservesSeqPermEQ) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  seqSwapPreservesSeqPermEQ {
    \schemaVar \term Seq EQ;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s;
    \schemaVar \term int x;
    \schemaVar \term int y;

    \assumes(seqSwap(s, x, y) = EQ ==>)
    \find(==> seqPerm(s, EQ))
    \add(
      ==>
         leq(Z(0(#)), x)
       & lt(x, seqLen(s))
       & leq(Z(0(#)), y)
       & lt(y, seqLen(s))
    )
    \heuristics(seqSimplifyEnlarging)
  };
}

== seqnormalizeDef (seqnormalizeDef) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  seqnormalizeDef {
    \schemaVar \term int le;
    \schemaVar \term int ri;
    \schemaVar \term any t;
    \schemaVar \variables int u;

    \find(seqDef{u;}(le, ri, t))

    \varcond(\notFreeIn(u, le), \notFreeIn(u, ri))
    \replacewith(
      \if (lt(le, ri))
          \then (seqDef{u;}(Z(0(#)),
                            sub(ri, le),
                            {\subst u;add(u, le)}t))
          \else (seqEmpty)
    )
  };
}

== setEqualityToElementOfRight (setEqualityToElementOfRight) =========================================
setEqualityToElementOfRight {
  \schemaVar \variables T av;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> t;

  \find(==> s = t)
  \varcond(\notFreeIn(av, s), \notFreeIn(av, t))
  \replacewith(
    ==>
     \forall av;
       (elementOf<T>(av, s) <-> elementOf<T>(av, t))
  )
  \heuristics(setEqualityBlastingRight)
}

== setMinusOfUnion (setMinusOfUnion) =========================================

  \schemaVar \term Set<T> distributedSet;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> unionLeft;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> unionRight;

  \find(
     setMinus<T>(union<T>(unionLeft, unionRight),
                 distributedSet)

             setMinus<T>(unionRight, distributedSet))
  )
  \heuristics(setDist)

== shiftLeftDef (shiftLeftDef) =========================================
shiftLeftDef {
  \schemaVar \term int left;
  \schemaVar \term int right;

  \find(shiftleft(left, right))

  \replacewith(
    \if (lt(right, Z(0(#))))
        \then (shiftrightPositiveShift(left,
                                       neg(right)))
        \else (shiftleftPositiveShift(left, right))
  )
  \heuristics(simplify_enlarging)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== shiftLeftPositiveShiftDef (shiftLeftPositiveShiftDef) =========================================
shiftLeftPositiveShiftDef {
  \schemaVar \term int left;
  \schemaVar \term int right;

  \find(shiftleftPositiveShift(left, right))

  \replacewith(mul(left, pow(Z(2(#)), right)))
  \heuristics(simplify)
}

shiftRightDef {
  \schemaVar \term int left;
  \schemaVar \term int right;

  \find(shiftright(left, right))

  \replacewith(
    \if (lt(right, Z(0(#))))
        \then (shiftleftPositiveShift(left, neg(right)))
        \else (shiftrightPositiveShift(left, right))
  )
  \heuristics(simplify_enlarging)
}

shiftRightPositiveShiftDef {
  \schemaVar \term int left;
  \schemaVar \term int right;

  \find(shiftrightPositiveShift(left, right))

  \replacewith(div(left, pow(Z(2(#)), right)))
  \heuristics(simplify)
}

== sign_case_distinction (sign_case_distinction) =========================================
sign_case_distinction {
  \schemaVar \term int signCasesLeft;

  "#signCasesLeft is negative":
    \add(leq(signCasesLeft, Z(neglit(1(#)))) ==>);
  "#signCasesLeft is zero":
    \add(signCasesLeft = Z(0(#)) ==>);
  "#signCasesLeft is positive":
    \add(geq(signCasesLeft, Z(1(#))) ==>)
  \heuristics(inEqSimp_signCases)
}

== simplifySelectOfAnon (simplifySelectOfAnon) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  simplifySelectOfAnon {
    \schemaVar \term Field f;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h2;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s;
    \schemaVar \term beta sk;

    \find(select<beta>(anon(h, s, h2), o, f) = sk ==>)
    \replacewith(
         \if (    elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(o,
                                                                                        f),
                                                          s)
                & !f = java.lang.Object::#$created
              | elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(o,
                                                                                      f),
                                                        freshLocs(h)))
             \then (select<beta>(h2, o, f))
             \else (select<beta>(h, o, f))
       = sk
      ==>
    )
    \addrules(
      replaceKnownSelect {
        \find(select<beta>(anon(h, s, h2), o, f))
        \sameUpdateLevel\inSequentState
        \replacewith(sk)
        \heuristics(concrete)
      }
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_select)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== simplifySelectOfAnonEQ (simplifySelectOfAnonEQ) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  simplifySelectOfAnonEQ {
    \schemaVar \term Heap EQ;
    \schemaVar \term Field f;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h2;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s;
    \schemaVar \term beta sk;

    \assumes(anon(h, s, h2) = EQ ==>)
    \find(select<beta>(EQ, o, f) = sk ==>)
    \replacewith(
         \if (    elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(o,
                                                                                        f),
                                                          s)
                & !f = java.lang.Object::#$created
              | elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(o,
                                                                                      f),
                                                        freshLocs(h)))
             \then (select<beta>(h2, o, f))
             \else (select<beta>(h, o, f))
       = sk
      ==>
    )
    \addrules(
      replaceKnownSelect {
        \find(select<beta>(EQ, o, f))
        \sameUpdateLevel\inSequentState
        \replacewith(sk)
        \heuristics(concrete)
      }
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_select)
  };
}

== singletonAssignment (singletonAssignment) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  singletonAssignment {
    \schemaVar \program Variable #a;
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #seObj;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v;

       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..

    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };

== singletonUnfold (singletonUnfold) =========================================

  singletonUnfold {
    \schemaVar \program Variable #a;
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program NonSimpleExpression #nseObj;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v;

       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..

          #v = \singleton(#vObjNew.#a);
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

== sizeOfMapRemove (sizeOfMapRemove) =========================================
sizeOfMapRemove {
  \schemaVar \term K key;
  \schemaVar \term Map<K,V> m;

  \find(mapSize<K, V>(mapRemove<K, V>(m, key)))

  \add(
        isFinite<K, V>(m)
     ->   mapSize<K, V>(mapRemove<K, V>(m, key))
        = \if (inDomain<K, V>(m, key))
              \then (sub(mapSize<K, V>(m), Z(1(#))))
              \else (mapSize<K, V>(m))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(inReachableStateImplication)
}

  \schemaVar \term H y;

  \replacewith(false)
  \heuristics(concrete)

== startsWith (startsWith) =========================================

    \schemaVar \term Seq searchStr;
    \schemaVar \term Seq sourceStr;

    \find(clStartsWith(sourceStr, searchStr))

    \replacewith(
      \if (gt(seqLen(searchStr), seqLen(sourceStr)))
          \then (false)
          \else (  seqSub(sourceStr,
                          Z(0(#)),
                          seqLen(searchStr))
                 = searchStr)
    )
    \heuristics(defOpsStartsEndsWith)
  };
}

== staticMethodCall (methodCall) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & initialisation:disableStaticInitialisation) {
  staticMethodCall {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #elist;
    \schemaVar \program MethodName #mn;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #se.#mn(#elist);
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\staticMethodReference(#se, #mn, #elist))
    "Normal Execution":
      \replacewith(
        \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
            #methodCall(#v0, #se.#mn(#elist))
          ... }\endmodality post
      )
    \heuristics(method_expand)
    \displayname "methodCall"
  };
}

== stringAssignment (stringAssignment) =========================================
stringAssignment {
  \schemaVar \modalOperator {
    box,
    box_transaction,
    diamond,
    diamond_transaction
  } #normalassign;
  \schemaVar \program StringLiteral #slit;
  \schemaVar \program Variable #v;
  \schemaVar \formula  post;

  \find(
     \modality{#normalassign}{ ..
         #v = #slit;
       ... }\endmodality post
  )

  \replacewith(
    {#v:=strPool(#slit)}
      \modality{#normalassign}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
  )
  \add(
     !strPool(#slit) = null,
       select<boolean>(heap,
                       strPool(#slit),
                       java.lang.Object::#$created)
     = TRUE
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(simplify_prog, simplify_prog_subset)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== stringConcat (stringConcat) =========================================
stringConcat {
  \schemaVar \modalOperator {
    box,
    box_transaction,
    diamond,
    diamond_transaction
  } #normalassign;
  \schemaVar \program SimpleStringExpression #sstr1;
  \schemaVar \program SimpleStringExpression #sstr2;
  \schemaVar \program Variable #v;
  \schemaVar \formula  post;
  \schemaVar \skolemTerm java.lang.String sk;

  \find(
     \modality{#normalassign}{ ..
         #v = #sstr1 + #sstr2;
       ... }\endmodality post
  )

  \varcond(\newDependingOn(sk, post))
  \replacewith(
    {#v:=sk}
      {heap:=create(heap, sk)}
        \modality{#normalassign}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
  )
  \add(
       strContent(sk)
     = seqConcat(strContent(#sstr1),
                 strContent(#sstr2))
    ==> sk = null
  )
  \heuristics(simplify_prog, simplify_prog_subset)
}

== stringConcatBooleanLeft (stringConcatBooleanLeft) =========================================
stringConcatBooleanLeft {
  \schemaVar \modalOperator {
    box,
    box_transaction,
    diamond,
    diamond_transaction
  } #normalassign;
  \schemaVar \program SimpleJavaBooleanExpression #seLeft;
  \schemaVar \program SimpleStringExpression #sstrRight;
  \schemaVar \program Variable #v;
  \schemaVar \formula  post;
  \schemaVar \skolemTerm java.lang.String sk;

  \find(
     \modality{#normalassign}{ ..
         #v = #seLeft + #sstrRight;
       ... }\endmodality post
  )

  \varcond(\newDependingOn(sk, post))
  \replacewith(
    {#v:=sk}
      {heap:=create(heap, sk)}
        \modality{#normalassign}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
  )
  \add(
       strContent(sk)
     = seqConcat(\if (#seLeft = TRUE)
                     \then (seqConcat(seqSingleton(C(6(1(1(#))))),
                                      seqConcat(seqSingleton(C(4(1(1(#))))),
                                                seqConcat(seqSingleton(C(7(1(1(#))))),
                                                          seqSingleton(C(1(0(1(#)))))))))
                     \else (seqConcat(seqSingleton(C(2(0(1(#))))),
                                      seqConcat(seqSingleton(C(7(9(#)))),
                                                seqConcat(seqSingleton(C(8(0(1(#))))),
                                                          seqConcat(seqSingleton(C(5(1(1(#))))),
                                                                    seqSingleton(C(1(0(1(#)))))))))),
                 strContent(#sstrRight))
    ==> sk = null
  )
  \heuristics(simplify_prog, simplify_prog_subset)
}

== sub (sub) =========================================
sub {
  \schemaVar \term int i;
  \schemaVar \term int i0;

  \find(sub(i, i0))

  \replacewith(add(i, neg(i0)))
  \heuristics(simplify_int)
}

== subPSeqComplete (subPSeqComplete) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  subPSeqComplete {
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> seq;

    \find(pseqSub<E>(seq, Z(0(#)), pseqLen<E>(seq)))

    \replacewith(seq)
    \heuristics(seqConcrete)
  };
}

    \schemaVar \variables int i;
    \schemaVar \term int u;

       pseqSub<E>(pseqDef<E>{i;}(Z(0(#)), u, a),
                  Z(0(#)),
                  u)
    )

    \heuristics(seqConcrete)
  };
}

    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> EQ;
    \schemaVar \term E a;
    \schemaVar \variables int i;
    \schemaVar \term int u;

    \assumes(pseqDef<E>{i;}(Z(0(#)), u, a) = EQ ==>)
    \find(pseqSub<E>(EQ, Z(0(#)), u))

    \replacewith(pseqDef<E>{i;}(Z(0(#)), u, a))
    \heuristics(no_self_application, seqConcrete)

== subPSeqConcat (subPSeqConcat) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  subPSeqConcat {
    \schemaVar \term int l;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s1;
    \schemaVar \term PSeq<E> s2;
    \schemaVar \term int u;

    \find(pseqSub<E>(pseqConcat<E>(s1, s2), l, u))

    \replacewith(
      pseqConcat<E>(pseqSub<E>(s1,
                               l,
                               \if (lt(pseqLen<E>(s1), u))
                                   \then (pseqLen<E>(s1))
                                   \else (u)),
                    pseqSub<E>(s2,
                               \if (lt(l, pseqLen<E>(s1)))
                                   \then (Z(0(#)))
                                   \else (sub(l,
                                              pseqLen<E>(s1))),
                               sub(u, pseqLen<E>(s1))))
    )
    \heuristics(seqSimplifyEnlarging)
  };
}

    \schemaVar \term int u;

    \assumes(pseqConcat<E>(s1, s2) = EQ ==>)

      pseqConcat<E>(pseqSub<E>(s1,
                               l,

                                   \then (pseqLen<E>(s1))

                                              pseqLen<E>(s1))),

  };
}

== subPSeqSingleton2 (subPSeqSingleton2) =========================================

    \schemaVar \term int l;
    \schemaVar \term int u;
    \schemaVar \term E x;

    \find(pseqSub<E>(pseqSingleton<E>(x), l, u))

    \replacewith(
      pseqConcat<E>(pseqSub<E>(pseqEmpty<E>,
                               \if (lt(l, Z(0(#))))
                                   \then (l)
                                   \else (Z(0(#))),
                               \if (lt(u, Z(0(#))))
                                   \then (u)
                                   \else (Z(0(#)))),
                    pseqConcat<E>(\if (  leq(l, Z(0(#)))
                                       & geq(u, Z(1(#))))
                                      \then (pseqSingleton<E>(x))
                                      \else (pseqEmpty<E>),
                                  pseqSub<E>(pseqEmpty<E>,
                                             \if (gt(l,
                                                     Z(0(#))))
                                                 \then (l)
                                                 \else (Z(1(#))),
                                             \if (gt(u,
                                                     Z(0(#))))
                                                 \then (u)
                                                 \else (Z(1(#))))))
    )
    \heuristics(seqSimplifyEnlarging)
  };
}

-----------------------------------------------------
== subSeqConcat (subSeqConcat) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  subSeqConcat {
    \schemaVar \term int l;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s1;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s2;
    \schemaVar \term int u;

    \find(seqSub(seqConcat(s1, s2), l, u))

    \replacewith(
      seqConcat(seqSub(s1,
                       l,
                       \if (lt(seqLen(s1), u))
                           \then (seqLen(s1))
                           \else (u)),
                seqSub(s2,
                       \if (lt(l, seqLen(s1)))
                           \then (Z(0(#)))
                           \else (sub(l, seqLen(s1))),
                       sub(u, seqLen(s1))))
    )
    \heuristics(seqSimplifyEnlarging)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== subSeqConcatEQ (subSeqConcatEQ) =========================================
\rules (sequences:on) {
  subSeqConcatEQ {
    \schemaVar \term Seq EQ;
    \schemaVar \term int l;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s1;
    \schemaVar \term Seq s2;
    \schemaVar \term int u;

    \assumes(seqConcat(s1, s2) = EQ ==>)
    \find(seqSub(EQ, l, u))

    \replacewith(
      seqConcat(seqSub(s1,
                       l,
                       \if (lt(seqLen(s1), u))
                           \then (seqLen(s1))
                           \else (u)),
                seqSub(s2,
                       \if (lt(l, seqLen(s1)))
                           \then (Z(0(#)))
                           \else (sub(l, seqLen(s1))),
                       sub(u, seqLen(s1))))
    )
    \heuristics(no_self_application, seqSimplifyEnlarging)
  };
}

== subSeqSingleton2 (subSeqSingleton2) =========================================

  subSeqSingleton2 {
    \schemaVar \term int l;
    \schemaVar \term int u;
    \schemaVar \term any x;

    \find(seqSub(seqSingleton(x), l, u))

    \replacewith(
      seqConcat(seqSub(seqEmpty,
                       \if (lt(l, Z(0(#))))
                           \then (l)
                           \else (Z(0(#))),
                       \if (lt(u, Z(0(#))))
                           \then (u)
                           \else (Z(0(#)))),
                seqConcat(\if (  leq(l, Z(0(#)))
                               & geq(u, Z(1(#))))
                              \then (seqSingleton(x))
                              \else (seqEmpty),
                          seqSub(seqEmpty,
                                 \if (gt(l, Z(0(#))))
                                     \then (l)
                                     \else (Z(1(#))),
                                 \if (gt(u, Z(0(#))))
                                     \then (u)
                                     \else (Z(1(#))))))
    )
    \heuristics(seqSimplifyEnlarging)
  };
}

== sub_equations_left (sub_equations_left) =========================================
sub_equations_left {
  \schemaVar \term int i;
  \schemaVar \term int i0;
  \schemaVar \term int j;
  \schemaVar \term int j0;

  \assumes(i = i0 ==>)
  \find(j = j0 ==>)
  \add(sub(j, i) = sub(j0, i0) ==>)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== sub_equations_right (sub_equations_right) =========================================
sub_equations_right {
  \schemaVar \term int i;
  \schemaVar \term int i0;
  \schemaVar \term int j;
  \schemaVar \term int j0;

  \assumes(i = i0 ==>)
  \find(==> j = j0)
  \add(==> sub(j, i) = sub(j0, i0))
}

== subsetToElementOf (subsetToElementOf) =========================================
subsetToElementOf {
  \schemaVar \variables T av;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> t;

  \find(subset<T>(s, t))

  \varcond(\notFreeIn(av, s), \notFreeIn(av, t))
  \replacewith(
    \forall av;
      (elementOf<T>(av, s) -> elementOf<T>(av, t))
  )
  \heuristics(semantics_blasting)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== subsetToElementOfLocSet (subsetToElementOfLocSet) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  subsetToElementOfLocSet {
    \schemaVar \variables Field fv;
    \schemaVar \variables java.lang.Object ov;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s2;

    \find(subset<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(s, s2))

    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(fv, s),
      \notFreeIn(fv, s2),
      \notFreeIn(ov, s),
      \notFreeIn(ov, s2)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \forall ov;
        \forall fv;
          (   elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(ov,
                                                                                    fv),
                                                      s)
           -> elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(ov,
                                                                                    fv),
                                                      s2))
    )
    \heuristics(semantics_blasting)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== subsetToElementOfLocSetRight (subsetToElementOfLocSetRight) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  subsetToElementOfLocSetRight {
    \schemaVar \variables Field fv;
    \schemaVar \variables java.lang.Object ov;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s2;

    \find(
      ==>
      subset<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(s, s2)
    )
    \varcond(
      \notFreeIn(fv, s),
      \notFreeIn(fv, s2),
      \notFreeIn(ov, s),
      \notFreeIn(ov, s2)
    )
    \replacewith(
      ==>
       \forall ov;
         \forall fv;
           (   elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(ov,
                                                                                     fv),
                                                       s)
            -> elementOf<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(pair<java.lang.Object, Field>(ov,
                                                                                     fv),
                                                       s2))
    )
    \heuristics(locSetEqualityBlastingRight)
  };
}

subsetToElementOfRight {
  \schemaVar \variables T av;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> t;

  \find(==> subset<T>(s, t))
  \varcond(\notFreeIn(av, s), \notFreeIn(av, t))
  \replacewith(
    ==>
     \forall av;
       (elementOf<T>(av, s) -> elementOf<T>(av, t))
  )
  \heuristics(setEqualityBlastingRight)
}

  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s;

  \find(subset<T>(empty<T>, s))

  \replacewith(true)
  \heuristics(concrete)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== subsetWithSetMinusLeft (subsetWithSetMinusLeft) =========================================
subsetWithSetMinusLeft {
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s2;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s3;

  \find(subset<T>(setMinus<T>(s, s2), s3))

  \replacewith(subset<T>(s, union<T>(s2, s3)))
  \heuristics(simplify_enlarging)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== subsetWithSetMinusLeftEQ (subsetWithSetMinusLeftEQ) =========================================
subsetWithSetMinusLeftEQ {
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> EQ;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s2;
  \schemaVar \term Set<T> s3;

  \assumes(setMinus<T>(s, s2) = EQ ==>)
  \find(subset<T>(EQ, s3))

  \replacewith(subset<T>(s, union<T>(s2, s3)))
  \heuristics(simplify_enlarging)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== subsortTrans (subsortTrans) =========================================
subsortTrans {
  \schemaVar \term SORT s1;
  \schemaVar \term SORT s2;
  \schemaVar \term SORT s3;

  \assumes(ssubsort(s1, s2), ssubsort(s2, s3) ==>)
  \add(ssubsort(s1, s3) ==>)
  \heuristics(simplify_enlarging)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== subst_to_eq (subst_to_eq) =========================================
subst_to_eq {
  \schemaVar \skolemTerm G sk;
  \schemaVar \term G t;
  \schemaVar \term S1 target;
  \schemaVar \variables G u;

  \find({\subst u;t}target)

  \varcond(\newDependingOn(sk, t))
  \replacewith({\subst u;sk}target)
  \add(sk = t ==>)
  \heuristics(simplify)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== subst_to_eq_for (subst_to_eq) =========================================
subst_to_eq_for {
  \schemaVar \formula  phi;
  \schemaVar \skolemTerm G sk;
  \schemaVar \term G t;
  \schemaVar \variables G u;

  \find({\subst u;t}phi)

  \varcond(\newDependingOn(sk, t))
  \replacewith({\subst u;sk}phi)
  \add(sk = t ==>)
  \heuristics(simplify)
  \displayname "subst_to_eq"
}

== substringSubstring (substringSubstring) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  substringSubstring {
    \schemaVar \term int innerEndIdx;
    \schemaVar \term int innerStartIdx;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm Seq newSym;
    \schemaVar \term int outerEndIdx;
    \schemaVar \term int outerStartIdx;
    \schemaVar \term Seq str;

    \find(
       seqSub(seqSub(str, innerStartIdx, innerEndIdx),
              outerStartIdx,
              outerEndIdx)
    )

    \varcond(
      \newDependingOn(newSym, innerStartIdx),
      \newDependingOn(newSym, outerEndIdx),
      \newDependingOn(newSym, outerStartIdx),
      \newDependingOn(newSym, str)
    )
    \add(
            geq(innerStartIdx, Z(0(#)))
          & geq(innerEndIdx, innerStartIdx)
          & leq(innerEndIdx, seqLen(str))
          & geq(outerStartIdx, Z(0(#)))
          & geq(outerEndIdx, outerStartIdx)
          & leq(outerEndIdx,
                sub(innerEndIdx, innerStartIdx))
       ->     seqSub(seqSub(str,
                            innerStartIdx,
                            innerEndIdx),
                     outerStartIdx,
                     outerEndIdx)
            = newSym
          &   seqSub(str,
                     add(outerStartIdx, innerStartIdx),
                     add(innerStartIdx, outerEndIdx))
            = newSym
      ==>
    )
    \heuristics(
      stringsIntroduceNewSym,
      stringsReduceSubstring)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== substringSubstring2 (substringSubstring2) =========================================
\rules (Strings:on) {
  substringSubstring2 {
    \schemaVar \term int innerEndIdx;
    \schemaVar \term int innerStartIdx;
    \schemaVar \term Seq innerSub;
    \schemaVar \skolemTerm Seq newSym;
    \schemaVar \term int outerEndIdx;
    \schemaVar \term int outerStartIdx;
    \schemaVar \term Seq str;

    \assumes(
      seqSub(str, innerStartIdx, innerEndIdx) = innerSub
      ==>
    )
    \find(seqSub(innerSub, outerStartIdx, outerEndIdx))

    \varcond(
      \newDependingOn(newSym, innerStartIdx),
      \newDependingOn(newSym, outerEndIdx),
      \newDependingOn(newSym, outerStartIdx),
      \newDependingOn(newSym, str)
    )
    \add(
            geq(innerStartIdx, Z(0(#)))
          & geq(innerEndIdx, innerStartIdx)
          & leq(innerEndIdx, seqLen(str))
          & geq(outerStartIdx, Z(0(#)))
          & geq(outerEndIdx, outerStartIdx)
          & leq(outerEndIdx,
                sub(innerEndIdx, innerStartIdx))
       ->     seqSub(innerSub,
                     outerStartIdx,
                     outerEndIdx)
            = newSym
          &   seqSub(str,
                     add(outerStartIdx, innerStartIdx),
                     add(innerStartIdx, outerEndIdx))
            = newSym
      ==>
    )
    \heuristics(
      stringsIntroduceNewSym,
      stringsReduceSubstring)
  };
}

== switch (switch) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  switch {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Switch #sw;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #sw
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #switchToIf(#sw)
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

== synchronizedBlockEmpty (synchronizedBlockEmpty) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java & runtimeExceptions:ban) {
  synchronizedBlockEmpty {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
      ==>
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           synchronized(#se) {}
         ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \varcond(\isLocalVariable (#se))
    "Normal Execution":
      \replacewith(
        ==>
         \modality{#allmodal}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
      );
    "#se is not null":
      \replacewith(==> !#se = null)
    \heuristics(simplify_prog, simplify_prog_subset)
  };
}

== synchronizedBlockEvalSync (synchronizedBlockEvalSync) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  synchronizedBlockEvalSync {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #loc;
    \schemaVar \program NonSimpleExpressionNoClassReference #nsencr;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #slist;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           synchronized(#nsencr) {
             #slist
           }
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(
      \newTypeOf(#loc, #nsencr),
      \isLocalVariable (#nsencr)
    )
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #typeof(#nsencr) #loc = #nsencr;
          synchronized(#loc) {
            #slist
          }
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog, simplify_prog_subset)
  };
}

== tanIsNaN (tanIsNaN) =========================================
tanIsNaN {
  \schemaVar \term double arg;

  \find(tanDouble(arg))

  \add(
        doubleIsNaN(arg)
      | doubleIsInfinite(arg)
     -> doubleIsNaN(tanDouble(arg))
    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}

    ==>
  )
  \heuristics(userTaclets1)
}

== tryBreak (tryBreak) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  tryBreak {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Catch #cs;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #slist;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           try {
             break;
             #slist
           }catch #cs
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          break;
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

== tryCatchFinallyThrow (tryCatchFinallyThrow) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  tryCatchFinallyThrow {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Catch #cs;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #slist;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #slist1;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #slist2;
    \schemaVar \program Type #t;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           try {
             throw #se;
             #slist
           } catch (#t #v0) {
             #slist1
           }catch #cs finally {
             #slist2
           }
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          if (#se == null) {
            try {
              throw new java.lang.NullPointerException();
            } catch (#t #v0) {
              #slist1
            }catch #cs finally {
              #slist2
            }
          } else if (#se instanceof #t) {
            try {
              #t #v0;
              #v0 = (#t) #se;
              #slist1
            } finally {
              #slist2
            }
          } else {
            try {
              throw #se;
            }catch #cs finally {
              #slist2
            }
          }
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== tryCatchThrow (tryCatchThrow) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  tryCatchThrow {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program SimpleExpression #se;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #slist;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #slist1;
    \schemaVar \program Type #t;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #v0;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           try {
             throw #se;
             #slist
           } catch (#t #v0) {
             #slist1
           }
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    "Null reference in throw":
      \replacewith(
        \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
            try {
              throw new java.lang.NullPointerException();
            } catch (#t #v0) {
              #slist1
            }
          ... }\endmodality post
      )
      \add(#se = null ==>);
    "Normal execution":
      \replacewith(
        \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
            if (#se instanceof #t) {
              #t #v0;
              #v0 = (#t) #se;
              #slist1
            } else {
              throw #se;
            }
          ... }\endmodality post
      )
      \add(==> #se = null)
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}

            #t #v0;
            #v0 = (#t) #se;
            #slist1
          } else {
            try {
              throw #se;
            } catch (#t2 #v1) {
              #slist3
            }catch #cs
          }
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
    \displayname "tryCatchThrow"

== unionArrayRangeAdjacent (unionArrayRangeAdjacent) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  unionArrayRangeAdjacent {
    \schemaVar \term int lower;
    \schemaVar \term int lower2;
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term int upper;
    \schemaVar \term int upper2;

    \find(
       union<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(arrayRange(o,
                                                      lower,
                                                      upper),
                                           arrayRange(o,
                                                      lower2,
                                                      upper2))
    )

    \replacewith(
      \if (  leq(lower, upper)
           & lower2 = add(upper, Z(1(#)))
           & lt(upper, upper2))
          \then (arrayRange(o, lower, upper2))
          \else (union<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>>(arrayRange(o,
                                                                lower,
                                                                upper),
                                                     arrayRange(o,
                                                                lower2,
                                                                upper2)))
    )
    \heuristics(locSetArrayRangeMerge)
  };
}

                                                                lower,
                                                                upper),
                                                     arrayRange(o,
                                                                lower2,
                                                                upper2)))
    )

== unsignedShiftRightJintDef (unsignedShiftRightJintDef) =========================================
unsignedShiftRightJintDef {
  \schemaVar \term int left;
  \schemaVar \term int right;

  \find(unsignedshiftrightJint(left, right))

  \replacewith(
    \if (geq(left, Z(0(#))))
        \then (shiftrightJint(left, right))
        \else (addJint(shiftrightJint(left, right),
                       shiftleftJint(Z(2(#)),
                                     sub(Z(1(3(#))),
                                         mod(right,
                                             Z(2(3(#))))))))
  )
  \heuristics(simplify_enlarging)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== unsignedShiftRightJlongDef (unsignedShiftRightJlongDef) =========================================
unsignedShiftRightJlongDef {
  \schemaVar \term int left;
  \schemaVar \term int right;

  \find(unsignedshiftrightJlong(left, right))

  \replacewith(
    \if (geq(left, Z(0(#))))
        \then (shiftrightJlong(left, right))
        \else (addJlong(shiftrightJlong(left, right),
                        shiftleftJlong(Z(2(#)),
                                       sub(Z(3(6(#))),
                                           mod(right,
                                               Z(4(6(#))))))))
  )
  \heuristics(simplify_enlarging)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== unusedLabel (unusedLabel) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  unusedLabel {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Label #lb;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #s;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           #lb:
           #s
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\not\freeLabelIn (#lb,#s))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          #s
        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_prog)
  };
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== unwindLoopScope (unwindLoopScope) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  unwindLoopScope {
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #allmodal;
    \schemaVar \program Statement #body;
    \schemaVar \program Expression #nse;
    \schemaVar \program Variable #x;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
           while (#nse) #body
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \varcond(\new(#x, boolean))
    \replacewith(
      \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
          boolean #x;
          loop-scope (#x) {
            if (#nse) {
              #body
              continue;
            } else {
              break;
            }
          }
        ... }\endmodality (  (     #x<<loopScopeIndex>>
                                 = TRUE
                              -> post)
                           & (     #x<<loopScopeIndex>>
                                 = FALSE
                              -> \modality{#allmodal}{ ..
                                     #reattachLoopInvariant(while (
                                       #nse
                                     ) #body)
                                   ... }\endmodality post))
    )
    \heuristics(loop_scope_expand)
  };
}

== wellFormedAnon (wellFormedAnon) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  wellFormedAnon {
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h2;
    \schemaVar \term Set<Pair<java.lang.Object,Field>> s;

    \find(wellFormed(anon(h, s, h2)))
    \succedentPolarity
    \replacewith(wellFormed(h) & wellFormed(h2))
    \heuristics(concrete)
  };
}

    \schemaVar \term Heap h2;

    \succedentPolarity
    \replacewith(wellFormed(h) & wellFormed(h2))
    \heuristics(concrete)
  };
}

== wellFormedMemsetArrayObject (wellFormedMemsetArrayObject) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  wellFormedMemsetArrayObject {
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object ar;
    \schemaVar \term Heap h;
    \schemaVar \term int lo;
    \schemaVar \term int up;
    \schemaVar \term deltaObject x;

    \find(
      wellFormed(memset(h, arrayRange(ar, lo, up), x))
    )
    \succedentPolarity
    \varcond(\hasElementarySort(ar, alpha))
    \replacewith(
        wellFormed(h)
      & (  x = null
         |   select<boolean>(h,
                             x,
                             java.lang.Object::#$created)
           = TRUE
         & arrayStoreValid(ar, x))
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_enlarging)
  };
}

== wideningCastIntToFloat (cast) =========================================
\rules (programRules:Java) {
  wideningCastIntToFloat {
    \schemaVar \program Variable #loc;
    \schemaVar \modalOperator {
      box,
      box_transaction,
      diamond,
      diamond_transaction
    } #normalassign;
    \schemaVar \program JavaCharByteShortIntExpression #seCharByteShortInt;
    \schemaVar \formula  post;

    \find(
       \modality{#normalassign}{ ..
           #loc = (float) #seCharByteShortInt;
         ... }\endmodality post
    )

    \replacewith(
      {#loc:=cast<float>(#seCharByteShortInt)}
        \modality{#normalassign}{ ..  ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(executeFloatAssignment)
    \displayname "cast"
  };

        ... }\endmodality post
    )
    \heuristics(simplify_expression)
    \displayname "cast"
  };
}

== writePermission (writePermission) =========================================
writePermission {
  \schemaVar \term Permission p;

  \find(writePermission(p))

  \replacewith(writePermissionObject(currentThread, p))
  \heuristics(simplify_enlarging)
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== writePermissionObject (writePermissionObject) =========================================
\rules (permissions:off) {
  writePermissionObject {
    \schemaVar \term java.lang.Object o;
    \schemaVar \term Permission p;

    \find(writePermissionObject(o, p))

    \replacewith(true)
    \heuristics(concrete)
  };
}

== xorJIntDef (xorJIntDef) =========================================
xorJIntDef {
  \schemaVar \term int left;
  \schemaVar \term int right;

  \find(xorJint(left, right))

  \replacewith(moduloInt(binaryXOr(left, right)))
  \heuristics(simplify)
}

== zadd_left_cancel0 (zadd_left_cancel0) =========================================
zadd_left_cancel0 {
  \schemaVar \term int i0;
  \schemaVar \term int i1;

  \find(i0 = add(i0, i1))

  \replacewith(i1 = Z(0(#)))
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== zero_leq_mult_iff (zero_leq_mult_iff) =========================================
zero_leq_mult_iff {
  \schemaVar \term int i0;
  \schemaVar \term int i1;

  \find(leq(Z(0(#)), mul(i0, i1)))

  \replacewith(
      leq(Z(0(#)), i0) & leq(Z(0(#)), i1)
    | leq(i0, Z(0(#)))
    & leq(i1, Z(0(#)))
  )
}
-----------------------------------------------------
== zero_less_mult_iff (zero_less_mult_iff) =========================================
zero_less_mult_iff {
  \schemaVar \term int i0;
  \schemaVar \term int i1;

  \find(lt(Z(0(#)), mul(i0, i1)))

  \replacewith(
      lt(Z(0(#)), i0) & lt(Z(0(#)), i1)
    | lt(i0, Z(0(#)))
    & lt(i1, Z(0(#)))
  )
}
